title: Lead Engineer, Data Management
description:
The Lead Data Management Engineer is responsible for overseeing and guiding the information management activities within the organization, including data management, document control, engineering design system administration, and CMMS database build. This role requires a strong understanding of information management principles, best practices, and technologies. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing information management strategies, ensuring quality and integrity across all functions,.

Develop information management policy and standards that align with the organization's goals and objectives, and operate the Information Management section based on these standards.

  • Lead and manage a team of 80+ information management professionals, providing guidance, mentorship, and performance evaluations.
  • Oversee the information management activities (including data management, document control, engineering design system administration, and CMMS database building) in ongoing projects and provide necessary support/guidance to complete the project on time, within scope, and within budget.
  • Oversee proposal activities related to information management, ensuring accurate and timely submissions.
  • Define and monitor information management performance metrics, identifying areas for improvement and implementing corrective actions as needed.
  • Ensure quality and integrity across all information management functions.
  • Oversee the selection, development, operation, and maintenance of information management systems and tools, ensuring they meet the organization's requirements and industry best practices.
  • Collaborate and coordinate with stakeholders across the organization to implement information management activities in both projects and corporate.
  • Provide training and support to staff on information management principles, tools, and techniques.
  • Plan resource allocation to project/corporate positions based on demand as well as the career development perspective of each information management professional.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Science.
  • 15+ years of experience in information management, with a focus on data management, document control, engineering design system administration, and CMMS database build.

Competencies

Technical:

  • Strong understanding of information management principles, best practices, and technologies.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and address complex information management challenges.
  • Experience with information management tools and technologies.
  • Familiarity with relevant industry regulations and standards.

title: Solution Architect Teamcenter
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Solution Architect Teamcenter based in Canada.

Join a team of PLM and IT specialists dedicated to helping manufacturing organizations simplify complex engineering and business processes. As a Solution Architect specializing in Teamcenter, you will act as a trusted technical advisor, translating customer requirements into scalable Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) solutions. You will lead solution design, implementation planning, customization, migration, testing, and deployment across diverse industrial environments. Combining deep technical expertise with business process knowledge, you will help customers optimize their digital engineering ecosystems and integrate Teamcenter with CAD and ERP systems. You will also contribute to project leadership, coordinate international multidisciplinary teams, and guide customers through digital transformation initiatives. This opportunity offers long-term career development in a collaborative environment that values technical excellence, customer relationships, and sustainable professional growth.

Accountabilities:

You will serve as a key point of contact for customers on PLM solutions and project-related matters, ensuring that business requirements are translated into effective technical architectures and successful implementations. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Analyze customer requirements: Capture and evaluate business processes, identify operational needs, and translate requirements into comprehensive PLM solution concepts.

  • Design and present solutions: Develop, document, and present solution architectures, implementation approaches, and technical recommendations tailored to customer objectives.

  • Advise customers: Provide expert guidance on available solutions, implementation strategies, methodologies, and process improvements related to Teamcenter and PLM/PDM environments.

  • Estimate and plan projects: Assess technical effort, contribute to proposal preparation, define implementation approaches, and establish plans for Teamcenter deployments and customizations.

  • Lead solution implementation: Oversee or contribute directly to solution design, configuration, customization, migration, testing, and rollout activities.

  • Configure and customize Teamcenter: Implement customer-specific solutions, including server-side and client-side customizations, to address complex business and engineering requirements.

  • Manage integrations: Support Teamcenter integration with CAD and ERP systems to enable effective data exchange and connected engineering workflows.

  • Apply appropriate project methodologies: Use agile or traditional project management approaches to structure requirements, solution concepts, and technical specifications.

  • Coordinate project delivery: Participate in projects as a technical specialist or assume partial or overall project leadership responsibilities.

  • Lead multidisciplinary teams: Coordinate international and cross-functional stakeholders, ensuring alignment between technical teams, business representatives, and customers.

  • Resolve complex technical challenges: Apply detailed knowledge of Teamcenter's internal functionality and processes to recommend practical solutions and support successful implementation.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines extensive Teamcenter expertise with a strong understanding of PLM/PDM processes, solution architecture, and project delivery. You should be comfortable advising customers, translating complex requirements into technical solutions, and collaborating with international teams. The following qualifications and capabilities are expected:

    • Education: A completed degree or vocational qualification in computer science, mechanical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

    • PLM/PDM expertise: Strong knowledge of Product Lifecycle Management and Product Data Management processes, concepts, methodologies, and implementation practices.

    • Teamcenter experience: Extensive practical experience with Teamcenter architecture, functionality, configuration, and customization.

    • Teamcenter modules: Detailed knowledge of Teamcenter Structure Management, Change Management, Dispatcher, Scheduler, and/or other relevant modules.

    • Organization and access management: Experience with Teamcenter organization structures, permissions, and access management.

    • Server-side customization: Knowledge of BMIDE-based configuration and customization, including data models, workflows, and ITK/SOA services.

    • Client-side customization: Experience with both codeless and code-based customization for Active Workspace (AW) and Rich Application Client (RAC).

    • System integration: Experience integrating Teamcenter with CAD and ERP systems.

    • Technical problem-solving: Ability to understand Teamcenter's internal processes, assess complex technical requirements, and develop effective implementation solutions.

    • Project management: Demonstrated project experience, ideally including partial or full project leadership and familiarity with agile methodologies.

    • Communication and collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills, intercultural competence, and the ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary and international teams.

    • Language skills: Very good German proficiency and strong written and spoken English.

      • Benefits:

      • Long-term employment: Permanent employment contract offering professional stability.

      • Established work environment: Join a family-owned company with a long-standing presence in the PLM and manufacturing technology sector.

      • Collaborative team culture: Work in a supportive environment characterized by teamwork, mutual assistance, and knowledge sharing.

      • Structured working hours: Benefit from defined core working hours and overtime compensation.

      • Competitive compensation: Attractive annual gross target compensation, with an optional company car.

      • Professional development: Access opportunities to expand your technical expertise and advance your career.

      • Individual development support: Benefit from personalized employee discussions and career development opportunities.

      • Team events: Participate in company activities that strengthen collaboration and team spirit.

      • Additional perks: Access benefits such as bicycle leasing and corporate fitness programs.

      • Work-life balance: Join an organization that values employees' different life stages and supports a sustainable balance between professional and personal commitments.

As the only international firm with dual accreditation, as a CISI Chartered Status firm and a CII International Professional Partner Partner Firm, we are committed to delivering trusted advice and the highest standards of service to achieve the best outcomes for our clients.

Whether you’re pursuing long-term financial goals or navigating complex regulations, Titan Wealth International provides clear, informed guidance tailored to your needs. With transparent fees and a commitment to lasting relationships, our mission is to empower you with effective financial solutions.


The Paraplanner will work as part of the Global Wealth Division (GWD), the international wealth management division serving clients across multiple jurisdictions. The role will provide high-quality technical and administrative support to Wealth Planners and the wider client-facing team, contributing to the preparation of clear, accurate and suitable financial planning recommendations that meet client needs, internal standards and applicable regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate will undertake detailed research and analysis, prepare suitability reports and supporting documentation, and help ensure client files are complete and maintained to a consistently high standard. They will work collaboratively with advisers and other colleagues across GWD to support an efficient and positive client experience.

This role requires a proactive and detail-focused individual with strong technical knowledge, sound judgement and a commitment to continuous professional development.

Important Requirements

Please note the following requirements before applying:

  • Applicants must hold a recognised Level 4 Diploma in Financial Planning (or equivalent) as a minimum.
  • Applicants must already be studying towards Chartered status (or have clear plans to commence Chartered-level qualifications in the near future).
  • This role is suited to experienced technical paraplanners who are committed to developing their expertise within financial planning and wealth management.
  • Candidates must have experience producing suitability reports, conducting technical research and supporting advisers with complex financial planning cases.

Please note that Titan Wealth does not provide relocation assistance or cover relocation costs. Any candidate applying from outside the UAE must be willing and financially able to fund their own relocation to Dubai.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide high-quality paraplanning support to Wealth Planners and the wider GWD team.
  • Undertake detailed research and analysis to support appropriate financial planning recommendations for clients.
  • Prepare clear, accurate and compliant suitability reports, including reports involving complex investment, retirement, tax-efficient investment and trust-planning considerations.
  • Review client information and supporting documentation, identifying any gaps or further information required before recommendations are finalised.
  • Complete technical and suitability checks on cases in line with internal standards and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Work closely with Wealth Planners to ensure recommendations accurately reflect each client’s objectives, circumstances, attitude to risk and agreed financial plan.
  • Maintain complete and accurate client records within the company’s systems and ensure all relevant documentation is stored appropriately.
  • Support the development and consistent application of GWD advice processes, report templates and technical standards.
  • Keep up to date with relevant regulatory, tax, product and market developments, and share relevant updates with the GWD team.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of client materials, internal guidance and working practices across GWD.
  • Build effective working relationships with colleagues, product providers and other relevant third parties to support timely case progression.

Core Competencies

Experience: Proven experience in a paraplanning, technical support or financial planning support role.
Professionalism: Represent the business professionally and maintain appropriate standards of conduct.
Accuracy: Apply strong attention to detail to financial analysis, reports and client records.
Time Management: Prioritise work effectively, manage competing deadlines and progress cases efficiently.
Communication: Communicate clearly and professionally in writing and verbally with colleagues and relevant third parties.
Integrity and Ethical Behaviour: Act fairly, honestly and professionally in all business dealings, with client interests at the centre of the work.
Partnership and Teamwork: Build effective working relationships across GWD and the wider business and contribute positively as part of a team.
Decision-Making: Apply sound judgement, raise concerns promptly and take responsibility for the quality of work produced.
Adaptability: Respond positively to changing priorities, processes and regulatory requirements.
Continuous Learning: Maintain and develop technical knowledge through ongoing learning and professional development.

Technical Competencies

Financial Planning Knowledge: Good understanding of financial planning principles, products and the needs of internationally mobile and cross-border clients.

Research and Financial Analysis: Ability to assess client information, evaluate options and produce clear technical analysis to support recommendations.

Suitability Report Writing: Ability to prepare accurate, well-structured and client-focused suitability reports, including reports for complex cases.

Regulatory Compliance: Working knowledge of the laws, regulations and internal standards relevant to the role, with the ability to apply them consistently.

Risk and File Quality: Ability to identify missing information, inconsistencies and potential risks, and to escalate matters appropriately.

Client Relationship Management Systems: Confidence using client relationship management systems to maintain accurate records, track case progress and manage documentation.

Data Management: Strong data-entry and record-keeping skills, with close attention to accuracy and confidentiality.

Written and Presentation Materials: Ability to produce and improve clear, professional client reports, meeting materials and internal technical guidance.

Essential Qualifications and Experience

  • Minimum three years’ experience in a paraplanning, technical support or financial planning role.
  • Level 4 qualification from a recognised financial services professional body.
  • Experience supporting international financial planning clients and advisers.
  • Strong experience preparing suitability reports and technical research.

Desirable Qualifications and Experience

  • Additional relevant professional or industry qualification.
  • Degree-level education or equivalent professional experience.
  • Experience supporting high-net-worth or internationally mobile clients.
Our employees are talented people, distinguished by excellence. You will be able to demonstrate a willingness to embrace the Company values of:
Creativity – we recognise we need new ways of thinking, learning and doing to both improve our own productivity and efficiency as well as to help us stay ahead of competitors.
Commitment – we are team with the willingness to put time, effort and energy into driving change in the organisation, going the extra mile.
Collaboration – we need teamwork amongst ourselves and with partners to generate more innovative, efficient and effective solutions and thereby a greater sense of achievement.
The Titan Wealth Group is firmly committed to fostering an inclusive and equitable environment for everyone who works with us, regardless of their race, age, gender, sexual orientation, religion, physical ability or disability, or political affiliation. We believe that having a diverse team allows us to create the best possible outcomes for our clients and team members. We strive to provide equal opportunities in all aspects of the workplace with respect to recruitment and career advancement, pay and benefits, training and development opportunities and other job-related activities.

title: Sr. Manager, Government Relations
description:

title: News Editor, The Stranger
description:
Job Title: News Editor
Company: The Stranger
Location: Seattle

Salary $100,000


The Stranger is looking for a News Editor who can drive ambitious, original news coverage, break the stories that matter to Seattle, and continue to establish The Stranger as the city's most essential source for local news.


The News Editor will work closely with the Editor in Chief to shape and lead the paper's news coverage, from breaking news and daily reporting to investigations and accountability journalism. The News Editor should have sharp news judgment, a deep curiosity about how Seattle works and who holds power, and the confidence to push reporters toward stronger stories, better sourcing, and bolder angles. They should value beat ownership and help reporters build the sources and expertise to consistently break news in their areas. An ideal candidate is fast, accurate, and energized by a busy news cycle, and holds the highest ethical standards of journalistic integrity.


The typical schedule is Monday through Friday, though you may be asked to work nights and weekends during breaking news, elections, and other major events. Some telecommuting is allowed, as approved by the Editor in Chief. The News Editor must be able to attend regular meetings at The Stranger's offices on Capitol Hill and generally work from the office to better lead and support reporters.


Responsibilities

  • Lead The Stranger's daily news coverage across web, newsletters (including Slog AM), and the monthly print edition.
  • Identify and own the stories that matter in Seattle. Break news and cultivate the newsroom's original reporting on local government, politics, housing, public safety, labor, and other civic issues.
  • Assign, edit, and shape news stories, from quick-turn breaking news to longform investigations, overseeing fact-checking, accuracy, clarity, and style.
  • Build and uphold beat discipline, making sure reporters own their beats, develop sources, and deliver consistent, authoritative coverage.
  • Coach and develop reporters and freelancers with clear, direct, supportive feedback that strengthens their reporting and writing.
  • Plan and lead election coverage and special news projects in partnership with the Editor in Chief.
  • Collaborate with the Arts, Photo, Art, Social, Podcast, and Video teams to tell news stories across formats and platforms.
  • Hit production deadlines and goals for both print and digital formats.
  • Partner with news editors across the Noisy Creek family of publications in Chicago, Portland, and beyond to share stories, strategies, and best practices.
  • Help foster a strong newsroom culture built on high journalistic integrity, healthy debate, and respect for colleagues.
  • Organize and oversee The Stranger Election Control Board.

title: Pædagog/pædagogisk assistent til Plejehjemmet Kildemosen, Samsø
description:
Er du pædagog eller pædagogisk assistent med et stort omsorgshjerte, der brænder for at skabe en skøn og meningsfuld hverdag for vores beboere? Så håber vi, at du vil søge mod Samsø og blive en del af vores fantastiske team!



Om jobbet

Plejehjemmet Kildemosen søger en ny kollega, som har lyst til at være medskaber af det gode og meningsfulde hverdagsliv for vores beboere. Vi er i fuld gang med at implementere den nye Ældrelov. Vi arbejder med helhedspleje, og vi vægter beboernes selvbestemmelse, det rehabiliterende sigte og kontakt til familie, fællesskaber og civilsamfundet højt. Du vil blive en vigtig del af denne proces.

Vi søger 2 pædagoger/pædagogiske assistenter til faste stillinger.

Vi forventer, at du

  • er uddannet pædagog eller pædagogisk assistent
  • har lyst og evne til at arbejde rehabiliterende og personcentreret for at understøtte den enkelte beboers selvbestemmelse, ønsker og behov, og trivsel i hverdagen.
  • deltager aktivt i helhedsplejen; personlig pleje og andre praktiske opgaver omkring en beboer (erfaring ikke et krav), og relationelt arbejde/socialpædagogiske indsatser.
  • tør bringe din faglighed i spil, er nysgerrig på andres perspektiver og bidrager aktivt til, at vi sammen finder de gode faglige løsninger.
  • trives i et tværfagligt samarbejde og respekterer forskellige fagligheder og kompetencer.
  • altid ser person før sygdom, og møder beboere, familie/pårørende og kolleger med respekt, åbenhed og ordentlighed.
  • kan arbejde inden for gældende instrukser og retningslinjer, og arbejder struktureret, ansvarligt og med blik for både faglighed og relationer.
  • er fortrolig med daglig dokumentation, og du har gerne kendskab til CURA.
Hvad kan du forvente?

  • Et veltilrettelagt intro-forløb, så du kommer godt fra start.
  • Et spændende arbejdsmiljø, hvor faglig sparring, refleksion og udvikling af praksis er i centrum.
  • En varieret hverdag med faglige udfordringer, og mulighed for at danne tætte relationer og følge beboernes udvikling tæt.
  • Mulighed for kompetenceudvikling.
  • Et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde med sosu-hjælpere, sosu-assistenter, ergoterapeut, sygeplejersker og demenskoordinator.
  • Vi har fokus på at anvende velfærdsteknologier og vi er gode til at anvende dem i hverdagen. Vi har stor interesse for at prøve nye ting af, hvis det giver mening for beboerne og/eller for os.
  • Mulighed for medindflydelse på tilrettelæggelsen af din arbejdsdag.
  • Vores dokumentation foregår i CURA.
Om Kildemosen

Plejehjemmet Kildemosen er beliggende i Tranebjerg i hjertet af Samsø, ca. 10 min. fra færgerne fra hhv. Jylland og Sjælland. Plejehjemmet har 34 lejligheder fordelt på fire huse med fælles gårdhaver og sansehave. Hver lejlighed har direkte adgang til egen terrasse.

Ansættelsesstedet er Plejehjemmet Kildemosen, Kildemosen 1-4, Tranebjerg, 8305 Samsø.

Det vil være en stor fordel, hvis du vil være en del af vores dejlige lokalsamfund, men det er ikke et krav. Samsø Kommune er en lille og velfungerende kommune, der gerne vil vise omverdenen, at Samsø både er en skøn ferieø og et godt sted at bo og arbejde hele året.


Ansættelsesvilkår

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst mellem relevant faglig organisation og Samsø Kommune. Lønnen er efter principperne om Lokal løn.

Timeantal: 30-37 timer ugentligt

Arbejdstid: Blandede dag- og aftenvagter

Weekendvagt hver 2. weekend

Vi er åbne for at skabe en stilling, der passer til dig – vi kan både tilbyde faste stillinger og tidsbegrænsede ansættelser.



Vi ønsker stillingen besat snarest muligt – dog senest 1. januar 2027.

Ansættelsessamtaler afholdes løbende, og stillingsopslaget tages ned, når de rette kandidater er fundet.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 15. november 2026.



Har du lyst til at vide mere?

Hvis du er nysgerrig, har spørgsmål til stillingen eller har lyst til at besøge os, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte forstander, Rena Christou: aurc@samsoe.dk / 25454150 eller viceforstander, John Asahi Sørensen: John.Soerensen@samsoe.dk / 24346485



Lyder det som noget for dig – og bor du ikke på Samsø? Så kan du læse meget mere om livet på Samsø på www.tidtilsamsoe.dk eller følge med på både Instagram på @tidtilsamsoe og Facebook på @tidtilsamsoe. Du kan læse mere om Samsø Kommune på kommunens hjemmeside www.samsoe.dk

Øen er kendt for en helt unik natur, de smukke landskaber, lyset, havet og den helt specielle østemning. Samsø er højtprofileret som en grøn kommune med en meget skarp miljøprofil. Kommunen lever af landbrug og turister og har i betragtning af sit befolkningsgrundlag et bemærkelsesværdigt stærkt kultur- og foreningsliv.



Vi foretrækker, at du søger stillingen online ved at bruge knappen ”Send ansøgning”. Husk at vedhæfte din ansøgning og CV samt andre relevante bilag. Når du har sendt ansøgningen, modtager du en e-mail som kvittering. Vær opmærksom på, at mailen kan være placeret i din mappe Uønsket post. Samsø Kommune opfordrer alle til at søge stillingen uanset køn, alder, etnisk baggrund, handicap m.v.

title: Sr. Solution Architect, Professional Services (Finance)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Solution Architect, Professional Services (Finance) based in the United States.

We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect to design and deliver sophisticated enterprise planning solutions that address complex financial and operational challenges. In this role, you will transform business requirements, spreadsheets, and existing systems into scalable, multidimensional models that support better decision-making. You will serve as a trusted architectural expert on strategic accounts, helping organizations optimize planning processes and connect data across functions. Working closely with customers, business partners, and delivery teams, you will contribute throughout the implementation lifecycle, from requirements gathering and solution design to testing and deployment. This opportunity combines financial modeling, data integration, and business analytics in a collaborative, customer-focused professional services environment. You will also have the opportunity to share your expertise, coach others, and expand your experience across industries.

Accountabilities

  • Translate existing solutions, spreadsheets, and business challenges into sophisticated multidimensional planning models.

  • Enhance and optimize existing models as part of connected planning solutions or to introduce new functionality.

  • Serve as the architectural subject matter expert for large-scale, connected planning implementations.

  • Apply established implementation principles and methodologies to ensure high-quality solution delivery.

  • Provide timely progress updates, feedback, and communication to business partners and project teams.

  • Develop and maintain clear model documentation.

  • Contribute to data integration and migration solutions, including inbound and outbound data flows.

  • Participate in or lead user acceptance testing (UAT), solution validation, and deployment activities.

  • Manage multiple implementation responsibilities while maintaining a strong focus on customer service, collaboration, and delivery excellence.

  • Share knowledge, support colleagues, and contribute to a team culture centered on continuous improvement and practical problem-solving.

    • Requirements

    • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Management Information Systems (MIS), or a related field.

    • At least 6 years of experience implementing Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) solutions, particularly in Supply Chain, Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Workforce Planning (WFP), or Sales Performance.

    • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and strong financial modeling capabilities.

    • Demonstrated knowledge of formal systems implementation methodologies, including requirements gathering, solution design, build, testing, and deployment; Agile experience is preferred.

    • Strong understanding of data integration processes, including inbound and outbound data flows.

    • Subject matter expertise in financial planning and modeling, workforce planning, or sales planning is strongly preferred.

    • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and business modeling skills, with a genuine interest in business analytics and planning.

    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to both technical and business audiences.

    • Proven ability to lead and manage multiple responsibilities simultaneously while delivering results.

    • A customer-focused mindset, collaborative working style, and commitment to service excellence.

    • Self-motivation, initiative, sound judgment, and a results-oriented approach.

    • A coaching mentality and willingness to share expertise with colleagues.

    • An open, collegial, and integrity-driven approach to teamwork.

    • Flexibility and a hands-on attitude when addressing complex challenges.

    • A strong desire to develop professionally, gain exposure to multiple industries, and contribute to a dynamic team environment.

      • Benefits

      • Professional growth: Opportunities to develop your solution architecture expertise and broaden your experience across multiple industries.

      • Career development: Exposure to complex enterprise planning challenges and strategic customer implementations.

      • Collaborative culture: Work with a team that values knowledge sharing, service excellence, diverse perspectives, and continuous improvement.

      • Inclusive workplace: A commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging, where individuals are respected and encouraged to bring their authentic selves to work.

title: Introduktion til psykiatri – et fantastisk spændende og udfordrende speciale

  • mulighed for ugentlig bedside supervision og masser af fælles undervisning

Du bliver en del af gruppen af læger på Psykiatrisk Center Ballerup.

title: Technical Authority Structural
description: W3.CSS BW Offshore leverages more than four decades of experience in operating advanced offshore production systems and executing complex projects. We are proud to have executed 40 FPSO and FSO projects, and have cultivated a culture of thorough engineering, trust and teamwork throughout the organisation. BW Offshore is actively engaged in the energy transition by developing clean energy production solutions, applying our offshore engineering and operations capabilities to drive future value creation. Our aim is to create tailored energy solutions for evolving global energy markets. We are looking for an experienced Technical Authority Structural to provide technical leadership, governance, and assurance across our FPSO and offshore portfolio. In this role, you will be the custodian of naval architecture standards, ensuring safe, compliant, and efficient design and operation throughout the asset lifecycle, while influencing how the discipline continues to evolve. This is a senior expert role for someone who enjoys combining deep technical mastery with strategic influence, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Key Tasks and Responsibilities: Own and continuously develop the company’s structural technical standards, defining minimum requirements for projects and operations Provide expert technical guidance to projects, asset operations, and the wider technical organisation Lead and support verification and assurance activities, ensuring compliance with corporate standards, regulatory requirements, and class rules Review and approve technical deviations, engineering methods, tools, and key discipline deliverables Act as the main technical interface with classification societies, regulators, and industry bodies Capture and implement lessons learned from projects and operations to drive continuous improvement Mentor and support the professional development of Structural Engineers across the organisation Collaborate closely with other engineering disciplines to deliver integrated, optimised solutions. Qualifications: Minimum of 15 years’ experience in offshore Oil Gas or a closely related industry working with floating production facilities Strong experience across both project and operational phases of offshore facilities, preferably FPSOs Previous experience as a Principal Engineer, Lead Engineer, or Technical Authority / Subject Matter Expert Proven ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and multinational environments Master’s degree in Civil or Structural Engineering Bachelor’s degree with extensive relevant experience may also be considered Skills: Deep expertise in structural, construction and materials engineering Strong understanding of industry rules and standards related Structural such as ABS, DNV, API, AISC, NORSOK, ISO and EC Knowledge of structural analysis softwares such as SACS, SASAM Genie, STAADPRO etc. Solid grasp of the technical, contractual, and commercial aspects of FPSO design, construction, and operation. We offer: A high-impact expert role with real authority over technical standards and decisions Exposure to complex, large-scale offshore assets across their full lifecycle Opportunity to influence how the structural discipline develops across the organisation. Collaborative, international working environment with highly skilled professionals Competitive compensation and benefits package Practicalities: The role may involve travel, including visits to project sites, shipyards, and offshore units Temporary assignments at project or asset locations may be required This role would preferably be filled in Singapore or Oslo, Norway. Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion BW Offshore is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all. We believe in fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of age, gender, disability, religion, or ethnic background.

title: Erfaren Rengøringsassistent til Hovedrengøring & Flytterengøring – København og Storkøbenhavn (see further down for English version)
description:
Social Facility Group er en af Danmarks hurtigst voksende rengøringsvirksomheder, og vi søger nu en dygtig og erfaren rengøringsassistent til vores afdeling for hovedrengøring og flytterengøring.

Du bliver en del af et team, hvor kvalitet og pålidelighed er i højsædet. Vi leder efter en, der har styr på faget, kan arbejde selvstændigt og er stolt af at aflevere et stykke arbejde, kunden bliver glad for.

Om jobbet

Du udfører hovedrengøring og flytterengøring hos både private og erhvervskunder i København og Storkøbenhavn. Opgaverne er varierede, og ingen dage er helt ens. Du arbejder både alene og sammen med kolleger, alt efter opgavens størrelse.

Vores kontor ligger i Kastrup, og du får stillet firmabil til rådighed i arbejdstiden, så du nemt kan komme rundt mellem opgaverne.

Vi tilbyder

  • En attraktiv timeløn, der afspejler din erfaring og kvaliteten af dit arbejde.

  • Firmabil til brug i arbejdstiden.

  • Alt nødvendigt rengøringsudstyr og materialer.

  • Varierede opgaver i hele hovedstadsområdet.

  • En arbejdsplads i vækst, hvor vi belønner ansvar, pålidelighed og performance, ikke anciennitet.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har erfaring med rengøring, gerne hovedrengøring eller flytterengøring.

  • Arbejder grundigt, effektivt og har et skarpt øje for detaljer.

  • Er selvkørende og kan tage ansvar for dine opgaver fra start til slut.

  • Er mødestabil og pålidelig.

  • Optræder venligt og professionelt over for kunderne.

  • Har gyldigt kørekort (B).

Lyder det som dig?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig. Send din ansøgning, og fortæl kort om din erfaring med rengøring.

English version

Experienced Cleaner for Deep Cleaning & Move-Out Cleaning – Copenhagen and Greater Copenhagen

Social Facility Group is one of Denmark’s fastest-growing cleaning companies, and we’re looking for a skilled and experienced cleaner to join our Deep Cleaning and Move-Out department.

You’ll be part of a team where quality and reliability come first. We’re looking for someone who knows the craft, works independently, and takes pride in delivering work that leaves customers happy.

About the job

You’ll carry out deep cleaning and move-out cleaning for both private and business customers across Copenhagen and Greater Copenhagen. The work is varied, and no two days are quite the same. Depending on the size of the job, you’ll work both on your own and alongside colleagues.

Our office is in Kastrup, and you’ll have a company car at your disposal during working hours, making it easy to get between jobs.

What we offer

  • An attractive hourly rate that reflects your experience and the quality of your work.

  • Company car for use during working hours.

  • All necessary cleaning equipment and supplies.

  • Varied assignments across the Copenhagen area.

  • A growing workplace that rewards responsibility, reliability, and performance, not seniority.

What we expect

  • Experience with cleaning, ideally deep cleaning or move-out cleaning.

  • A thorough, efficient approach and a sharp eye for detail.

  • The ability to work independently and take ownership of your tasks from start to finish.

  • Punctuality and reliability.

  • A friendly and professional manner with customers.

  • A valid driver’s license (category B).

Sound like you?

We’d love to hear from you. Send your application and tell us briefly about your cleaning experience.

title: Full Stack Udvikler til Koncern IT i Udlændingestyrelsen
description:
Vil du udvikle løsninger, der understøtter nogle af de centrale digitale processer på udlændingeområdet? Har du praktisk erfaring med softwareudvikling, et stærkt fagligt fundament og ambitioner om at tage større ansvar for dine opgaver i et tværfagligt udviklingsteam? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Til vores Udviklingsenhed søger vi en engageret Full Stack Udvikler, der kan bidrage aktivt til udviklingen og videreudviklingen af vores løsninger.



Hos os får du ikke bare opgaver, der skal kodes. Du bliver en del af et tværfagligt DevOps-team, hvor I følger jeres løsninger hele vejen fra udvikling til produktionssætning og efterfølgende vedligehold og får mulighed for at påvirke de tekniske løsninger og den måde, vi arbejder med softwareudvikling på.

Vi forventer ikke, at du kender alle vores teknologier fra første dag. Til gengæld forventer vi, at du har praktisk erfaring med professionel softwareudvikling, et solidt softwarefagligt fundament og evnen til hurtigt at sætte dig ind i nye teknologier, problemstillinger og eksisterende kodebaser.



Hvem er vi?

Koncern IT er organisatorisk placeret i Udlændingestyrelsen, men vores opgaver rækker langt bredere. Vi fungerer som det tekniske fundament, der binder styrelserne sammen og sikrer, at de digitale løsninger fungerer på tværs af hele Udlændinge- og Integrationsministeriet – herunder departementet, Udlændingestyrelsen, Styrelsen for International Rekruttering og Integration (SIRI), Hjemrejsestyrelsen og Flygtningenævnet.

Vi er i gang med en ambitiøs transformation af vores udviklingsorganisation, hvor vi opbygger og styrker vores interne udviklingskompetencer. Vi organiserer vores udvikling i tværfaglige DevOps-teams, der ejer løsningerne gennem hele deres livscyklus – fra udvikling og test til idriftsættelse, og videreudvikling.

Det betyder også, at du kommer ind i en organisation i bevægelse. Vi har ambitioner om at udvikle den måde, vi bygger software på, og du får mulighed for at bringe dine egne erfaringer i spil og være med til at forme vores tekniske løsninger og arbejdsformer.



Dine kommende hovedopgaver

I Koncern IT arbejder vi med en bred vifte af opgaver – fra komplekse backend-systemer og integrationer til moderne frontend-grænseflader. Du kommer til at arbejde direkte i vores eksisterende kodebaser og bidrage til applikationer, der blandt andet understøtter sagsbehandling, softwarekomponenter til bestilling af pas og opholdskort samt integrationer til Digital Post og CPR.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Udvikle og videreudvikle løsninger: Du udvikler nye features, videreudvikler eksisterende funktionalitet og løser fejl og tekniske problemstillinger i vores løsninger.
  • Tage ansvar for egne udviklingsopgaver: Du er med til at afklare, nedbryde og estimere opgaver og tager ansvar for at drive dem fra behov og analyse til implementering og test.
  • Arbejde på tværs af teknologier: Du arbejder primært med vores .NET og Angular-baserede løsninger, men du skal have lyst og evne til at bevæge dig på tværs af teknologier og dele af vores stack, når opgaven kræver det.
  • Sikre kvalitet i løsningerne: Du arbejder med blandt andet code reviews, automatiserede tests og dokumentation som en naturlig del af udviklingsarbejdet.
  • Bidrage til teamets tekniske løsninger: Du deltager aktivt i faglige diskussioner og er med til at træffe tekniske valg sammen med resten af teamet.
  • Følge løsningerne i drift: Du bidrager til deployment, fejlsøgning og stabil drift af de løsninger teamet har ansvar for.
  • Bidrage til vores udviklingsorganisation: Du bringer dine erfaringer og idéer i spil og er med til løbende at forbedre vores udviklingspraksis, værktøjer og arbejdsformer.


Din profil

Vi søger først og fremmest en dygtig softwareudvikler, der gennem professionelt udviklingsarbejde har opbygget et solidt teknisk fundament. Du har en relevant it-faglig uddannelse med softwareudvikling som et væsentlige element.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du ikke alene kan skrive god og ren kode, men også kan sætte dig ind i en problemstilling, forstå den sammenhæng løsningen skal fungere i og tage ansvar for at drive dine opgaver fremad.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har praktisk og professionel erfaring med udvikling i .NET og C#.
  • Har praktisk erfaring med SQL-databaser.
  • Har praktisk erfaring med JavaScript og/eller TypeScript.
  • Har erfaring med et frontend-framework som eksempelvis Angular, Blazor eller tilsvarende.
  • Har erfaring med Git eller tilsvarende versionsstyring, samt erfaring med at arbejde i eksisterende kodebaser.
  • Kan drive egne udviklingsopgaver og har ambitioner om at tage et større selvstændigt ansvar fra afklaring og analyse til implementering og test.
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret og samtidig aktivt søger og bidrager til faglig sparring.
  • Har et solidt softwarefagligt fundament og kan sætte sig ind i nye teknologier og frameworks.
  • Kan samarbejde med både tekniske og ikke-tekniske kollegaer om at omsætte behov til fungerende løsninger.
Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med:

  • DevOps og CI/CD
  • Azure DevOps eller tilsvarende værktøjer
  • Containerteknologier som Docker og Kubernetes
Som person er du fagligt nysgerrig og tager naturligt ejerskab for dine opgaver. Du trives med at løse problemer sammen med andre, men har ikke behov for, at alle skridt af en opgave er defineret på forhånd.

Du tør stille spørgsmål, udfordre en løsning konstruktivt og bringe dine egne erfaringer i spil. Samtidig ved du, hvornår det giver mening at række ud efter sparring hos en kollega.

Vi forventer ikke at du kender vores systemer eller domæne fra første dag. Til gengæld forventer vi, at du har den nødvendige erfaring og faglige ballast, samt nysgerrighed på at sætte dig ind i dem og bidrage aktivt til teamets leverancer.



Din kommende arbejdsplads

I Koncern IT er vi ca. 90 dygtige og engagerede medarbejdere, som har ansvaret for drift, vedligeholdelse og videreudvikling af ministeriets systemportefølje.

I Udviklingsenheden bliver du en del af et fagligt miljø med både interne medarbejdere og eksterne konsulenter. Vi sidder centralt i København tæt ved Kgs. Nytorv, og i hverdagen lægger vi vægt på både faglig sparring, samarbejde og en uformel omgangstone.

Vi tilbyder stor fleksibilitet og gode muligheder for faglig udvikling, herunder relevant efteruddannelse og certificeringer.

Hos os får du samtidig mulighed for at følge de løsninger, du udvikler, over længere tid. Du er ikke kun med til at levere dem – du er med til at eje, drive og videreudvikle dem.



Er du nysgerrig?

Så er du velkommen til at kontakte Mads Schjelde på tlf. 21 99 89 28 eller e-mail schj@us.dk eller kontorchef Vera Mali på tlf. 23 64 82 96 eller e-mail vema@us.dk.



Søg jobbet

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning, CV og eksamensbevis mv. senest onsdag d. 4. november 2026.

Vi forventer at holde samtaler i uge 46. Der kan være mulighed for, at der afholdes en 2. samtalerunde ligeledes i uge 46. I forbindelse med en eventuel 2. samtale, vil du skulle løse en faglig case.



Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Afhængig af din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund ansættes du enten efter overenskomst for akademikere i staten eller OAO-S-Fællesoverenskomsten og organisationsaftalen for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere (HK). Der er mulighed for at forhandle tillæg, der matcher dine kvalifikationer.

Ansættelsesområdet er Udlændinge- og Integrationsministeriet med tilhørende institutioner, og arbejdsstedet er Udlændingestyrelsen, Adelgade 11-13, 1304 København K.

Der er tale om en fast stilling på fuldtid med gennemsnitligt 37 timer om ugen.

Du skal opnå sikkerhedsgodkendelse til ”HEMMELIGT” for at arbejde i denne stilling, og opretholde denne under hele din ansættelse. Du kan læse om, hvordan vi behandler dine persondata her.

Ligestilling i alle dens aspekter er vigtig. Derfor opfordres alle interesserede uanset etnisk tilhørsforhold, religion, køn, alder og lign. til at søge stillingen. Udlændinge- og Integrationsministeriet er medlem af Foreningen Lige Adgang.

title: IT-tekniker för change och third line ärenden
description:
Din nya tjänst

Vi är ute efter att utöka vårt interna team med en till tekniker som kan lösa change- och third line ärenden, där vi hjälper våra kunder att optimera och utveckla sina IT-miljöer. Våra kunder har varierade IT-miljöer i huvudsakligen Windows, men andra miljöer förekommer. Vårt mål är att vara en heltäckande partner inom IT-infrastruktur och att ständigt utveckla våra tjänster. Vi tror på att jobba väldigt nära kunden och att alltid ge det lilla extra för att bidra med engagemang och kunskap för att skapa ett fint partnerskap.

Som tekniker jobbar du i ett mindre team där ni tillsammans utvecklar era kunskaper för att lösa de frågeställningar som ställs. Ansvaret för teamet ligger på Tech Lead som även bygger och förvaltar projekt strukturen.

Stor del av ditt arbete kommer ligga på att administrera och lösa svårare tekniska problem, inte bara våra kunders verksamhet, men även vår egen. För att lyckas i rollen krävs teamwork och en vilja att stötta upp där det behövs. Vi lägger stor vikt på ägarskap, viljan att lära sig och att problemlösa, för att i bästa mån tillsammans komma fram med lösningar för kund. Vi stöttar varandra för att fortsätta att utvecklas.

Vi har mycket att berätta om rollen och tror att den kan vara spännande med en bra kombination av utveckling och frihet. Den målinriktningen vi har är att det ska ligga inom området IT-infrastruktur och vi är inte rädda att ta på oss nya utmaningar!

Din bakgrund

Vi tror att du är en IT-tekniker som har en bred teknisk förståelse, samt har djupare kunskaper inom vissa områden. Du behöver inte behärska allt, men har en teknisk kompetens som gör att du kan utvecklas och komma med lösningar som kan gynna verksamheten. Vi ser gärna att du har koll på områden såsom M365/Azure, Exchange, backup, nätverk, klient och server hantering.

Krav

  • Högskoleutbildning inom IT eller motsvarande kunskap genom arbetslivserfarenhet.

  • Flytande i svenska och engelska.

  • Gedigen erfarenhet av arbete med Workplace-relaterade tjänster

  • Mycket goda kunskaper i Microsofts tech stack med tidigare erfarenhet av Microsoft 365, Active Directory och Azure

  • Du har också övergripande förståelse för flera, men mycket goda kunskaper kring några specifika tjänster/applikationer såsom SCCM, Intune, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange Online, Teams. Power Apps.

Personlighet

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet. Vi ser gärna att du är en person som gillar att bidra, ser möjligheter och har ett professionellt bemötande mot våra kunder. Du har ett säkerhetstänk i ditt sätt att arbeta.

Arbetstider

08:00-17:00. Vi har en hybrid arbetsplats med möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån vissa dagar.

Din ansökan

Välkommen med din ansökan! Urval sker löpande, så vi välkomnar din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Vid frågor, var vänligen kontakta Tilda på tilda.stenmark@thalamus.se eller Omar på omar.lordfye@thalamus.se

Din nya arbetsgivare

Thalamus är ett stadigt växande bolag inom IT-infrastruktur som erbjuder kvalificerade IT-konsulter/tjänster inom supporttekniker, Onsite & drift. Vi är ett familjärt bolag som ligger i Alvik strand och har funnits sedan 2000 talet.

Thalamus erbjuder certifierings- och utvecklingsmöjligheter med spännande och långsiktiga kunder som öppnar upp möjligheter för vidareutveckling och intressanta IT-projekt. Gemenskap är en viktig del, där vi ofta anordnar AW:s, sommarfest och julbord, så att alla anställda kan dela erfarenheter och glädje.

Om vi skulle beskriva oss själva skulle det vara att vi är ett glatt, kunskapsdrivet gäng vars arbete kännetecknas av kvalitet, nytänkande och personligt engagemang. Hoppas du vill bli en av oss!

title: Associate Scientific Director - Medical Communications
description:
About Avalere Health

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind.

Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere.

Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.

Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs.

We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.

We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.

Location: US or Canada (flexible but ideally East Coast)
About the role
We’re looking for an Associate Scientific Director to join our Medical Scientific Services team. In this role, you’ll provide advanced scientific leadership across a range of med affairs focused projects, taking responsibility for scientific accuracy, strategic oversight, and client relationship management within large workstreams or accounts.
You’ll combine content development with high-level reviewing, while line managing, mentoring and onboarding junior writers to deepen their scientific expertise. As a key leader, you’ll play an active role in team development and resourcing, contribute to business growth and strategic initiatives, and line manage junior writers.
This is an ideal next step for an Associate Principal Medical Writer, Principal Medical Writer, or equivalent looking to progress towards a Scientific Director role and broaden their impact across medical affairs deliverables.

What you'll do

  • Drive scientific leadership across a range of medical affairs deliverables, including advisory boards, congress materials and slide decks.
  • Provide advanced scientific review and strategic input to align content with client objectives.
  • Lead client relationships within assigned accounts, ensuring clear communication and trusted delivery.
  • Lead, mentor and empower junior writers, fostering professional growth and scientific expertise.
  • Contribute to business development, pitching and organic growth through scientific insights.

About you

  • Degree in a scientific or related field (advanced degree preferred).
  • Minimum 6 years’ experience in medical or scientific writing.
  • Proven ability to manage diverse scientific content and ensure strategic alignment.
  • Skilled in client relationship management and account oversight.
  • Collaborative leader with a passion for line management, mentoring and team development.
  • Experience supporting business development initiatives and supporting pitches.
  • Excellent communication skills and a proactive, solutions-focused mindset.
  • Oncology or Immunology TA experience is highly advantageous.
What we can offer

You will receive a 401K plan with an employer match contribution up to 4% (immediately vested), as well as life insurance, disability coverage, and medical, dental, and vision plans for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote work, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 20 vacation days plus one personal well-being day, recognise 9 public holidays, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August.

Access free counselling through our employee assistance program and personalized health support. Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business.

We encourage all applicants to read our candidate privacy notice before applying to Avalere Health.

title: Lead Software Engineer, Platform Engineering
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Software Engineer, Platform Engineering based in the United States.

We are seeking an experienced engineering leader to shape the platforms, tools, and services that enable teams to build and deliver software more effectively. This full-stack role combines backend and frontend development with DevOps, automation, and internal platform engineering. You will improve developer experience, streamline software delivery, and strengthen the reliability, security, and maintainability of production systems. Working closely with product, platform, and application engineering teams, you will influence technical direction and champion scalable engineering practices. You will also mentor colleagues, guide platform evolution, and turn operational insights into continuous improvements. This is an opportunity to make a broad technical impact in a collaborative, distributed environment supporting access to knowledge and education.

Accountabilities

  • Architect, develop, and maintain internal platforms, services, and tools that support CI/CD, automation, and efficient software delivery.

  • Own the development platform lifecycle, including pipeline design, deployment strategies, platform automation, and developer productivity tooling.

  • Apply DevOps and platform enablement practices to improve engineering velocity, software quality, reliability, and operational efficiency through standardized development pathways.

  • Collaborate with product, platform, and application engineering teams to understand developer needs and improve workflows, usability, and accessibility.

  • Build scalable backend services and RESTful APIs, alongside intuitive internal web applications and user-facing interfaces.

  • Mentor and coach engineers on architecture, coding standards, DevOps practices, and user experience considerations.

  • Facilitate technical deep dives, design reviews, and training sessions to encourage shared learning and consistent engineering standards.

  • Evaluate, prototype, implement, manage, and retire technologies based on their suitability and long-term value.

  • Contribute to platform roadmaps and translate organizational objectives into actionable technical initiatives.

  • Take ownership of systems throughout their lifecycle, supporting reliability, maintainability, security, and ongoing evolution.

  • Participate in incident response, production support, troubleshooting, and remediation activities.

  • Improve availability, alerting, performance, capacity planning, cost management, recovery processes, and technical debt, using operational feedback to drive continuous improvement.

    • Requirements

    • At least 8 years of experience as a full-stack software engineer delivering large-scale, distributed web applications.

    • Strong product thinking and the ability to build engineering communities, influence technical direction, and support shared goals.

    • Proven experience designing and developing scalable backend services and RESTful APIs.

    • Hands-on experience building internal or user-facing web applications with modern frontend frameworks such as React or Vue, applying UI/UX and accessibility best practices.

    • Working knowledge of CI/CD concepts, automation, and software delivery pipelines, using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or equivalent technologies.

    • Practical experience contributing to or operating internal developer platforms, engineering enablement tools, or shared services.

    • Strong experience with AWS services such as EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, and EKS.

    • Experience deploying applications with Docker and Kubernetes.

    • Hands-on knowledge of infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform.

    • Experience with event-driven architectures and messaging systems.

    • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot, debug, and optimize application and infrastructure performance across the stack.

    • Comfort working in Agile, cross-functional, distributed, or self-directed teams.

    • Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts, architectural decisions, and trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

    • A commitment to continuous improvement and building clear, reliable, maintainable systems. Deep expertise in every listed technology is not expected, and onboarding, mentorship, and ongoing learning support are available.

    • Ability to work and reside within the continental United States.

      • Benefits

      • Salary: Starting annual salary ranges from $145,000 to $160,000. Starting pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

      • Healthcare: Medical, dental, and vision insurance plans for benefits-eligible employees.

      • Retirement: Employer-paid retirement contribution of 10%.

      • Paid leave: 22 days of paid time off, 11 paid holidays, and up to 12 sick days.

      • Family support: Paid parental and caregiver leave.

      • Wellness: Wellness benefits and additional programs for eligible employees.

      • Remote flexibility: Remote work available within the continental United States, with a distributed workforce.

      • Learning and collaboration: Access to onboarding, mentorship, and continuous learning opportunities.

      • Benefits programs may be changed at the partner company's discretion. The listed salary is the stated starting range, and eligibility may apply to certain benefits.

title: Chief Laser Engineer, Electro-Optics
description:
ABOUT US

Join a Global Photonics Leader Engineering Solutions from the Deep Ocean to Outer Space!


G&H is a global leader in the design, engineering, and manufacture of advanced photonic technologies. As experts in the technology of light, we partner with customers to deliver optical systems, assemblies, and components for demanding applications across aerospace and defense, life sciences, industrial, and other high-performance markets.


With operations across the United States and Europe, G&H brings together deep technical expertise, precision manufacturing, and more than 75 years of innovation. Our success is built on the capability of our people and our ability to translate complex customer requirements into high-quality, reliable solutions.


As we continue to grow and evolve, we are investing in the people, leadership, and organizational capabilities required to scale our operations and support our customers.


THE OPPORTUNITY

The Chief Laser Engineer, Electro-Optics (EO) drives the design and development of innovative components and sub-systems based on electro-optics and non-linear optics from design, build, concept verification to performance test. They are the global technology and subject matter expert on linear and non-linear optical device technology and its application on laser systems for A&D, Life Science and Industrial applications. The Chief Laser Engineer, EO generates, owns and drives our technology/science roadmap. As the ultimate custodian of our technical knowledge and expertise in EO, she/he guides and mentors the team and ensures our knowledge is not only maintained but expanded and adapted, so we can respond to technology advancements and trends in the sector.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead and deliver R&D and product development projects with full understanding of product performance, material implications and design for manufacture
  • Design, develop and validate new and variant EO devices and SHG modules
  • Own, drive and manage our technology roadmap on Electro-Optics in order to intercept new opportunities and achieve profitable revenue growth
  • Lead engineering reviews and significantly contribute to product lifecycle planning
  • Discover, inspire and nurture innovation
  • Identify and report on trends of new technology or new applications of our existing technology that could lead to business growth
  • Lead and/or chair New Product Development gate reviews that illustrate the physical design implementation, identifying and mitigating risks between mechanical, optical, hardware, manufacturing, and supply chain interfaces
  • Assess and challenge the design work, quality of output and skillset levels on an ongoing basis
  • Identify potential competing technologies and generate risk mitigation strategies
  • Maintain, extend and safeguard our enabling technologies on Electro-Optics
  • Expand team skill-set and create new technical capabilities within the team
  • Push for Intellectual Property generation through the creation of new Know-How and patents
  • Identify new technologies and validate relevance for G&H to create a pipeline of new products
  • Work with Sales and Business Development to support RFQ/RFIs with technical solutions
  • Push for seamless handover from design to production
  • Participate in customer meetings and support marketing with technical material
  • Support talent management, development & succession planning activities

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

  • Educated to at least Master's degree level in Physics, Engineering or equivalent
  • Hands-on laboratory experience in developing and testing photonic devices
  • Experience in simulating and modelling in optics
  • Meticulousness, Diligence, Disciplined and capacity to work to deadlines and goals
  • Passion to solving complex technical problems
  • Inclination to adapt, absorb and conduct substantial change
  • Comfortable interacting at all levels in an organization and with customers

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Specialization in Electro-Optics, Non-Linear Optics and/or material science
  • Experienced with Solidworks, Zemax and/or ANSYS
  • Understanding of assembly, integration and testing of optical devices
  • Familiar with testing and qualification standards

COMPETENCIES & PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

  • Problem Solving
  • Innovative & Creative
  • Decision-making
  • Motivating others
  • Strategic outlook
  • Drive & Determination

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

  • On-time delivery of technical milestones
  • Revenue from new products
  • Adherence to R&D cost/budget
  • Generation of roadmaps & technology trend reports
  • Generation of technical blogs and/or papers
  • Demonstrable contribution to winning and delivering on the technical aspects of profitable new business

title: Law Clerk
description: Who We Are The Office of the Ohio Public Defender (OPD) is the state agency responsible for providing legal representation and other services to people accused or convicted of a crime who cannot afford to hire an attorney. The NWRH is located in Lima, OH and serves individuals in Allen County, Hardin County, and Putnam County. The Law Clerk will assist Assistant Public Defenders who represent indigent trial-level clients facing misdemeanor and felony criminal charges in Common Pleas, Municipal, and Juvenile courts within those counties. Intentional omission of relevant information, falsification, or misrepresentation of information on the application will disqualify the applicant. In addition, such intentional acts are grounds for immediate termination of an employee. Final candidates selected for this position will be required to undergo a drug test. This position serves at the pleasure and discretion of the State Public Defender. title: Vacancy | Test Engineer – GNSS Products | Leuven
description:
Location: Leuven,Vlaanderen,België

We are looking for highly qualified and motivated professionals like you. If you think you have what it takes to keep Septentrio firmly in Pole Position, get in touch.

We need you for the position of

Test Engineer – GNSS Products

The Job

As a Test Engineer, you help ensure the quality, reliability and performance of Septentrio’s high-precision GNSS products. You play an important role in the Verification and Validation (V&V) process, testing products throughout development and on existing platforms to identify defects and prevent regressions.

You combine hands-on testing with test automation, data analysis and technical reporting. Working closely with software developers and fellow test engineers, you investigate anomalies, follow up on corrective actions and help make our products more robust and reliable.

Your Mission

Test Design & Execution

  • Design, execute and document functional and technical tests based on product requirements.
  • Plan and perform laboratory and field test campaigns, including exploratory testing to uncover issues that planned tests may not reveal.
  • Test all aspects from a receiver, from individual features during development to complete product systems

Test Automation & Data Analysis

  • Develop scripts and tools, primarily using Python, to automate test execution, data processing, anomaly detection and reporting.
  • Analyze and visualize test results, identify unexpected behavior and investigate potential defects.
  • Monitor product performance and verify the stability of new developments and existing products.

Defect Investigation & Collaboration

  • Document test procedures, executions, findings and results in clear, structured technical reports.
  • Report defects, help identify their root causes and follow up on firmware adaptations and corrective actions.
  • Work closely with developers, product stakeholders and fellow test engineers to support product improvements and prevent regressions.

Your Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer, Electrical, Industrial or Geomatics Engineering, Physics, or an equivalent technical field.
  • Experience with Python, MATLAB and/or C for test automation, data analysis or technical tooling. Strong Python skills are particularly valuable.
  • Initial experience in software, hardware or system testing is an advantage.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to identify anomalies, interpret test results and investigate unexpected behavior.
  • A critical and curious mindset, with the motivation to uncover defects and help improve product quality.
  • A diligent, organized and hands-on approach to planning tests, executing them carefully and maintaining accurate documentation.
  • Creativity and initiative in designing tests that challenge products beyond expected use cases.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate constructively with developers and other team members.
  • Excellent written and spoken English, particularly for technical documentation and reporting.

The following are considered a plus:

  • ISTQB Foundation certification.
  • General knowledge of GPS/GNSS principles.
  • Experience with signal generators, oscilloscopes or other electronic laboratory equipment.

Our Offer

In exchange for your talent, we offer a very competitive compensation package in a top-notch high-tech, international working environment. At Septentrio you'll have room to grow, both personally and professionally. Our on-boarding plan is legendary, our homework policy family-friendly. Get in touch and help us shoot for the moon, the stars and beyond.

Vil du bruge din pædagogiske faglighed til at skabe stærke fællesskaber, nye deltagelses muligheder og styrke livschancer for børn og unge?

Brænder du for at skabe relationer, åbne døre og hjælpe børn og unge ind i positive fællesskaber? Er du god til at omsætte idéer til handling og skabe samarbejde mellem unge, foreninger, skoler, klubber og lokale aktører? Så er du måske vores nye netværksskabende medarbejder.

Vi søger en uddannet pædagog eller en medarbejder med anden relevant uddannelse til den boligsociale indsats i Frydenlund og Charlottehøj, som gennem positive fællesskaber, uddannelsesrettede aktiviteter og målrettet brobygning til lokale fritidstilbud skal være med til at styrke børn og unges trivsel, deltagelse og livschancer. Den netværksskabende funktion er en central drivkraft i arbejdet med at skabe stærke og inkluderende børn- og ungefællesskaber og sikre, at flere børn og unge finder vej til positive netværk og fritidsfællesskaber.

Om jobbet

Som netværksskabende medarbejder bliver du en synlig og aktiv ressource i lokalområdet. Du arbejder opsøgende og relationsskabende blandt børn og unge og hjælper dem videre ind i positive fællesskaber.

Du får særligt ansvar for at udvikle og drive indsatser inden for:

Studiecafé og læringsfællesskaber

  • Etablere og udvikle studiecafé i samarbejde med Ungdomsskolen UngiAarhus.
  • Rekruttere unge til studiecaféen og skabe attraktive og trygge læringsfællesskaber hvor unge støtter hinanden.
  • Bidrage til, at flere unge gennemfører uddannelse og styrker deres faglige kompetencer.
Brobygning til positive børn- og unge fællesskaber

  • Skabe kontakt mellem børn og unge, lokale skoler, lokale foreninger, klubber og fritidstilbud (herunder understøtte den lokale fritidsjobindsats).
  • At styrke børn og unges deltagelse i positive fællesskaber og bidrage til deres sociale, kulturelle og demokratiske dannelse i tæt samspil med lokale aktører og fællesskaber.
  • Understøtte ferie- og foreningsaktiviteter for børn og unge i et tæt samarbejde med den lokale foreningsudvikler.
Koordinerende funktion

  • Styrker sammenhængen mellem kommunale, boligsociale og lokale indsatser på børne- og ungeområdet gennem relationel koordinering og tæt samarbejde med børn, unge, familier og relevante aktører. Funktionen understøtter tværgående samarbejder, brobygning og fælles løsninger, der fremmer deltagelse, trivsel og positive fællesskaber for børn og unge. Du skal kunne omsætte faglighed til praksis i forskellige sammenhænge og være optaget af, hvad den pædagogiske ramme betyder for børnene og de unge og derigennem styrke indsatser på tværs.
  • Understøtte og koordinere den netværksskabende indsats på tværs af Hasle, vandtårnsområdet og Frydenlund. Dette sker gennem faglig sparring, videndeling, erfaringsopsamling og metodeudvikling, så lokale erfaringer omsættes til fælles læring, styrket praksis og en mere sammenhængende indsats på tværs af området.
  • Sikre formidling af erfaringer, resultater og læring fra indsatsen til relevante fagpersoner, samarbejdsfora og ledelsesniveauer.
Målgruppe

Den primære målgruppe er børn og unge i alderen 10-17 år, som står uden for positive fællesskaber, samt deres forældre. Indsatsen gennemføres i tæt samarbejde med den boligsociale familiekoordinator, frivilligkoordinator og boligsociale vicevært med henblik på at skabe helhedsorienterede løsninger omkring hele familien.

Den sekundære målgruppe er unge voksne i overgangen fra ungdoms- til voksenlivet. Her er fokus på brobygning til relevante kommunale tilbud inden for uddannelse, beskæftigelse og vejledning, så de unge understøttes i en positiv overgang til voksenlivet.

Vi forventer at du

  • Har en pædagogisk baggrund evt. med en overbygning eller andet relevant uddannelsesmæssig baggrund.
  • Har erfaring med børn og unge. Gerne i udsatte eller mangfoldige boligområder.
  • Er stærk i relationsarbejde og motiverende samtaler.
  • Kan arbejde opsøgende og skabe kontakt til unge, der ikke selv finder vej til fællesskaberne.
  • Har erfaring med at koordinere samarbejder, vidensopsamling samt udvikle indsatser på tværs af mange aktører.
  • Er initiativrig, selvstændig og handlekraftig.
Vi tilbyder

  • En meningsfuld stilling med stor betydning for børn og unges trivsel og fremtid.
  • Mulighed for at præge og udvikle nye indsatser.
  • Et stærkt fagligt fællesskab med det boligsociale arbejde, foreninger og kommunale aktører i lokalområdet i samarbejdet om indsatser overfor børn og unge i lokalområdet.
  • Høj grad af frihed, ansvar og mulighed for faglig udvikling.
  • En hverdag tæt på de børn og unge, som indsatsen er sat i verden for.
  • Gode kollegaer, der sætter pris på faglige drøftelser, kollegial opbakning samt en uhøjtidelig og munter omgangstone i dagligdagen.
Om indsatsen

Mange børn og unge i området står uden for organiserede fritidsfællesskaber og mangler adgang til netværk, der kan understøtte uddannelse, livschancer og trivsel. Som vores kommende kollega bliver du en central drivkraft i arbejdet med at styrke børn og unges deltagelse i positive fællesskaber. Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt med hovedbase i Frydenlund og løbende opgaveløsning og tilstedeværelse i Charlottehøj.

Du får ansvar for at udvikle, afprøve og implementere metoder, der mobiliserer børn og unge til deltagelse i meningsfulde fællesskaber. Med stor selvstændighed skal du igangsætte, udvikle og koordinere samarbejder på tværs af lokalsamfundet og skabe sammenhæng mellem indsatserne i området

Stillingen er organisatorisk forankret i UngiAarhus og indgår i en delt ledelsesstruktur mellem den lokale pædagogiske leder og den boligsociale leder. I fællesskab sikrer de den faglige retning, sparring, koordinering og forankring af indsatsen på tværs af kommunale og boligsociale samarbejder. Den daglige opgaveledelse varetages af den boligsociale leder på baggrund af løbende drøftelser og prioriteringer i et fælles ledelsesteam bestående af den boligsociale leder og den lokale klubs pædagogiske leder.

Stillingen giver stor frihed til at sætte dit eget præg på arbejdet. Vi søger derfor en medarbejder, der trives med at tage initiativ, arbejde selvstændigt, udvikle nye løsninger og omsætte idéer til konkrete aktiviteter og fællesskaber.

Arbejdet tager udgangspunkt i de tidspunkter, hvor børn og unge har fri. Derfor skal du være indstillet på fleksible arbejdstider, herunder eftermiddage, gennemsnitligt to eftermiddage aftener om ugen samt aktiviteter i skolernes ferieperioder og weekender.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Vi tilbyder en fast stilling som netværksskabende medarbejder, 37 timer/uge. Løn og ansættelsesvilkår vil være i henhold til gældende overenskomst med BUPL eller anden relevant overenskomst
Forventet tiltrædelse: 1. januar 2027 eller efter aftale.

Der vil blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest og ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at attesterne ikke viser, at du er uegnet/uværdig til stillingen. Du kan læse mere her om hvordan vi behandler dine oplysninger her.

Hvis du vil vide mere

Du kan få yderligere information om stillingen ved at kontakte:

Pædagogisk leder; Casper Øer, ocac@aarhus.dk, 23381258

Boligsocial leder Pernille Amir Shahi, 28926369, pernille@voresbydel.dk

Ansøgning

Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Ansøgningsfrist: den 8. november 2026.

Samtaler afholdes den 12. november 2026 mellem kl. 10.00-16.00.

Aarhus Kommune ser mangfoldighed som en styrke. Vi opfordrer derfor alle uanset alder, køn, religion, seksualitet og nationalitet til at søge.

Om os

UngiAarhus er en bydækkende organisation, der har ansvaret for fritidsklubber, ungdomsklubber, ungdomsskolen og de pædagogisk ledede legepladser i Aarhus Kommune. Vi samarbejder desuden med skolerne om de unges dannelse og uddannelse. Vores målgruppe er børn og unge fra fjerde klasse til 18 år (21 år for unge med særlige behov).

UngiAarhus er inddelt i tre søjler: ØST, VEST og BYDÆKKENDE OG TVÆRGÅENDE. Alle områder arbejder både lokalt og bydækkende. Du kan læse mere om UngiAarhus og om Aarhus Kommunes fritids- og ungdomsskoleplan her: www.ungiaarhus.dk
