title: Områdechef til Banedanmarks Trafikkontrolcentre
company: Banedanmark, Trafiktårn Øst, Carsten Niebuhrs Gade 49
description:
Vi søger en områdechef, der vil være ansvarlig for effektiv og punktlig trafikafvikling – også mens jernbanen gennemgår store forandringer.

Området Trafikkontrolcentre omfatter de to store trafikkontrolcentre i henholdsvis Øst- og Vestdanmark. Her samles trafikafviklingen i takt med at vores nye signalsystem udrulles. Frem til den fulde udrulning omfatter området også fjernstyringscentraler og kommandoposter på de strækninger, hvor trafikken afvikles med de traditionelle sikringsanlæg.

Som områdechef har du det overordnede ansvar for en kompleks, landsdækkende driftsleverance, og hvor den sikre, effektive og punktlige trafikafvikling er den vigtigste opgave. Du leder en organisation, der er på arbejde 24/7 alle årets dage, og du skal kunne sætte en tydelig driftsmæssig retning, prioritere under pres og sikre konsekvent opfølgning og eksekvering. Samtidig indgår du i et samarbejde med ledelsen i Banedanmark og med jernbanevirksomhederne, om at forankre beslutninger og koordinere tværgående processer i trafikafviklingen.

Driftsleder med jernbanetrafikal baggrund

Det er et krav, at du har trafikal erfaring fra jernbanen og dermed kendskab til de vilkår, prioriteringer og beslutninger, der præger den operative trafikafvikling. Du har interesse for kompleks driftsledelse og har solid erfaring med at lede gennem andre ledere.

Du har dokumenteret erfaring med at koordinere en døgnbemandet driftsorganisation og understøtte organisatorisk udvikling sammen med højt specialiserede fagpersoner.

Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund er ikke afgørende. Det afgørende er, at du med din trafikale erfaring og ledelsesmæssige tyngde kan skabe retning, stabilitet og fremdrift.

Du har gode kommunikations- og forhandlingsevner og behersker engelsk flydende i både tale og skrift.

Din nye arbejdsplads og kollegaer

Vi har et solidt fagligt miljø, hvor vi møder opgaverne og hinanden med godt humør og engagement.

Du refererer til trafikdirektøren og indgår i trafikdirektørens chefgruppe sammen med fire andre områdechefer. Her prioriterer vi videndeling og tværgående drøftelser højt og bruger aktivt hinanden til sparring om både den aktuelle drift og den langsigtede udvikling.

Som leder i Banedanmark investerer vi i din udvikling. Vi gennemfører løbende udviklingsforløb, hvor du vil møde ledere fra andre områder. Der er her mulighed for at netværke og erfaringsudveksle, og sikre et godt fællesskab omkring god ledelsespraksis.

Din nye arbejdsplads er i vores driftscenter ved Kalvebod Brygge i København, tæt på offentlig transport.

Løn

Som områdechef sker ansættelsen på åremål i løngruppe 1 efter rammeaftale om kontraktansættelse i staten. Lønnen fastsættes efter forhandling på baggrund af erfaringer og kvalifikationer jf. Cirkulære om rammeaftale om Kontraktansættelse af chefer i staten, som du finder her og Medarbejder- og Kompetencestyrelsens lønoversigt, som du finder her.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Vil du vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte trafikdirektør Peter Svendsen på telefon 41879990.

Har du spørgsmål til løn og overenskomst, er du velkommen til at kontakte vores HR-Konsulenter på mail banedanmarkpersonale@BANE.dk.

Send os gerne dit CV hurtigst muligt, da vi løbende vurderer CV’er og indkalder til samtaler.

For at søge stillingen klikker du på linket ”Søg stilling” og følger instruktionerne.

Forskellige perspektiver gør os stærkere. Derfor værdsætter Banedanmark mangfoldighed og opfordrer alle interesserede kandidater, uanset personlig baggrund, til at søge.

Går du videre fra de indledende samtaler, vil der blive indhentet referencer fra tidligere arbejdsgiver. Du vil blive informeret inden, at der bliver indhentet en reference.

title: Solution Architect Teamcenter
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Solution Architect Teamcenter based in Brazil.

Join a team of PLM and IT specialists dedicated to helping manufacturing organizations simplify complex engineering and business processes. As a Solution Architect specializing in Teamcenter, you will act as a trusted technical advisor, translating customer requirements into scalable Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) solutions. You will lead solution design, implementation planning, customization, migration, testing, and deployment across diverse industrial environments. Combining deep technical expertise with business process knowledge, you will help customers optimize their digital engineering ecosystems and integrate Teamcenter with CAD and ERP systems. You will also contribute to project leadership, coordinate international multidisciplinary teams, and guide customers through digital transformation initiatives. This opportunity offers long-term career development in a collaborative environment that values technical excellence, customer relationships, and sustainable professional growth.

Accountabilities:

You will serve as a key point of contact for customers on PLM solutions and project-related matters, ensuring that business requirements are translated into effective technical architectures and successful implementations. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Analyze customer requirements: Capture and evaluate business processes, identify operational needs, and translate requirements into comprehensive PLM solution concepts.

  • Design and present solutions: Develop, document, and present solution architectures, implementation approaches, and technical recommendations tailored to customer objectives.

  • Advise customers: Provide expert guidance on available solutions, implementation strategies, methodologies, and process improvements related to Teamcenter and PLM/PDM environments.

  • Estimate and plan projects: Assess technical effort, contribute to proposal preparation, define implementation approaches, and establish plans for Teamcenter deployments and customizations.

  • Lead solution implementation: Oversee or contribute directly to solution design, configuration, customization, migration, testing, and rollout activities.

  • Configure and customize Teamcenter: Implement customer-specific solutions, including server-side and client-side customizations, to address complex business and engineering requirements.

  • Manage integrations: Support Teamcenter integration with CAD and ERP systems to enable effective data exchange and connected engineering workflows.

  • Apply appropriate project methodologies: Use agile or traditional project management approaches to structure requirements, solution concepts, and technical specifications.

  • Coordinate project delivery: Participate in projects as a technical specialist or assume partial or overall project leadership responsibilities.

  • Lead multidisciplinary teams: Coordinate international and cross-functional stakeholders, ensuring alignment between technical teams, business representatives, and customers.

  • Resolve complex technical challenges: Apply detailed knowledge of Teamcenter's internal functionality and processes to recommend practical solutions and support successful implementation.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines extensive Teamcenter expertise with a strong understanding of PLM/PDM processes, solution architecture, and project delivery. You should be comfortable advising customers, translating complex requirements into technical solutions, and collaborating with international teams. The following qualifications and capabilities are expected:

    • Education: A completed degree or vocational qualification in computer science, mechanical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

    • PLM/PDM expertise: Strong knowledge of Product Lifecycle Management and Product Data Management processes, concepts, methodologies, and implementation practices.

    • Teamcenter experience: Extensive practical experience with Teamcenter architecture, functionality, configuration, and customization.

    • Server-side customization: Knowledge of BMIDE-based configuration and customization, including data models, workflows, and ITK/SOA services.

    • Client-side customization: Experience with both codeless and code-based customization for Active Workspace (AW) and Rich Application Client (RAC).

    • System integration: Experience integrating Teamcenter with CAD and ERP systems.

    • Technical problem-solving: Ability to understand Teamcenter's internal processes, assess complex technical requirements, and develop effective implementation solutions.

    • Project management: Demonstrated project experience, ideally including partial or full project leadership and familiarity with agile methodologies.

    • Communication and collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills, intercultural competence, and the ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary and international teams.

    • Language skills: Very good German proficiency and strong written and spoken English.

      • Benefits:

      • Long-term employment: Permanent employment contract offering professional stability.

      • Established work environment: Join a family-owned company with a long-standing presence in the PLM and manufacturing technology sector.

      • Collaborative team culture: Work in a supportive environment characterized by teamwork, mutual assistance, and knowledge sharing.

Are you looking for an emerging, AI-augmented hybrid role that combines the strategic vision of a product manager, the design sense of a UX designer, and the prototyping capability of a software engineer? We have that opportunity available in our AI Product Builder role.


We’re looking for our next bold leader – an AI Product Builder – to join our quest to provide market-transforming solutions for businesses, care teams and consumers to interactively manage health and care. This is a remote, US-based role reporting to the SVP of Product.


At Medecision, you’ll have the chance to work with people that have incredible intellect, who are hard-wired for problem-solving. You’ll also know that you’re making a real difference, and not just in some abstract, corporate-mission-statement kind of way. Vi mangler en elektriker til industri og erhverv i Ringkøbing.



Du lander i en større teknisk organisation, hvor opgaverne ligger i industri, erhverv, nybyg og renovering. Arbejdsområdet er Ringkøbing og omegn, og firmabilen er en del af pakken. Når opgaven ligger i industri eller erhverv, handler dagen om at få installationer, ændringer og fejl rettet ordentligt af. Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Vi forestiller os, at du:

title: Intern, Intake Unit (Summer 2027)
description:
Legal Aid DC, a nonprofit organization with an approximately $18 million annual budget and a staff of approximately 125 employees, is seeking a Summer Intern to join our Intake Unit.


Since 1932, Legal Aid has provided civil legal assistance to clients in individual cases and engaged in systemic reform. Currently, we provide individual representation in consumer law, domestic violence/family law, housing, public benefits, and immigration matters. We also help people with the collateral consequences of their involvement with the criminal justice system. From the experiences of our clients, we identify opportunities for law reform, public policy advocacy, and systemic impact and appellate litigation. Legal Aid also administers the DC Resource Bridge, a single access point for legal services in the District.


Legal Aid believes that meaningful pursuit of our anti-poverty mission requires an unwavering commitment to racial justice and equity. We aspire both to reflect the rich racial diversity of the communities we serve and to value, respect, and empower our staff and clients to be effective agents of change. For more information about Legal Aid please visit our website, .


Our work is supported through public and private grants and private fundraising from individuals, law firms, and other contributors.


Interns at Legal Aid DC have the unique opportunity to receive substantive assignments that will have an immediate impact on our clients. This internship is for Summer 2027 and will be 10 weeks in duration. Summer interns should expect to work full-time (40 hours per week). Interns mainly work out of Legal Aid’s NW DC office, with the option to perform some work remotely if approved by their supervisor. Summer interns may be required to perform duties off site, and will be required to travel locally for summer programming events.


The summer term is from May 27th through August 6th.


The Intake Intern will be part of the Intake Unit and assist in conducting and processing intakes received from Applicants. The Intake Intern will also assist with other tasks assigned by various staff across all of Legal Aid’s practice areas, including, but not limited to composing letters, review assigned court dockets for follow up action; file court documents electronically or in person, assist with document gathering and organization, request interpreters for scheduled meetings, and request document translations through third party provider and provide support to various outreach partnership events. The Intake Intern will be expected to be able to work independently; however, support and supervision will be provided by the Intake Program Director and a member of the Intake Unit.


Responsibilities:

  • Provide client intake support by receiving and processing inquiries and requests for assistance across all of Legal Aid’s practice areas.
  • Provide administrative and operational support across all of Legal Aid’s practice areas.
  • Assist in developing Intake material for internal use.
  • Interact with clients, witnesses, and experts to gather information and provide support as needed.
  • Collaborate with staff from across all Legal Aid’s practice areas.

Scholarship Funding:


Legal Aid DC can provide scholarship funding to ensure that summer law students receive no less than $6,440 per summer, including scholarships from the Lee Horton Memorial Scholarship for Aspiring Public Interest Lawyers.


Summer law students are required to apply for outside funding to fund their internships in order to receive supplemental scholarship funding. We will provide a scholarship of up to $6,440 to summer law school interns when:

  • They attend a school that does not provide funding OR they are not approved for at least $6,440 of funding from their schools

AND

  • They do not get funding from any other outside sources that gets them to total funding of $6,440 for the summer

Example: if a student receives $5,000 of outside funding, Legal Aid will pay them $1,440 in scholarship funding.


Students may waive funding if they are prohibited from receiving renumeration by their law school.


To Apply:


Legal Aid values an inclusive, diverse workplace and encourages applications from interested persons from diverse backgrounds of any race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, personal appearance, family responsibilities, matriculation, political affiliation, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.


We strongly encourage applications from people with personal experience with the criminal justice system and/or with lived experiences in the communities we serve.


Submit your application, cover letter, resume, writing sample and transcript or letter of matriculation here. Applications will be accepted until 5:00 pm EST October 23, 2026.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Manager based in India.

In this role, you will drive product strategy, shape roadmaps, and oversee the development of innovative technology solutions that address evolving customer and business needs. You will work at the intersection of business strategy, customer experience, and technology, translating complex requirements into clear product priorities and actionable plans. Collaborating with engineering, design, and business stakeholders, you will guide cross-functional teams from product discovery and planning through delivery, launch, and continuous improvement. You will use market insights, customer feedback, and performance metrics to make informed decisions and measure product success. You will also champion modern product development practices, including Agile methodologies and AI-powered tools, to improve efficiency and accelerate innovation. This opportunity is ideal for an experienced product leader who combines strategic thinking, analytical rigor, and strong stakeholder management to deliver measurable business outcomes in a collaborative, remote-first environment.

Accountabilities

  • Define and execute product strategies and roadmaps aligned with business objectives, customer needs, and long-term organizational priorities.
  • Lead product discovery by gathering customer insights, conducting market research, analyzing competitive trends, and identifying opportunities for innovation and differentiation.
  • Translate business goals and customer requirements into clear product specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized development backlogs.
  • Collaborate with engineering, design, marketing, and other cross-functional teams to plan, develop, launch, and continuously improve product capabilities.
  • Own the product lifecycle from ideation and opportunity assessment through development, launch, post-launch monitoring, and ongoing optimization.
  • Establish and track product success metrics, evaluate performance data, and use customer feedback and analytical insights to inform product decisions.
  • Prioritize product initiatives based on customer value, business impact, technical feasibility, available resources, and strategic objectives.
  • Facilitate stakeholder discussions, align expectations, communicate product priorities, and resolve competing requirements across business and technical teams.
  • Support Agile and Scrum practices, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, iterative delivery, and continuous improvement.
  • Develop and maintain product documentation, including product briefs, roadmaps, requirements, release notes, and other materials needed to support effective execution.
  • Leverage AI-powered tools to streamline product discovery, accelerate documentation, develop prototypes, and improve product planning and validation.
  • Identify product risks, dependencies, and implementation challenges early, working with relevant teams to develop practical solutions and maintain delivery momentum.
  • Champion a customer-centric, outcome-oriented product culture that emphasizes measurable results, continuous learning, and effective collaboration.

Requirements

  • Significant professional experience in product management, preferably in enterprise software, SaaS, or technology-driven environments, with a track record of delivering successful products.
  • Strong understanding of product strategy, roadmap development, product discovery, market research, customer needs analysis, and lifecycle management.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex business problems into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and actionable development priorities.
  • Solid knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Agile principles, Scrum methodologies, and cross-functional product delivery practices.
  • Experience collaborating with engineering, design, business, and other stakeholders to deliver products that balance customer needs, business objectives, and technical constraints.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to define success metrics, interpret product performance data, and evaluate business impact.
  • Experience using customer feedback, market intelligence, and competitive analysis to identify product opportunities and guide prioritization decisions.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered tools for product management, including generating product briefs, supporting documentation, and creating prototypes to validate ideas.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders, articulate product vision, and communicate priorities effectively.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities, including the ability to build alignment, navigate ambiguity, and drive decisions without relying solely on formal authority.
  • Excellent organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and maintain focus on measurable outcomes.
  • A customer-focused mindset, combined with strategic thinking, adaptability, ownership, and a commitment to continuous improvement.
  • Experience launching new products from concept to market, managing complex product portfolios, or leading zero-to-one initiatives is an advantage.
  • An MBA or other relevant advanced qualification may be beneficial.
  • Experience in real estate technology, financial services, title insurance, mortgage solutions, or related enterprise domains is an additional advantage.

Benefits

  • Remote working: Opportunity to work remotely from India in a full-time position.
  • Competitive compensation: Salary aligned with experience, responsibilities, and the overall employment package.
  • Professional development: Opportunities to strengthen product strategy, leadership, and technical product management expertise.
  • Strategic ownership: Contribute to product vision, roadmap decisions, and initiatives that influence customer experience and business performance.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with engineering, design, and business teams to bring innovative solutions to market.
  • Technology-driven environment: Gain exposure to modern software platforms, AI-enabled product development, and evolving enterprise technology solutions.
  • Meaningful impact: Help shape products that address real customer challenges and deliver measurable business value.
  • Continuous learning: Develop expertise in product discovery, Agile delivery, product analytics, and lifecycle optimization.
  • Inclusive workplace: Join a professional environment that values diversity, respect, collaboration, and equal employment opportunities.

title: Inköpare
company: Verksamhetsstöd, Enheten för inköp och upphandling
description:
Har du kompetens inom inköp och drivs av att nå mål? Som inköpare på Skolverket blir du en viktig rådgivare och uppdragsledare för våra beställare, med möjlighet att utvecklas i ett spännande och mångsidigt arbete. Var med och bidra till skolans framtid!

Om jobbet

Som inköpare genomför och stöttar du alla former av inköpsaktiviteter i nära samverkan med beställare i verksamheten. I rollen arbetar du för att uppnå ökad verksamhetsnytta och affärsmässighet för Skolverket och i förlängningen för myndighetens målgrupper. Du agerar som uppdragsledare genom att stödja beställare genom hela inköpsprocessen och driva uppdraget i mål. Som inköpare arbetar du med direktupphandlingar, avrop och upphandlingar. I just denna roll har du fokus på inköp av it, men du arbetar även med andra inköpskategorier över tid.

Vidare är din roll att stödja och utveckla externa samarbeten med leverantörer och andra statliga myndigheter med fokus på affärsmässighet, förhandlingar, leverantörsstyrning och avtalsuppföljning. Att proaktivt ge råd och stöd till myndighetens beställare och ibland utbilda internt inom området ingår också i rollen.

Du tillhör enheten Inköp och upphandling som består av ca 15 medarbetare. Vi arbetar kategoribaserat med våra inköp och enheten är indelad i tre grupper som fokuserar på IT & konsulter, varor & tjänster samt tjänster för skola & överenskommelser. I grupperna ingår inköpare tillsammans med upphandlare som har kategoriledarroll. Utöver det så har vi specialistroller som upphandlingsjurist, inköpscontroller och inköpsadministratör.

Här kan du läsa en intervju med Louise som jobbar som inköpare på enheten: www.skolverket.se/jobb-Louise

* * * * *

”Skolverket har en central roll i reformerna av svensk skola. I detta arbete är det nödvändigt med flera stora inköpsuppdrag. Därför behöver vi förstärka vårt team med ytterligare en inköpare för att kunna möta ökad efterfrågan på våra tjänster i myndigheten. Välkommen till ett bra team som arbetar tillsammans för att nå detta mål.”

Peter Norén, inköpschef

* * * * *

Du arbetar på vårt moderna och rymliga kontor i Solna Business Park. Du kan också ha möjlighet att arbeta upp till 50 procent på distans.

Om dig

För att göra ett bra jobb och trivas hos oss behöver du stå för och leva upp till den statliga värdegrunden och till våra kärnvärden för medarbetarskap: förebild, tillit, ansvar, samarbete och utveckling. Läs mer på www.skolverket.se/jobb

För det här jobbet ska du ha

  • eftergymnasial utbildning inom inköp och upphandling,
  • aktuell flerårig erfarenhet av arbete med inköp som exempelvis konkurrensutsättning och avtalshantering,
  • aktuell erfarenhet av att arbeta med moderna upphandlingssystem som används i svensk offentlig sektor,
  • mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av arbete med inköp av it-tjänster, antingen i rollen som inköpare eller från arbete på it-avdelning. Det är även meriterande om du har erfarenhet av arbete som inköpare/upphandlare inom LOU samt att du arbetat i en statlig myndighet.

Som person behöver du

  • vara kommunikativ och säkerställa att ditt budskap når fram till mottagaren,
  • sätta högsta prioritet på att uppnå mål och få arbetet slutfört på ett strukturerat sätt, med fokus på beställarens och myndighetens behov,
  • ha ett affärsmässigt tänkande och visa det genom att fokusera energi och resurser på projekt och uppgifter som genererar mervärde,
  • god förmåga att utveckla ett förtroendefullt samarbete och goda relationer med alla olika delar av myndigheten.

Viktigt att veta

Sista ansökningsdag är 2 nov. Anställningen är tillsvidare och inleds med provanställning i sex månader.

När du registrerar din ansökan får du svara på några frågor i stället för att bifoga ett personligt brev. Läs gärna igenom ansökningsformuläret och förbered dina svar innan du gör ansökan.

Läs mer om hur vår rekryteringsprocess går till under Att söka jobb hos oss på www.skolverket.se/lediga-jobb.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Skolverket arbetar för att alla barn och elever ska få en bra och likvärdig utbildning i en trygg miljö. Vi stödjer på olika sätt den svenska förskolan, skolan och komvux. Som medarbetare på Skolverket är du med och bidrar till att skapa goda förutsättningar för barns och elevers utveckling och lärande. Lär känna oss bättre genom att besöka vår webbplats www.skolverket.se/jobb. Vårt uppdrag – skolans framtid.

title: Socialpædagog? Vi har brug for din erfaring!
description:
Er du socialpædagog – og klar til nye muligheder?

Vi søger flere socialpædagoger til Helhedstilbuddet Siriusparken i Odsherred Kommune.

Hvorfor vælge Siriusparken? Fordi du her får mulighed for at bruge din faglighed i praksis, præge hverdagen og udvikle nye løsninger sammen med dygtige kolleger.

Du bliver en del af et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor vi deler viden, sparrer med hinanden og udvikler os sammen.

Vi bruger aktivt vores værksteder, sansehave og sanserum i hverdagen og arbejder blandt andet med musikterapi, neuropædagogik og kommunikationsteknologi.

Her er der plads til dine erfaringer og idéer – og mulighed for at omsætte dem til konkrete aktiviteter og pædagogiske indsatser, der gør en forskel for borgerne.

Vi søger dig, der har erfaring fra socialområdet, og som sammen med dine kolleger vil gøre en forskel.

Er du nysgerrig på, om Helhedstilbuddet Siriusparken kunne være dit næste skridt?

Hold dig ikke tilbage – ring og få en snak med Mathias på +45 24 45 66 38.

Om rekrutteringsprocessen

Norima er Odsherred Kommunes samarbejdspartner i rekrutteringen af nye medarbejdere til Helhedstilbuddet Siriusparken. Norima står for at finde og kontakte relevante kandidater, gennemføre de indledende samtaler og præsentere kvalificerede kandidater. Den endelige ansættelsesbeslutning træffes af Odsherred Kommune.

title: Dygtig økonom til analyser og udvikling af økonomisk regulering på affaldsområdet
description:
Vil du være en del af et fagligt stærkt miljø, hvor du får mulighed for at arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem økonomi og jura? Er du på udkig efter et arbejde med faglig tyngde og ansvar samt gode udviklingsmuligheder? Kunne du tænke dig, at bidrage til den grønne omstilling? Så har du mulighed for at blive en del af fællesskabet i Danmarks stærke og uafhængige tilsynsmyndighed – Forsyningstilsynet.

Vores arbejde Du bliver en del af Center for AFFALD, som blev etableret i Forsyningstilsynet i 2022, hvor du får 10 engagerede kolleger, der primært er økonomer og jurister. Vi arbejder med udvikling og implementering af ny økonomisk regulering samt analyser og tilsyn inden for affalds- og genanvendelsessektoren.

Affaldsområdet er under fortsat udvikling med en voksende opgaveportefølje, og du vil få et arbejde med direkte betydning for de danske husholdninger og erhverv samt for den grønne omstilling. Affald skal i fremtiden i højere grad være en ressource, der genanvendes, og udviklingen af affaldssektoren er afgørende for en effektiv udnyttelse af vores ressourcer og en bæredygtig fremtid. Affalds- og genanvendelsesområdet er i hastig forandring, og vores regulering har derfor stor og fortsat stigende betydning for vores interessenter og sektoren som helhed.

Dine opgaver Du vil blive tilknyttet vores team, som overvåger den økonomiske udvikling i affaldssektoren og er tæt på implementering af ny økonomisk regulering i sektoren, men dine konkrete opgaver og ansvar vil blive tilpasset til din profil. I teamet samarbejder vi om opgaver inden for blandt andet:

  • bidrag til udvikling og implementering af økonomisk regulering på affaldsområdet, herunder vurdering af hensigtsmæssige regulatoriske metoder og modeller

  • bidrag til analyserapporter

  • bidrag til inddragelse af relevant teori, data og metode i vores opgaveløsning

Vi sørger for din oplæring i dine konkrete opgaver, og via vores onboardingprogram bliver din egen faglighed suppleret med introduktion til hele energiområdet.

Vi løser vores opgaver i tæt dialog og samarbejde med de lovgivende myndigheder på området samt interesseorganisationer, kommuner og forsyningsvirksomheder. Efter nogle år hos os har du et stort netværk, du er en dygtig og attraktiv specialist inden for regulering af forsyningssektorer, og du vil have dyb indsigt i affalds- og energibranchen.

Om dig Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • er uddannet økonom f.eks. cand.polit., cand.oecon., cand.scient.oecon., cand.merc., cand.merc.(mat), eller lignende samfundsfaglig uddannelse med specialisering inden for økonomi, f.eks. cand.scient.pol. eller cand.scient.adm.
  • har stærke analytiske evner og kan lide at arbejde systematisk og struktureret
  • er nysgerrig og har lyst til at sætte dig ind i nye problemstillinger
  • trives med at samarbejde med andre faggrupper i krydsfeltet mellem økonomi, jura og politik
  • er ansvarsbevidst, tager initiativ og har fokus på resultater – både i forhold til at starte og afslutte opgaver
  • kan indgå i samarbejder med kolleger, men kan også arbejde selvstændigt
  • er en dygtig formidler – både skriftligt og mundtligt.
Erfaring fra offentlig administration, økonomisk regulering, konsulentbranchen eller selskaber inden for forsyningssektoren vil være en fordel, men det er ikke et krav, da vi i høj grad selv sørger for oplæring.

Socialt arbejdsmiljø med fokus på faglig udvikling, trivsel og arbejdsglæde I Forsyningstilsynet bliver du en del af en organisation, hvor der er kort til beslutningerne. Vi har en uformel tone og lægger vægt på holdånd og at være gode kollegaer for hinanden. Vi har fokus på arbejdsglæde og udviklingsmuligheder for den enkelte. Det er vigtigt for os, at du får de bedste muligheder for at anvende dine faglige kompetencer og udbygge din viden. Derfor tilbyder vi både interne og eksterne kurser, evt. suppleret med kursusophold i udlandet.

Vi bor i flotte, renoverede lokaler i Frederiksværk, tæt på skoven, hvor der er gode muligheder for en walk and talk eller en løbetur. Vi har en dejlig have med WI-FI og et træningsrum. Der kører dagligt en medarbejderbus direkte fra København (Nørrebro St.) til din nye arbejdsplads.

Du vil i det daglige opleve en stor grad af frihed og fleksibilitet, som er med til at sikre en god balance mellem arbejde og fritid. Vi er en familievenlig arbejdsplads og du får bl.a. mulighed for hjemmearbejde og for at arbejde under transport.

Du kan læse mere om vores arbejde på og bl.a. se videoklip med tre af dine kommende kolleger på www.forsyningstilsynet.dk/job. På samme side er der en oversigt over vores onboardingprogram, samt oplysninger om mulighederne for kompetence- og karriereudvikling i Forsyningstilsynet.

Interesseret? Vil du høre mere om stillingen, så kontakt gerne Michael Højer på mish@forsyningstilsynet.dk eller på telefon 4171 5377.

Søg stillingen gennem linket her på siden. Husk at vedhæfte relevante dokumenter, herunder en motiveret ansøgning, cv og eksamensbeviser og karakterudskrifter for både bachelor- og kandidatuddannelse.

Ansøgningsfrist: 12. november.

Der indkaldes løbende til samtaler, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Der kan indgå brug af test i rekrutteringsprocessen. Tiltrædelse efter aftale.

Ansættelse sker efter den til enhver tid gældende overenskomst for akademikere i staten. Du vil blive ansat som fuldmægtig eller specialkonsulent ud fra en samlet vurdering af de kompetencer og erfaringer, du har i forhold til stillingens indhold.

Forsyningstilsynet ønsker at fremme ligestilling og mangfoldighed. Vi opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede kandidater til at søge stillingen, uanset køn, alder og etnisk baggrund.

title: Senior Operations Generalist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Operations Generalist based in France.

The Senior Operations Generalist will play a key role in ensuring smooth, efficient operations within a globally distributed organization working across the private markets ecosystem. In this remote position, you will oversee essential administrative, financial, and project coordination workflows while supporting leadership and enabling teams to collaborate effectively across time zones. You will manage day-to-day processes, coordinate meetings and communications, maintain accurate financial records, and contribute to recruitment and onboarding activities. You will also conduct research to support partnerships, sponsorships, and collaborative events. Beyond execution, you will help maintain high operational standards by improving handovers, ensuring consistent reporting, and mentoring junior team members. This opportunity is ideal for an organized, proactive professional who thrives in an international environment and enjoys combining hands-on operations with process improvement and team development.

Accountabilities

  • Oversee daily operational workflows across CRM systems, finance, and internal coordination to ensure business activities run efficiently.

  • Manage global calendars, schedule meetings, and coordinate communications across teams operating in different time zones.

  • Track and organize invoices, receipts, and expense reports across departments, maintaining accurate and reliable records.

  • Support recruitment and onboarding processes, helping new team members integrate smoothly into the organization.

  • Conduct research into sponsorship opportunities, potential partnerships, and event co-hosting initiatives.

  • Maintain clear, timely daily reporting and high-quality handovers through Slack to support continuity and effective collaboration.

  • Coordinate administrative and project-related tasks, ensuring priorities are tracked and deadlines are met.

  • Mentor junior generalists, promote consistent ways of working, and contribute to continuous operational improvement.

  • Support leadership directly with operational execution, organization, and coordination of key initiatives.

    • Requirements

    • At least 3 years of experience in remote operations, administration, project coordination, or a related field.

    • Strong English proficiency, with a minimum B2 level; C1 proficiency is preferred.

    • Proficiency in Google Workspace, including Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Drive, as well as Slack.

    • Exceptional attention to detail, organizational skills, and time management.

    • Ability to manage multiple workflows, prioritize competing tasks, and deliver accurate work within deadlines.

    • Demonstrated independence and reliability when working remotely with colleagues across different time zones.

    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across teams and functions.

    • A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and willingness to take ownership of operational processes.

    • Ability to provide guidance to junior colleagues and contribute to consistent team standards.

    • Location requirement: Applicants must currently be based in Poland, the Philippines, or Latin America to be considered for this position.

      • Benefits

      • Monthly compensation of $1,800–$2,100 USD, depending on experience.

      • Permanent employment opportunity.

      • Fully remote work with international collaboration and flexibility across time zones.

      • Opportunity to join a global team working to transform the private markets ecosystem.

      • Professional growth opportunities, including potential progression into leadership and process optimization responsibilities.

title: Product Line Manager, Emphasys HFA
description:
Location: Pembroke Pines,Florida,United States

We are excited to speak to you about this opportunity. If you are interested in joining our growing team, please apply to this link directly.

Who we are

Aquila, a group within Constellation Software Inc., one of North America’s largest and most respected software companies, invests in category-defining B2B and B2G software businesses globally, providing long-term support and strategic guidance. Emphasys Software has been part of Aquila since 2008.

Operating across five specialized divisions, Emphasys provides mission-critical software that modernizes and streamlines complex processes for housing authorities, lenders, and government agencies in nearly every state. Through both products and services, Emphasys helps house roughly half of the families most in need in the country.

At Emphasys HFA, a division of Emphasys, we develop and support industry-leading software designed specifically for Public Housing Authorities across the United States. As a trusted provider in the affordable housing sector, our solutions help PHAs efficiently manage operations, ensure regulatory compliance, and deliver critical housing services to families and individuals in need. From applicant intake to rent calculations and unit inspections, our platform supports the full lifecycle of public housing programs—empowering agencies to focus on their mission of providing safe, stable, and affordable housing.

Who we need

Reporting to the Head of Operations, we are hiring a Product Line Manager, Single Family, to join Emphasys HFA, an Aquila company. As our new Product Line Manager, you will oversee the strategy, roadmap, development, and ongoing evolution of our Single Family mortgage lending software solutions, supporting the full lending lifecycle from loan origination through portfolio management. You will lead the modernization of our product line, balancing the ongoing support of legacy applications with the migration and adoption of our newer Microsoft .NET platform and the introduction of AI-powered capabilities. Working closely with clients, Development, Implementation, and Client Services teams, you will translate business needs, industry requirements, and client feedback into product enhancements, manage critical client escalations, and ensure our solutions continue to meet the evolving needs of housing finance agencies and lending partners.

This is a remote role open to candidates based anywhere in the United States or Canada.

What’s in it for you

Ownership and influence. You will take ownership of an established Single Family mortgage lending product line, influencing its strategy, roadmap, and future direction. You will have the opportunity to shape product priorities, work directly with clients and internal teams, and make decisions that improve how housing finance agencies and lending partners manage their lending operations.

Modernization and innovation. You will play a central role in transforming an established product portfolio, helping clients transition from legacy systems to a modern Microsoft .NET platform while expanding AI-powered capabilities. From enhancing existing solutions to contributing to new product development initiatives, you will have the opportunity to bring ideas to life and see their impact on how clients work.

Breadth and impact. You will work across the full product lifecycle, combining strategic product management with hands-on product ownership, client engagement, and delivery. You will collaborate with Development, Implementation, Business Development, and Client Services teams, gaining broad exposure to the business while building relationships with housing finance agencies and lending partners. Your work will directly influence product adoption, client satisfaction, and the continued evolution of the Single Family product line.

As our new Product Line Manager, you will:

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap. You will lead the direction and ongoing evolution of our Single Family mortgage lending product line, supporting the full lifecycle from loan origination through portfolio management and servicing. You will translate client needs, industry trends, regulatory requirements, and business opportunities into product priorities, enhancements, and new solutions.
  • Drive product modernization. You will oversee the ongoing support of legacy COBOL applications while driving client migration and adoption of our modern Microsoft .NET platform. You will work closely with Development, Implementation, and Client Services teams to prioritize enhancements, coordinate releases, and ensure a smooth transition for clients.
  • Advance AI and product innovation. You will identify opportunities to expand AI-powered capabilities within the Lender Portal, including intelligent document ingestion and processing, to improve efficiency and the client experience. You will contribute to new product initiatives, translating ideas and client requirements into practical solutions, prototypes, and product features.
  • Lead product development and delivery. You will work closely with Development teams to define requirements, guide system design, prioritize enhancements, and oversee delivery timelines and releases. Combining product management with hands-on product ownership, you will ensure solutions meet client expectations, security standards, and industry requirements.
  • Build and strengthen client relationships. You will partner directly with housing finance agencies, lenders, and other stakeholders to understand their needs, gather feedback, and identify opportunities to improve our solutions. You will take ownership of critical client escalations, coordinate resolutions across teams, and communicate clearly throughout the process to maintain trust and satisfaction.
  • Support business growth and market opportunities. You will collaborate with Business Development, Sales, and Marketing teams on product demonstrations and showcases for prospective and existing clients, RFP responses, and solution development. You will clearly communicate product capabilities, demonstrate how our solutions address client needs, and support business development opportunities. You will stay informed about mortgage lending trends, competitors, and emerging market needs, identifying opportunities to strengthen our offerings and expand into new markets.

You bring:

  • The mortgage lending expertise. You have deep knowledge of the Single Family mortgage lending industry, including loan origination systems (LOS), underwriting, eligibility, loan reservations, and closing processes. You understand loan servicing and portfolio management, including payment processing, delinquency management, and investor reporting. You are familiar with the requirements of housing finance agencies, lenders, and mortgage assistance programs, including first mortgage and down payment assistance programs.
  • The product management experience. You have experience managing externally facing software products, ideally within mortgage lending technology, where client needs, product performance, and delivery timelines are critical. You can translate complex business requirements into product roadmaps, define priorities, and work closely with Development and Implementation teams to deliver enhancements and new capabilities. You are comfortable balancing strategic product direction with hands-on product ownership.
  • The AI and technical capabilities. You have experience bringing AI-powered features into production, from identifying practical use cases and defining requirements to collaborating with developers on implementation and deployment. You can create prototypes or mockups to validate ideas and understand how technology can improve lending workflows. You are comfortable working with technical teams to guide product design, troubleshoot issues, and support platform modernization.
  • The industry and analytical knowledge. You understand mortgage lending regulations, compliance requirements, and industry standards, including those associated with Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, and Ginnie Mae. You are familiar with mortgage data standards and formats such as URLA, ULDD, and MISMO, and can translate industry requirements into product specifications. You bring strong analytical skills, including advanced Excel capabilities, to interpret lending and portfolio data and inform product decisions.
  • The client relationship skills. You have experience working directly with external clients, building trusted relationships, understanding their needs, and navigating complex or time-sensitive issues. You can manage escalations calmly, communicate technical challenges and resolutions clearly, and balance client expectations with product priorities. You are confident showcasing software products and conducting product demonstrations for prospective and existing clients, clearly communicating product capabilities, benefits, and solutions in a way that addresses their business needs. You can also present recommendations and complex concepts effectively to executives and cross-functional teams.
  • The ability to connect strategy and execution. You can manage competing priorities across existing products, modernization initiatives, and new development projects. You bring critical thinking, sound judgment, and a proactive approach to problem-solving. You can turn client feedback and industry insights into practical product improvements while keeping stakeholders informed and projects moving forward.

Join us.

As an Aquila company, Emphasys Software brings together bright, talented people who aspire to excellence and share a commitment to upholding our mission: To be a company of outstanding people delivering vertical market software solutions through long-term partnerships with clients.

Our entrepreneurial culture, lean environment, and people come together to form a dynamic organization where purpose drives our growth. With the autonomy to be creative and curious, we collaborate and iterate to achieve real impact in the communities we support.

Apply now.

Diversity and inclusion are not mere words on paper to us. We welcome and appreciate candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences. If you have 70% of the qualifications we are looking for and want to play an integral role in changing an industry, apply to express your interest.

What you can expect from our interview process:

  • A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining the company and in the role. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
  • An interview with the Head of Operations to discuss your mortgage lending domain expertise, technical understanding, experience managing client relationships, and approach to resolving complex client challenges. This interview will last approximately one hour and may include a Product Leader.
  • An interview with a Product Leader to explore your product management approach, strategic thinking, experience delivering AI-powered product capabilities, and ability to navigate complex client scenarios.

Aquila and Emphasys Software promote equal employment opportunities for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status, marital status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. title: Junior Backend Engineer
description:
Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

Job Summary

The Junior Backend Engineer will contribute to the development, testing, and maintenance of reliable backend services and APIs for the V-Thru platform. The role will work under the guidance of senior engineers to deliver well-scoped software that meets quality, security, and performance standards while continuously developing technical skills, knowledge, and ownership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implement assigned features, enhancements, and bug fixes across any product domain within the backend, adhering to established coding conventions.
  • Develop and maintain REST APIs and backend services under the direction of senior engineers.
  • Work with the platform's data and infrastructure stack — MySQL, MongoDB, Redis (caching), RabbitMQ (async messaging), and Docker-based local development — using Doctrine ORM/ODM where applicable.
  • Write unit and integration tests for all delivered code; treat test coverage as a completion criterion.
  • Write code that is maintainable, readable, and easy to extend.
  • Debug reported issues by reproducing, identifying root cause, resolving, and adding regression coverage.
  • Address feedback from code reviews and static analysis promptly.
  • Adhere to the team's engineering standards and conventions (code style, type safety, exception handling, database access, caching, testing, security, and data privacy).
  • Follow established security, privacy, and secure-coding practices when handling customer and business data.
  • Foundational computer-science knowledge — data structures, algorithms, and basic complexity — sufficient to implement well-scoped tasks correctly.
  • Understanding of the software development lifecycle: writing, testing, reviewing, and shipping code.
  • Awareness of common design patterns and core programming principles (e.g., separation of concerns, DRY, SOLID) — able to work within them when applied by the team.
  • Comfort with at least one programming paradigm (object-oriented or functional) and demonstrated ability to learn unfamiliar languages, frameworks, and technologies quickly.
  • Basic familiarity with databases and data modeling (relational and/or NoSQL).
  • Working knowledge of version control (Git), APIs, and automated testing as everyday practices.
  • Fast learner — picks up unfamiliar languages, tools, and codebases quickly with guidance.
  • Good problem solver — breaks problems into manageable pieces and works toward the root cause.
  • Curious — takes interest in how and why systems work.
  • Adaptable — comfortable with changing tools, paradigms, and requirements.
  • Coachable — receptive to feedback and quick to apply it.
  • Detail-oriented and disciplined about quality and standards.
  • Clear written and verbal communication in English.
  • Ownership and accountability for assigned work.

Preferred Qualifications (Non-Essential) Competencies

  • Experience with programming language such as Php or Python.
  • Experience with a modern web framework (e.g., Symfony, Laravel, Django, Rails, Spring).
  • Exposure to Docker and containerized development.
  • Familiarity with NoSQL (MongoDB), caching (Redis), or message queues (RabbitMQ).

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • Equivalent practical experience may also be considered.

Experience

  • 0–2 years of software development experience.

title: Construction Project Manager
description:
The Construction Project Manager will oversee the planning and execution of Buck Mason’s retail construction, remodels, renovations, and other construction-related projects. This person will work closely with the Director of Store Construction, architects, general contractors, vendors, landlords, and internal teams to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to Buck Mason’s standards.
The ideal candidate is organized, hands-on, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple projects at once. You know how to keep things moving, communicate clearly, and catch issues before they become bigger problems.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage retail construction projects from initial planning and pre-construction through completion and turnover.
  • Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, and key milestones.
  • Coordinate with architects, engineers, general contractors, subcontractors, and vendors.
  • Review construction plans, drawings, specifications, and project documents.
  • Conduct regular site visits to monitor construction progress, quality, and adherence to project plans.
  • Track project timelines and identify potential delays or issues before they impact the project.
  • Manage project budgets, purchase orders, invoices, and change orders.
  • Review contractor bids, estimates, and proposals.
  • Partner with the Director of Store Construction to evaluate project costs and make informed decisions.
  • Ensure construction projects are completed on time, within budget, and to Buck Mason’s standards.
  • Partner with Retail, Operations, Finance, Design, and other internal teams to coordinate project needs and timelines.
  • Communicate project updates, milestones, and challenges to key stakeholders.
  • Coordinate with landlords, property managers, and building representatives as needed.
  • Oversee project closeout, including final inspections, punch lists, and outstanding construction items.
  • Maintain project documentation, warranties, and relevant records.
  • Support store openings, remodels, renovations, and other construction-related initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve construction processes and project execution.
  • Ensure projects are completed safely and in accordance with applicable requirements

Required Skills:

  • 5+ years of experience in construction project management, preferably in retail, commercial, or hospitality construction.
  • Proven experience managing construction projects from pre-construction through completion.
  • Strong knowledge of construction processes, project scheduling, budgeting, and contractor management.
  • Experience working with general contractors, subcontractors, architects, engineers, and vendors.
  • Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, plans, and specifications.
  • Strong project management, organizational, and time management skills.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail, follow-through, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience managing project budgets, invoices, change orders, and contractor estimates.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Excel, and project management software.
  • Ability to conduct site visits and travel to retail locations and construction sites as needed.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Knowledge of construction safety standards, permitting, and inspection processes.
  • A proactive, hands-on approach to managing projects and resolving challenges
Buck Mason designs updated, modern American classics for daily wear. Founded in 2013 by Sasha Koehn and Erik Allen, who were neighbors in Venice, California, they initially set up shop in a 350 square foot garage off Abbot Kinney Boulevard. Using old school manufacturing techniques combined with modern technology, they took an architectural approach to the product with the goal of making fashion less complicated, building each piece to last beyond a single season.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Infrastructure
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer – Data Infrastructure based in the United States.

Join a data infrastructure team responsible for the foundational systems powering large-scale cloud storage and backup services. In this senior engineering role, you will design and build automation, observability, and system health capabilities that improve reliability, durability, and performance across a fleet of thousands of servers. You will help engineers provision, configure, and repair infrastructure independently while developing tools that identify issues before they become incidents. Working across services and teams, you will lead technical design discussions, deliver complex projects from conception through rollout, and turn operational challenges into scalable engineering solutions. This remote opportunity is ideal for an experienced backend engineer who enjoys solving ambiguous systems problems, improving infrastructure at scale, and making a lasting impact on platform reliability.

Accountabilities

  • Design and develop automation frameworks that enable engineers to provision, configure, and repair fleet infrastructure independently.

  • Extend and improve observability systems across metrics, logs, traces, and alerts to monitor platform health and identify degradation.

  • Build reporting tools, dashboards, and visualizations that provide clear insights into fleet health, capacity, and operational trends.

  • Develop system health tooling to detect hardware failures, configuration drift, and capacity risks before they lead to incidents.

  • Lead technical design discussions and create clear design documentation for changes spanning multiple services and engineering teams.

  • Drive large-scale feature implementation from initial design through deployment, including migrations, data backfills, and rollout planning.

  • Collaborate with on-call engineers to identify recurring operational work and incident patterns, converting findings into automation and improved monitoring.

  • Identify opportunities to improve system throughput, reliability, and operational efficiency across the infrastructure platform.

    • Requirements

    • At least 7 years of backend development experience in an enterprise environment using an object-oriented or systems programming language such as Java, Rust, C++, C#, or Go.

    • Proven experience designing automation frameworks or platforms that other engineers rely on.

    • Experience building and operating large-scale software systems distributed across thousands of servers.

    • A track record of developing internal platform services, operational tooling, or deployment and configuration pipelines used by engineering teams.

    • Working knowledge of observability technologies such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK, Datadog, or equivalent, including service instrumentation and actionable alert design.

    • Strong Linux fundamentals and experience working in bare-metal or hybrid infrastructure environments rather than relying exclusively on fully managed cloud services.

    • Professional experience incorporating AI-assisted development tools such as Gemini, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar into engineering workflows.

    • Familiarity with the full software development lifecycle, including architecture and design, implementation, testing, deployment, and rollout.

    • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the curiosity to understand complex problems before proposing solutions.

    • Clear, proactive communication skills in a remote working environment, including keeping teammates informed, identifying blockers early, and maintaining progress.

    • A collaborative, adaptable mindset, strong attention to detail, commitment to engineering best practices, and willingness to contribute in a fast-paced company environment.

    • Excellent troubleshooting, interpersonal, and written and verbal communication skills.

      • Additional experience that would be an advantage:

      • Proficiency in Java.

      • Familiarity with configuration management or infrastructure-as-code tools such as Ansible, Salt, Puppet, Chef, or Terraform.

      • Experience defining service-level objectives (SLOs), managing error budgets, and reducing alert noise in large-scale environments.

      • Knowledge of time-series databases and query languages such as PromQL.

      • Experience automating hardware lifecycle processes, including burn-in testing, failure detection, drive replacement, and decommissioning.

      • Experience identifying and implementing CPU and I/O performance improvements.

      • Understanding of Linux internals and file systems.

      • Familiarity with hard drive performance optimization, including host-managed shingled magnetic recording (SMR).

      • Experience developing and interpreting operational models, dashboards, and reports.

title: Smed til hydraulik og maskinmontage i Rødekro
description:
Er du smed og vil du have firmabil, ordentlig løn og maskiner mellem hænderne?

Vi mangler en smed til hydraulik og maskinmontage i Rødekro.

Du lander i et lille hold, hvor arbejdet ligger tæt på smedearbejde, maskinforarbejdning og praktiske løsninger i metal. Opgaverne handler ikke kun om at stå ved samme bord hele dagen, for der er også montage og hydraulik i pakken. Det er en rolle for dig, der kan tage fat og få tingene til at passe, når metal, maskiner og virkelighed mødes.

Her får du en hverdag, hvor erfaring tæller mere end fine ord. Du skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt med forarbejde, bearbejdning og montage, og du skal være typen, der siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer. Firmabilen er med i pakken, og kørekort er et krav.

Arbejdsområde: Rødekro og omegn

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Din hverdag

Arbejdet starter ofte med at få emnet gjort klar: måle op, tilpasse, bearbejde og gøre klar til montage. Nogle opgaver kræver roligt forarbejde, andre kræver at du får hydraulik og maskindele til at spille sammen. Du skal kunne bruge din erfaring og ikke bare vente på næste besked.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du skal ikke være ekspert i hvert eneste hjørne af faget. Men du skal kunne stå inde for det du afleverer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har mindst 5 års erfaring som smed

title: Vi søger dig som er pædagogmedhjælper til Børnehuset Skrænten
description:
Vi søger 2 pædagogmedhjælpere til vores vuggestue, 32–37 timer om ugen med opstart den 1. januar 2027

Har du lyst til at være en del af en hverdag fyldt med leg, nærvær, omsorg og små og store øjeblikke sammen med de yngste børn? Trives du med at være tæt på børnene, følge deres nysgerrighed og være med til at skabe en tryg start på livet i dagtilbud?

Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter i Børnehuset Skrænten! Vi søger 2 pædagogmedhjælpere til vores vuggestue for børn i alderen 0–2 år, som har lyst til at blive en del af vores hverdag og fællesskab.

Hvem er vi? Børnehuset Skrænten er et integreret dagtilbud i Roskilde Kommune, som er normeret til 59 børn. Hos os skal børn føle sig trygge, opleve, at de hører til, og mærke, at de er vigtige for fællesskabet.

Vi er optagede af at skabe en hverdag, hvor der er plads til forskellighed, nysgerrighed, gode relationer og masser af leg. Vi møder børnene med varme, anerkendelse og interesse for, hvem de er, og hvad de er optagede af.

Vi tror på, at børn gør det bedste, de kan, og at det er vores opgave som voksne at hjælpe dem med at lykkes, føle sig som en del af fællesskabet og få øje på nye muligheder.

En hverdag med nærvær, omsorg og leg I vuggestuen er de små øjeblikke ofte de store. Det kan være et smil, et barn, der tager sine første skridt mod nye oplevelser, glæden ved at opdage noget nyt eller følelsen af at blive mødt af en voksen, der har tid og lyst til at være lige dér.

Vi ved, at de yngste børn har brug for trygge og nærværende voksne, som er opmærksomme på deres signaler, følger deres initiativer og hjælper dem med at udforske verden i deres eget tempo.

Derfor leder vi efter dig, der har lyst til at være tæt på børnene og deltage aktivt i deres hverdag. Du behøver ikke have alle svarene på forhånd. Det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig, omsorgsfuld og har lyst til at lære sammen med børnene og dine kollegaer.

I hverdagen arbejder vi blandt andet med at:
  • Skabe trygge relationer, hvor det enkelte barn føler sig set, mødt og forstået.
  • Understøtte børnenes trivsel, udvikling og nysgerrighed gennem leg og nærvær.
  • Skabe små, trygge børnefællesskaber, hvor børnene gradvist lærer hinanden at kende.
  • Følge børnenes initiativer og give plads til deres idéer og interesser.
  • Bruge vores udeområder og nærmiljø aktivt, så børnene får mulighed for at udforske verden omkring sig.
  • Skabe en genkendelig hverdag med omsorg, nærvær og plads til det enkelte barns behov.
  • Samarbejde tæt med forældre og kollegaer om børnenes trivsel og udvikling.
Din hverdag vil være tæt på børnene – både i legen, i rutinerne og i de aktiviteter, der opstår i løbet af dagen, inde såvel som ude. Det kan være at synge en sang, læse en bog, undersøge noget spændende på legepladsen, hjælpe et barn med at finde ro eller være den trygge voksne, der er lige dér, hvor der er brug for dig.

Hos os er du en vigtig del af fællesskabet Vi ved, at gode rammer for børnene begynder med voksne, der trives, føler sig trygge og oplever, at de har kollegaer omkring sig, som de kan samarbejde med og lære af.

I Børnehuset Skrænten bliver du en del af en personalegruppe, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, deler idéer og udvikler vores praksis sammen. Vi lægger vægt på et godt samarbejde, faglig sparring og en hverdag, hvor der også er plads til humor og smil.

Vi ønsker en hverdag, hvor der er plads til at stille spørgsmål, komme med idéer og være nysgerrig på, hvordan vi sammen kan skabe de bedste rammer for børnene. Vi tror på, at vi lykkes bedst, når vi står sammen om opgaven og hjælper hinanden i hverdagen.

Som pædagogmedhjælper er du en vigtig del af børnenes hverdag. Dine observationer, initiativer og din måde at møde børnene på har betydning. Du behøver ikke være uddannet pædagog for at gøre en forskel – det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at bidrage og være en aktiv del af fællesskabet.

Vi forventer, at du:
  • Er en stabil og engageret kollega, som tager ansvar i hverdagen.
  • Møder børnene med varme, omsorg, tydelighed og respekt.
  • Har lyst til at være tæt på de yngste børn og deres behov.
  • Er nærværende og opmærksom på børnenes signaler og initiativer.
  • Har lyst til at deltage aktivt i børnenes leg og hverdag.
  • Er nysgerrig, tager initiativ og gerne byder ind med dine egne idéer.
  • Har lyst til at samarbejde med både kollegaer og forældre.
  • Vil være med til at skabe trygge fællesskaber, hvor alle børn har mulighed for at trives og deltage.
Måske har du erfaring fra et dagtilbud – måske er du på vej ind i det pædagogiske område for første gang. Erfaring er bestemt ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er din motivation, din tilgang til børnene og din lyst til at være en del af vores fællesskab.

Kom gerne forbi og hils på Det kan være svært at få en fornemmelse af et børnehus gennem et stillingsopslag. Derfor er du meget velkommen til at besøge os, hilse på os og få et indblik i hverdagen i Børnehuset Skrænten.

Ring og aftal et tidspunkt på 46 31 49 01 eller 51 21 09 48, og spørg efter Patrik Tesch.

Du kan også læse mere om Skrænten på vores hjemmeside:



Praktisk information
  • Arbejdstid: 32-37 timer om ugen.

title: Staff Data Scientist, Rewarded Apps
description:
About the Role:
Fetch is looking for a Staff Data Scientist to serve as the senior analytical and scientific leader for our Play business and broader Rewarded Apps portfolio. Reporting to the Senior Director of User Analytics & Insights, you’ll partner with General Managers and leaders across Product, Marketing, Engineering, and other functions to shape how data, experimentation, and advanced analytics inform the future of Play.

This is a strategic, hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll set the analytical direction for Play, identify the highest-value questions for the business, and lead complex analyses and modeling initiatives that influence product strategy, monetization, engagement, and long-term growth. While this role has no direct reports, you’ll mentor analysts and data scientists, establish best practices, and raise the bar for analytical rigor across the organization.

What You'll Do at Fetch:
  • Set the analytical and scientific strategy for Play, identifying high-impact opportunities across revenue, margin, engagement, retention, user experience, and advertiser performance.
  • Serve as a senior thought partner to business, Product, Marketing, and Engineering leaders, proactively defining the questions analytics should answer.
  • Translate ambiguous business and product challenges into structured analytical approaches that clearly communicate trade-offs, uncertainty, and expected impact.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the Play P&L and connect user behavior and product performance to revenue, margin, and marketplace outcomes.
  • Lead advanced analytics and data science initiatives across engagement, retention, monetization, personalization, segmentation, and marketplace dynamics.
  • Build predictive and machine learning models that identify behavioral patterns, forecast outcomes, prioritize opportunities, and inform product and business strategy.
  • Shape Play’s experimentation and measurement strategy, applying A/B testing, causal inference, quasi-experimental methods, and observational analysis as appropriate.
  • Develop scalable analytical assets, feature pipelines, modeling frameworks, and trusted measurement systems using Python and SQL.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to operationalize models, scoring frameworks, and analytical outputs that improve the user experience and business performance.
  • Translate complex findings into clear recommendations for senior and executive audiences, framed around customer outcomes, financial impact, strategic risk, and opportunity cost.
  • Mentor analysts and data scientists, review high-impact analyses, and establish best practices for modeling, experimentation, documentation, reusable code, and data storytelling.

Minimum Qualifications:
  • 8+ years of experience in data science, analytics, quantitative strategy, or a related field, including ownership of complex product or business domains.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience building reusable analytical and modeling workflows.
  • Experience developing, evaluating, and operationalizing machine learning and predictive models, including feature engineering and translating model outputs into business decisions.
  • Strong foundation in statistics, experimental design, power analysis, metric selection, segmentation, and causal inference.
  • Experience applying causal inference techniques such as difference-in-differences, matching, synthetic controls, or related methodologies.
  • Experience developing models related to personalization, propensity, recommendations, forecasting, retention, or lifetime value.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently structure and solve ambiguous, high-impact problems while balancing analytical rigor with business urgency.
  • A track record of using analytics to drive measurable improvements in areas such as revenue, engagement, retention, product performance, or operational efficiency.
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Marketing, and business teams without direct authority.
  • Experience mentoring analysts or data scientists and improving the quality of work across a broader team.
  • Exceptional communication and data storytelling skills, including the ability to explain sophisticated analytical concepts to non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience in consumer technology, gaming, marketplaces, rewards, loyalty, or another high-frequency digital product.
  • Experience with modern analytics engineering tools and practices, including dbt, Git/GitHub, Spark, or similar technologies.
  • Experience working with businesses where user engagement, monetization, incentives, and marketplace economics are closely connected.
  • Experience combining advanced analytics with both product and commercial strategy.

This is a full-time role that can be held from one of our US offices or remotely in the United States or any Canadian province (excluding Quebec), subject to appropriate work authorization. Canadian employment, if applicable, would be through Fetch’s Canadian Employer of Record.

Benefits for Canada-based employees may differ slightly to comply with applicable law(s) (e.g., paid time off, Holidays, etc.).

Fetch may use technology tools that incorporate artificial intelligence ("AI") capabilities to support certain activities within our recruiting and hiring process:

  • Reviewing and organizing applications and resumes to help our recruiting team manage high volumes of submissions, including automated review of fraud signals to identify bad actors;
  • Identifying candidates whose stated qualifications and experience appear relevant to an open position;
  • Scheduling and coordinating interviews with candidates;
  • Generating interview summaries or notes to assist recruiters and hiring managers in their review; and
  • Conducting research on open roles and candidate pools to improve the effectiveness of our recruiting practices.

Fetch does not use AI tools to make hiring decisions. All decisions regarding whether to advance a candidate, extend an offer, or decline an application are made by Fetch employees, who are predominantly members of our Talent Acquisition team and relevant Hiring Managers. AI tools serve only to assist the process of recruiting talent and to inform the human review of candidate information. In no way does Fetch allow AI systems to make, finalize, or override any employment decision.
