title: CNC Programmer (2nd Shift, Mon-Fri)
description:
JOB SUMMARY

This position of CNC Programmer is responsible for the planning, development, programming, set-up, and operation of computer numerical controlled (CNC) machines for the machining of turbine engine components. The programming will generally be in the area of vertical and horizontal milling, turning and grinding. Mastercam and NC Plot software are the primary methods used in the development of repairs codes for CNC equipment programming.

Our customers are worldwide leaders in the fields of aerospace and marine industry sectors of turbine engine power. The final product must conform to the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) specifications.

This position is a part of a large Machining Department comprised of CNC VTL, Mill, Grind and Manual Mill and VTL, Tool & Die, R&D, CNC Programming and dedicated machinist trainers. The successful candidate will work alongside a team of experienced and professional machinists and process engineers that will allow for continuous interaction of techniques, skill knowledge, print reading and interpretation of technical drawings.

The position performs its primary functions in a climate-controlled and modern state-of-the-art facility.

COMPANY OVERVIEW

Component Repair Technologies, Inc. (CRT) began as a locally family-owned business, with operations in Mentor, OH since 1985, and grew into a global leader (500+ employees) in the aerospace MRO sector. Specializing in the repair and overhaul of turbine engine components, CRT proudly serves the world’s largest airlines and jet engine manufactures. Component Repair Technologies is focused on our valued employees, customers, and community.

In 2025, CRT became a Safran Aircraft Engines company as a Center of Excellence for the repair of large jet engine parts in the Americas.

For over 120 years, Safran, through its Aircraft Engines subsidiary, designs, produces, markets and supports, alone or in partnership, aircraft engines offering world-class performance and reliability. Its core purpose is to contribute to a safer, more sustainable world, where air transport is more environmentally friendly, comfortable and accessible.

Operating through CFM International, its 50/50 joint venture with GE Aerospace, Safran Aircraft Engines is the world’s leading supplier of single-aisle commercial jet engines, the CFM56 and LEAP. Safran Aircraft Engines is fully committed to sustainable aviation through the RISE (Revolutionary Innovation for Sustainable Engines) technology development program. Safran Aircraft Engines also deploys a global network providing a full range of support, maintenance & repair services.

Visit and for more information. Take-off in your career, learn new skills and become part of a world-class workforce.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Follow established safety protocols and guidelines to ensure full compliance with company safety policies and procedures.
  2. Program and operate CNC machines in the machining of gas turbine engine components.
  3. Identify, develop, and create language and programs for CNC milling, turning, and grinding machines for the removal of material to achieve required dimensions prior to the application of coatings, after application of finish coatings, or to establish part features.
  4. Work with the Mastercam and NC Plot software to develop efficient and reliable CNC programming needs with process engineering and machinist input.
  5. Work from engineering drawings to plan, number, locate and direct the tool path.
  6. Develop and control new product programming procedures. For program development, this involves test running a piece and first piece inspection through program revisions.
  7. Test and evaluate completed CNC programming developed to ensure accuracy.
  8. Review current CNC programming to determine if changes or improvements are required, such as automation of current CNC programs and new product repair development.
  9. Document set-up information and set-up instructions to ensure a consistent quality of product repair.
  10. Assist in fixture and tooling design.
  11. Present findings and recommendations to applicable levels of the company.
  12. Participate in problem-solving and continuous improvement efforts. The position requires communication with engineers, training specialists, and other machinists to improve skill sets.
  13. Catalog and control program back-up procedure with the quality department.
  14. Dimensional accuracy may require the use of inspection gauges, comparator, micrometers, calipers, and miscellaneous hand tools.
  15. Accurately record findings on provided work instructions and documentation.
  16. Participate in problem-solving and continuous improvement efforts.
  17. From time-to-time, participate in the training process and offer expertise in the OJT program for various levels of machinist technicians.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  1. Five plus years of experience in operating CNC Milling and/or Turning and/or Grind equipment. (Such as, but not limited to: Johnford DMC, VMC, BMC)
    1. Job shop type environment.
    2. MTO – made to order environment.
    3. First article experience.
  2. Five plus years of experience in creative problem solving on:
    1. Machine setups.
    2. Tooling.
    3. Fixturing.
  3. Firm understanding of:
    1. GD&T
    2. Critical dimensioning.
    3. Relationship between dimensions.
  4. Basic CNC Macro coding experience.

OTHER QUALIFICATIONS

  1. Technical high school diploma, machinist trade school or equivalent work experience.
  2. Familiar with shop math principles and basic trigonometry.
  3. Understanding timing or rotational values.
  4. General skills such as use of hand-held power tools, files, assembly, and disassembly.
  5. Read, write, speak, understand English, and be able to communicate with other employees.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  1. This position has pre-employment testing requirements that may require fitness for duty testing and a vision exam.
  2. Follow general shop safety procedures including the occasional use of safety glasses, safety toe shoes, and hearing protection.
  3. Stand and/or sit for portions of the shift. Move parts (>50 pounds) using hoists, slings, carts, or other handling methods. Move less heavy parts (<50 pounds) with or without hoists, slings, or carts

COMPANY BENEFITS

Our employees and families are the number one asset at CRT. A progressive and innovative benefits package is in place, such as:

  1. CRT currently offers two excellent health care options, one being a fully funded program (no premiums for employee and family) and the other being a traditional employee premium contribution. Programs include health, vision, and dental coverages. Additional programs include short- and long-term disability and life insurance.
  2. The company offers a 401k program with company match.
  3. Continuing education is offered via multiple sources and opportunities with tuition reimbursement based on eligibility requirements.
  4. Traditional paid time off (PTO) is offered via vacation days and personal days.
  5. Multiple shift opportunities with hourly premiums for off-shifts are offered.
  6. To review other benefits, visit our website at or Facebook page to see, “what we are up to.”
EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER AND AFFIRMATIVE ACTION PARTICIPATION
Component Repair Technologies, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer, M/F/H/V.
CRT is committed to providing a safe and healthy workplace and promoting the health and well-being of its employees. It is the Company’s policy to only hire individuals who do not use drugs. All candidates will be screened for drug use prior to hire. Employment opportunities at CRT are open to all qualified applicants solely based on their job-related experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities. CRT complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws with regards to equal employment opportunity.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Klaar om als Senior Data Engineer/Platform Engineer impact te maken bij toonaangevende organisaties? Bij Team EIFFEL werk je projectmatig aan uitdagende datavraagstukken, van corporates tot overheid. Je bouwt aan slimme data-oplossingen én begeleidt collega’s in hun groei. Jij kiest je richting: verdiepen of verbreden. Zo blijf je jezelf voor.

Dit ga je doen

  • Je ontsluit data voor eindgebruikers en werkt samen met analisten

Je bent fit for the job als je...

  • een hbo- of wo-diploma hebt in Informatica, Data Science of Business IT & Management
  • ervaring hebt met SQL, Python en ETL/ELT tools zoals Data Factory, dbt of Airflow en kennis van AVG richtlijnen en hoe data daarop aansluit
  • ervaring hebt met CI/CD, Git en data-integraties (API’s)
  • Nederlands spreekt en schrijft op minimaal C1-niveau
  • bent in het bezit van een rijbewijs B

Dit krijg je van ons

Je ontvangt een salaris tussen 5.500 en 8.500 euro bruto per maand op basis van een 40 urige werkweek, passend bij jouw ervaring en expertise.

  • Creëer je ideale thuiswerkplek met onze vergoeding
  • Leer van Olympische topsporters hoe je topprestaties levert én volhoudt
  • Trap je werkdag af op 2 wielen. Lease een (elektrische) fiets en blijf in beweging.
  • Een premievrij pensioen. Goed geregeld!
  • Boost je salaris met onze verschillende bonussen
  • Met 25 vakantiedagen heb je alle tijd voor jouw avonturen
  • Met kennissessies en webinars blijf je bij in je vakgebied
  • Op tijd naar je afspraak in je (elektrische) leaseauto
  • Ontwikkel je onbeperkt met de Team EIFFEL Academy trainingen
  • Mobiliteitsbudget: jij bepaalt hoe je reist
Dit zijn wij

Groot in interim capaciteit en sterk in consultancy, dat is EIFFEL. We versterken organisaties precies waar dat nodig is, of het nu gaat om een bank, gemeente of ziekenhuis. Dat doen we door slimmer te werken, ideeën van papier naar praktijk te brengen en de juiste mensen op de juiste plek te zetten. Voor grote transformaties én snelle oplossingen. Van multinational tot start up: als professional bij EIFFEL kom je overal binnen.

Je sluit je aan bij Team Analytics, een groeiend team van gedreven data professionals. Samen help je organisaties door heel Nederland om datagedreven werken naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Je werkt aan projecten waar je écht impact maakt en je krijgt de ruimte om jouw expertise te verdiepen en te verbreden.

Op vrijdag werken we samen in ons clubhuis in Arnhem. Deze dag staat in het teken van kennisdeling, sparren met collega’s en het versterken van de verbinding met Team EIFFEL. Verwacht je opdrachtgever je die dag op locatie? Dan gaat dat natuurlijk voor.

EIFFEL is onderdeel van Team EIFFEL: een community van ruim 3.000 experts binnen interim, consultancy en projectmanagement. Met opdrachten in 24 kennisdomeinen, bij meer dan 600 opdrachtgevers, en een trainingsaanbod waar je eindeloos uit kunt kiezen, helpen onze Performance Managers jou een loopbaan te bouwen die past bij jouw ambitie en levensfase.

#LI-GH1

Deze skills komen van pas
  • SQL
  • RESTful API development
  • Kennis van programma's en portfolio's
  • Kennis van BI-tools
  • ETL processen

Je schakelt makkelijk tussen techniek en business en neemt anderen mee in jouw keuzes en oplossingen.

title: SOC Analyst, Intermediate
description:
Long View. A career that helps you get more out of life.
A Long View career helps you get more out of life. We don’t just say it, we prove it. Every day. We’re proud of our reputation as one of North America’s most dynamic IT providers — and we’re even prouder of our culture that allows our people to live life to its fullest. At Long View, we create an environment of collaboration and support, of innovation and enthusiasm, of inclusion and belonging. As a member of the Long View team, you’ll see how our company’s core pillars — Integrity, Competence, Value, and Fun — resonate through the workplace. And in a recent survey, 89% of Long View team members rated Long View as a good or great place to work!

Do you get excited about monitoring and management tools that keep environments running securely and reliably? Do you have a passion for cybersecurity, threat detection, and operational excellence?

We are looking for a driven and self-motivated Intermediate Security Operations Centre Analyst for our Calgary team to help ensure the security, availability, and operational uptime of the tools used to monitor, protect, and manage Long View’s clients’ environments! In this role, you will serve as a key resource for escalated security incidents, providing technical guidance, knowledge sharing, and day-to-day support to fellow analysts.

This is an onsite position based in Northeast Calgary and will require working in shifts and on weekends.

A Day in the Life:

  • Serve as a trusted escalation point for complex security events, providing technical guidance, mentorship, and support to fellow analysts

  • Monitor, investigate, and respond to security incidents, suspicious activity, and operational alerts across client environments

  • Analyze and triage security events using SIEM and monitoring platforms, escalating incidents as required

  • Act as the first line of defense within the ITOC, monitoring network, infrastructure, and security alerts and coordinating incident response

  • Manage incidents, investigations, and service requests through established case management and ITSM processes

  • Conduct threat analysis, log reviews, and containment activities to support effective incident response

  • Support access management processes, including privileged access management solutions such as CyberArk

  • Perform vulnerability scanning activities, review findings, and remediate or escalate identified risks

  • Execute approved infrastructure changes, patching activities, and scheduled maintenance within designated change windows

  • Manage and monitor backup operations to ensure the availability and recoverability of client environments

  • Assist with operational escalations, service disruptions, and client-impacting events to support service continuity

  • Maintain and enhance internally developed tools and applications that support SOC and ITOC operations

What You Bring:

  • 4+ years of experience working in a Security Operations Centre (SOC), Network Operations Centre (NOC), or similar IT operations environment supporting on-premise and cloud-connected technologies

  • Experience working with SIEM, security monitoring, vulnerability management, and IT service management platforms

  • Experience working with and managing incidents, problems, changes and service requests that follow ITIL framework standards

  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threats, vulnerabilities, and incident response processes

  • Experience provisioning new client services and working through customer onboarding tasks

  • Experience with first-level server technologies (i.e. remoting into servers, implementing patches)

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve technical and procedural issues across security, infrastructure, and network domains

  • Ability to be on-site at a NE Calgary location

  • Availability to work varying schedules of 4 days on, 3 days off ( with every 4-weeks rotation), for 10-hour work shifts with rotation of days, evenings and overnights

What Makes You Extra Awesome:

  • Security+ and/or ISC2 certification

  • CCNA or CCNP certifications

  • ITILv4

  • Previous experience in a 24x7 operations center

Why Work at Long View:

  • Great people and culture

  • Recognition programs

  • Fun is one of our core values

  • Interesting work – Be part of exciting projects while accessing all the latest technologies

  • Flexible environment – A workplace that values the importance of flexibility for personal/professional growth, happiness and wellness

Want to learn more about our culture and life at Long View? Check us out on LinkedIn and Instagram!

Long View’s mission of building the best and most sustainable team-driven organization requires dedicated and ambitious people. Through employee resource groups, impactful and effective conversations, townhalls and various company-wide training, including how to reduce unconscious bias, we are fostering an inclusive environment. We are committed to taking consistent, positive and lifelong action to be a diverse and equitable workplace because we know that the most effective companies are made up of people with varied identities, experiences and backgrounds.

Long View is an equal opportunity employer. If you have any accommodation requests for your interview or the role, please let your friendly Recruiter know

title: WIC Program Assistant
description:

We are looking for a passionate, personable, and highly professional individual who is committed to delivering meaningful, high-quality services to WIC participants and supporting the health and well-being of our community.

  • Client Services: Build meaningful connections with WIC applicants by guiding them through the eligibility process. Verify key information—including identity, residency, income, and voter registration—with accuracy, compassion, and attention to detail to ensure every client feels supported and respected.
  • Appointment Coordination: Deliver a welcoming and organized experience by managing client check-ins, responding to incoming calls, and scheduling appointments with efficiency, professionalism, and care.

  • Promote and support breastfeeding among WIC participants.

  • Travel to satellite clinics and perform Program Assistant responsibilities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Key Competencies:

  • Communication – Listens for understanding and meaning; speaks and writes effectively.
  • Community - Demonstrates a desire to serve others and fulfill the needs of CPC clients.
  • Relationships - Builds rapport and relates well to others.
  • Inclusion – Works effectively with people of different backgrounds, abilities, opinions and perceptions.
  • Quality Results - Strives to meet or exceed goals and deliver a high-value experience to CPC clients.
  • Influence – Seeks first to understand the other person’s point of view and remains calm in challenging situations.

title: Operatører til pladepresse
description:
VKAREN.DK-REKRUTTERING søger 2 Operatører til pladepresse på fast aftenhold hos Elektro-Isola i Vejle

Har du hænderne godt skruet på, og vil du gerne arbejde med maskiner i en produktion? Så har vi måske jobbet til dig. Du behøver ikke at være faglært eller have erfaring med en pladepresse. Du får den oplæring, du har brug for.

Jobbet

Som operatør hos Elektro-Isola bliver din vigtigste opgave at passe en stor pladepresse. Du skal holde øje med pressen og sørge for, at pladerne bliver presset korrekt.

Du skal blandt andet fylde plader i pressen, tage dem ud igen og gøre de næste plader klar. Når der er styr på pressen, hjælper du med andre opgaver i produktionen.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Passe og betjene pladepressen
  • Fylde og tømme pressen
  • Gøre de næste plader klar til presning
  • Save plader til i de rigtige mål
  • Kontrollere, at pladerne lever op til kravene
  • Rengøre maskiner og produktionsudstyr
  • Hjælpe med almindelig vedligeholdelse og andre opgaver i produktionen

Du får en varieret hverdag, hvor du kan prøve kræfter med flere forskellige opgaver og maskiner. Du lærer nyt undervejs og får et godt indblik i, hvordan produktionen fungerer.

Virksomheden tilbyder

Du får en grundig oplæring, så du lærer maskinerne og opgaverne at kende. Oplæringen foregår som udgangspunkt på daghold, inden du overgår til aftenholdet.

Du bliver en del af et team, hvor man hjælper hinanden og løser opgaverne i fællesskab.

Der er tale om en fuldtidsstilling på fast aftenhold med arbejdstid:

  • Mandag til torsdag kl. 14.00-22.05
  • Ca. 12-15 fredagsvagter om året

Du får løn efter dine kvalifikationer samt pension, fritvalgsordning og sundhedssikring.

Din baggrund

Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at arbejde i en produktion og lære nyt. Du behøver ikke at have erfaring med pladepresser eller kompositmaterialer. Det skal vi nok lære dig.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • Møder til tiden og er til at regne med
  • Har lyst til at arbejde med maskiner
  • Tager ansvar for dine opgaver
  • Går op i, at arbejdet bliver gjort ordentligt
  • Kan arbejde selv og sammen med andre
  • Er klar på at lære nye opgaver

Har du truckcertifikat eller epoxycertifikat, er det en fordel, men det er ikke et krav.

Om virksomheden

Elektro-Isola A/S er en familieejet virksomhed i Vejle, som blev grundlagt i 1921. Her fremstiller man særlige plader og materialer, som bruges af virksomheder over hele verden.

Produkterne bruges blandt andet inden for rumfart, medicinalindustrien og energi. Kvalitet og god produktion er vigtige dele af hverdagen.

Elektro-Isola har mange erfarne medarbejdere, og flere har været ansat i virksomheden i årtier.

Læs mere på .

Ansøgning

Lyder jobbet som noget for dig? Så send din ansøgning og dit CV via linket her. Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Michael Bielefeldt på tlf. 70 20 15 12 på hverdage.


Alle ansøgninger behandles fortroligt. Af hensyn til GDPR modtager vi kun ansøgninger via linket i stillingsannoncen. Har du problemer med at uploade din ansøgning, er du velkommen til at kontakte os.

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description:
Technology Advancement Group (TAG) is a veteran-owned systems integrator in Ashburn, Virginia. We design, build and integrate assured positioning, navigation and timing (PNT) hardware and software for the Department of Defense and the companies that build for it. Our products include anti-jam CRPA antennas, horizon-nulling antennas and a miniature M-code GPS receiver. All of them are shipping today, with test data behind them, and our engineers integrate them into the systems our customers already run.

We're hiring an Embedded Software Engineer to architect and build the software inside our next generation of PNT products. You'll report to our Technical Director and play a lead architecture and development role: evaluating and selecting processors and subsystems, writing embedded code for single-core and multi-core processors, and integrating civilian and military next-generation GNSS receivers, inertial measurement units (IMUs) and other state-of-the-art sensors. There's no large software organization behind you here, so you'll own decisions from processor selection to the code that ships, working side by side with our hardware, systems and test engineers. The role is based in Ashburn. We'd prefer you on-site, and a hybrid schedule is possible.

On the Android and Linux side, you'll customize and integrate Android OS for embedded devices and custom hardware. You'll work in the Linux kernel, device drivers, the hardware abstraction layer (HAL) and system services to get the performance, functionality and hardware compatibility our platforms need. You'll lead board bring-up and board support package (BSP) development, develop and optimize drivers for our peripherals, and debug low-level problems from bootloaders to kernel panics and driver failures. You'll analyze and tune performance and power consumption, and keep the platform secure with secure boot, SELinux and dm-verity.

On the microcontroller side, you'll write code and state machines for 32-bit microcontrollers on bare metal, an RTOS or Android. You'll work across SPI, I2C, UART, MIPI, CAN and USB interfaces, GPIOs and interrupts, and integrate wireless links including Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, LoRa and ISM-band radios. You'll manage power through power islands and power states, core switching and dynamic clocking.

Who You Are

You're an embedded engineer who wants to own the software from the first register read to the fielded product, and you'd rather build the architecture than inherit it.

You live close to the hardware. You're at home with a datasheet, a scope and a debug probe. When a new board comes up dead, you want to be the one who finds out why.

You think in systems. Processor choice, power budget, boot time and security all trade against each other. You weigh them together, and you can explain why you picked what you picked.

You're curious about navigation. You want to know how a GNSS receiver tracks a signal, how an IMU carries the solution when GPS is jammed, and what that means for the code that brings them together. When something is new to you, you read up and keep asking questions until it makes sense.

You don't stop at the symptom. A kernel panic, a dropped interrupt or a driver that fails one boot in fifty doesn't get a workaround from you. You chase it to the root cause and write down what you found.

You own it at small scale. There's no platform team or build engineer to hand work to here. When something is missing, you set it up. When something isn't working, you say so and fix it.

You care who's on the other end. Our products go to warfighters who need to know where they are when GPS is jammed or spoofed. The code you write runs in their hands. You take that seriously, and it shows in your work.

Required Experience

Embedded Linux and Android. You've customized and integrated Android or embedded Linux on custom hardware, working in the kernel, device drivers, the HAL and system services. Pick a platform and you can walk us through what you changed and why.

Board bring-up and BSPs. You've brought up a new board and built or maintained its BSP. You've debugged bootloader, kernel and driver failures on real hardware, and you can describe the hardest one and how you found it.

Microcontroller firmware. You've written firmware and state machines for 32-bit microcontrollers on bare metal and on an RTOS. You've worked with SPI, I2C, UART, MIPI, CAN and USB, GPIOs and interrupts, and you can explain how you handled timing and concurrency.

Processor and architecture decisions. You've evaluated and selected processors or subsystems, or made the major architecture calls, for a product that shipped. You can show us the trade-offs you weighed and what you'd change now.

Multi-core, performance and power. You've written code for multi-core processors and optimized a system's performance and power consumption using power states, core switching or dynamic clocking. You can show us the measurements before and after.

U.S. person status. This position requires access to technical data controlled under U.S. export control laws. Applicants must be U.S. persons as defined in the ITAR (22 CFR 120.62): U.S. citizens and nationals, lawful permanent residents, and persons admitted as refugees or granted asylum.

Clearance eligibility. You must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance, which requires U.S. citizenship.

Nice to Haves

GNSS and inertial sensors. You've integrated GNSS receivers, IMUs or other navigation sensors, and ideally a military receiver. You understand how their data comes together into position and time.

Wireless protocols. You've integrated Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, LoRa or other ISM-band radios on an embedded device.

Platform security. You've implemented secure boot, SELinux policy or dm-verity, and kept a device compliant through software updates.

Active clearance. You already hold a current U.S. government security clearance, at any level.

TAG is a small, veteran-owned company, and more than a quarter of our team has served. You'll work directly with leadership and with our hardware and systems engineers, and the software you write will ship in products used in the field.

TAG is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior Platform Engineer II
description:

In this role, you will design, build, secure, and operate enterprise-grade Linux platforms that enable engineering teams to deliver reliable software efficiently. You will lead platform engineering initiatives spanning infrastructure automation, vulnerability management, compliance, and cloud operations across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud. Leveraging advanced Linux administration, Ansible, Terraform, and CI/CD practices, you will improve platform consistency, operational resilience, and security at scale. You will also drive automation initiatives that streamline patching, standardize system configurations, and strengthen production readiness across complex environments. Working closely with security, infrastructure, and application teams, you will troubleshoot critical issues, lead root-cause analysis, and implement sustainable solutions. This opportunity is ideal for an experienced platform engineer who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges, modernizing operational practices, and building secure, scalable systems in an enterprise environment.

Accountabilities

  • Design, build, operate, and troubleshoot enterprise UNIX/Linux platforms throughout their lifecycle, from server provisioning and configuration to production readiness, maintenance, and retirement.
  • Lead Linux vulnerability remediation, security hardening, compliance validation, and audit readiness across large-scale enterprise environments.
  • Plan and execute operating system patching, kernel updates, platform upgrades, and fleet maintenance, using controlled rollouts, canary deployments, and reliable rollback procedures.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure automation using Ansible, Python, Shell scripting, APIs, and infrastructure-as-code tools to improve operational efficiency and consistency.
  • Manage Linux workloads across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud, including server provisioning, bootstrap processes, platform images, private repositories, and lifecycle management.
  • Build and maintain standardized, secure Linux images using Packer or AWS Image Builder, integrating security controls and automated configuration management into golden-image workflows.
  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines, primarily with GitHub Actions or equivalent platforms, to automate patching, security hardening, compliance checks, and governed operational procedures.
  • Implement and maintain CIS benchmark compliance using Ansible Lockdown, investigate failed controls, remediate configuration gaps, and manage documented policy waivers with appropriate business justification and variable mapping.
  • Identify and remediate security vulnerabilities, including Qualys vulnerability QIDs associated with CVEs and packages, as well as CIS compliance CIDs.

  • Maintain platform standards, technical documentation, operational runbooks, and reusable automation patterns while collaborating with security, infrastructure, and application teams to continuously improve platform services.

Requirements

  • At least 7 years of hands-on experience in platform engineering, including substantial experience administering and operating enterprise Linux environments.
  • Expert-level Linux administration skills across RHEL 8/9, Ubuntu 22.04/24.04, and Amazon Linux 2/2023, including kernel and security patching, package management, service administration, user and permission management, SSH configuration, logging, and production troubleshooting.
  • Practical experience with controlled patch deployments, canary rollouts, rollback procedures, and Linux lifecycle management, including tools such as dnf history.
  • Strong knowledge of CIS security benchmarks and experience applying them through Ansible Lockdown, remediating failed controls, and managing documented policy exceptions with business justification and corresponding Ansible variable mappings.
  • Advanced Ansible skills for configuration management, automated patching, security hardening, and platform provisioning.
  • Experience integrating security hardening into golden images and onboarding third-party Amazon Machine Images (AMIs), including bootstrap configuration, automation keys, domain joining, and agent installation.
  • Advanced hands-on experience managing Linux workloads across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, including EC2, user data, bootstrap automation, and private package repositories.
  • Strong Terraform and Ansible expertise, along with practical experience building standardized Linux images using Packer or AWS Image Builder.
  • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or comparable tools, including workflows for patching, compliance validation, and controlled operational execution.
  • Proven ability to remediate Qualys vulnerability QIDs involving CVEs and packages, address CIS compliance CIDs, and work with security scanning tools such as SonarQube, Veracode, Snyk, and StackHawk.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering automated platform solutions, including large-scale vulnerability remediation, compliance diagnostics, policy-waiver registers, and repository or mirror troubleshooting.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to diagnose complex operating system, networking, storage, authentication, and performance issues and lead effective root-cause analysis.
  • Solid understanding of secure access management, including SSH, sudo, PAM, certificates, and privileged access controls.
  • Familiarity with incident management, problem management, change management, production support, and on-call operational practices.
  • Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve troubleshooting, scripting, log analysis, documentation, root-cause analysis, and automation workflows.
  • Strong communication, documentation, and collaboration skills, with the ability to coordinate across infrastructure, security, and application engineering teams.
  • AWS certifications or additional working knowledge of Azure and Google Cloud are advantageous.

  • Inclusive work environment: Join a workplace that values respect, diversity, collaboration, and equal employment opportunities.

description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Pessoa Especialista em Engenharia de Dados Sênior based in Brazil.

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineering Specialist to design, build, and evolve scalable data architectures that support strategic business decisions and innovation. In this role, you will work across Data Lake, Data Warehouse, and Lakehouse environments, ensuring data quality, security, governance, and reliability at scale. You will develop and optimize sophisticated data pipelines, enabling the efficient integration and processing of large volumes of information. As a technical expert, you will establish engineering standards, promote best practices, and improve the performance of data platforms and workflows. Working closely with multidisciplinary teams, you will help translate business needs into robust, sustainable data solutions. This fully remote opportunity is ideal for an experienced professional who combines deep technical expertise, architectural vision, and a passion for building high-quality data ecosystems.

Accountabilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data ingestion, transformation, and integration pipelines to support reliable data processing across the organization.
  • Develop and evolve robust architectures for Data Lakes, Data Warehouses, and Lakehouse environments, ensuring scalability, performance, and long-term maintainability.
  • Implement and optimize ETL/ELT processes to improve data processing efficiency, reliability, and resource utilization.
  • Establish and enforce data quality, governance, security, and management standards throughout the data lifecycle.
  • Integrate multiple data sources and destinations, ensuring interoperability and consistent data availability across platforms and systems.
  • Apply distributed processing technologies to handle large datasets efficiently and support complex analytical workloads.
  • Define technical standards, architectural guidelines, and engineering best practices to promote consistency and excellence across data engineering initiatives.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data pipelines and platform components to maintain performance, accuracy, and operational reliability.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of data infrastructure, architectures, and engineering processes, encouraging innovation and the adoption of modern technologies.

Requirements:

  • Strong professional experience with Python or Scala for data engineering, pipeline development, and data processing automation.
  • Proven hands-on experience with Apache Spark and distributed data processing technologies.
  • Deep knowledge of Data Lake, Data Warehouse, and Lakehouse architectures, including their design, implementation, and optimization.
  • Extensive experience developing, maintaining, and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines in cloud-based environments.

title: Informationssikkerheds- og implementeringsspecialist søges til kontoret Sikkerhed og Beredskab
description:
Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel inden for informationssikkerhed og dermed være med til at sikre, at Vurderingsstyrelsen står stærkt i en tid, hvor sikkerhed, robusthed og beredskab er vigtigere end nogensinde? Så er du måske en af vores nye kollegaer i Sikkerhed og Beredskab.

Vi søger en kollega, der har erfaring med informationssikkerhed og implementering heraf i en statslig organisation, og som har gerne vil arbejde med rådgivning og udvikling af informationssikkerheden i Skatteforvaltningen. Du behøver altså ikke kunne det hele, men det er vigtigt, at du har et stort kendskab til området og gerne vil sikre compliance indenfor informationssikkerhedsområdet.

Om Vurderingsstyrelsen
Vurderingsstyrelsen skal sikre retvisende ejendomsvurderinger og korrekt ejendomsbeskatning af alle ejendomme i Danmark. Vurderingsstyrelsen har dermed ansvaret for at sikre, at der er en sammenhængende proces i ejendomsvurdering og ejendomsbeskatning – fra indhentning af data og sagsbehandling af ejendomsvurderingen og beskatningsgrundlaget til formidling og forklaring af ejendomsværdien og ejendomsbeskatningen til den enkelte boligejer.



Det stiller store krav til vores evne til at beskytte data, systemer, processer og fysiske værdier – og til vores evne til at kunne håndtere situationer, hvor noget ikke går som planlagt.

Om kontoret Sikkerhed og Beredskab
I kontoret Sikkerhed og Beredskab arbejder vi både med informationssikkerhed, beredskab og persondatabeskyttelse. Vi understøtter organisationen med rådgivning, risikovurderinger, awareness, compliance og implementering af sikkerhedskrav, ligesom vi arbejder for at sikre et stærkt og velfungerende krise- og IT-beredskab. Vi har et stærkt fagligt miljø med plads til både specialister og kollegaer, der er i gang med at opbygge deres faglighed. Vi har en god og uformel tone, hvor humor og højt humør er yderst værdsat. Selvom vi til tider har travlt, hjælper vi hinanden, løfter i flok og gør en dyd ud af, at det også skal være sjovt at gå på arbejde.

Dine opgaver
Som informationssikkerheds- og implementeringsspecialist bliver du en del af arbejdet med at udvikle og implementere informationssikkerheden i Vurderingsstyrelsen.

Dine opgaver kan blandt andet omfatte:

  • Arbejde med at oversætte og implementere ISO 27001 i Vurderingsstyrelsen
  • Informationssikkerhed i forbindelse med udviklingsarbejde omkring de nye ejendomsvurderings- og ejendomsbeskatningssystemer
  • Informationssikkerhed i forbindelse med egenudvikling i styrelsen
  • Udarbejdelse af lokale politikker, kampagner og awareness-aktiviteter
  • Risikovurderinger af styrelsens forretningsprocesser og systemanvendelse
  • Implementering og opfølgning på udvalgte SoA-kontrolområder
  • Sekretariatsbetjening af Informationssikkerhedsudvalget, som har styrelsens direktør som formand
  • Besvarelse af høringer, tilsyn og modenhedsmålinger fra fx departementet, Rigsrevisionen eller andre policyansvarlige enheder
  • Rådgivning og sparring til de øvrige kontorer i styrelsen
  • Projektledelse og/eller projektdeltagelse
Du vil få en central rolle i at omsætte krav og standarder til noget, der fungerer i praksis i resten af organisationen. Det kræver både faglighed, struktur og ikke mindst evnen til at samarbejde med kollegaer, der ikke nødvendigvis har informationssikkerhed som deres primære fagområde.

Din profil
Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant videregående uddannelse eller anden relevant baggrund.

Som informationssikkerheds- og implementeringsspecialist er det en forudsætning, at du har erfaring med informationssikkerhed og fx har arbejdet med ISO 27001, risikovurderinger, compliance, sikkerhedskrav eller implementering af informationssikkerhed i en større organisation. Du behøver ikke have erfaring med alle de områder, vi arbejder med. Det vigtigste er, at du har en solid faglighed, har erfaring på området og kan omsætte din viden til løsninger, der fungerer i praksis.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • er analytisk og struktureret
  • kan skabe overblik og følge op på aftaler og opgaver
  • har blik for både detaljer og sammenhænge
  • har gode samarbejdsevner og bidrager til fælles målopfyldelse
  • kan kommunikere klart både skriftligt og mundtligt
  • er nysgerrig og har lyst til at lære
  • kan begå dig i en organisation med mange interessenter og forskellige fagligheder
  • tager ansvar for dine opgaver og følger dem til dørs
Vi forventer du har engagement, mod og vilje til at lære en stor organisation og et omfangsrigt system- og sikkerhedslandskab at kende.

En del af et stærkt fagligt netværk
Med ansættelse i Sikkerhed og Beredskab i Vurderingsstyrelsen, vil du få en bred kontaktflade.

Du kommer til at samarbejde og danne netværk med andre informationssikkerheds- og beredskabsmedarbejdere i Skatte- og vækstministeriets koncern, og på tværs af andre statslige myndigheder. Du bliver samtidig en del af et kontor, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen om sikkerhed og beredskab. Vi sparrer med hinanden, deler viden og hjælper hinanden med at finde løsninger på de udfordringer, vi møder.

Kontakt og ansættelsesvilkår
Send din ansøgning med CV og eksamensbevis via linket ”Søg stillingen” senest den 4. november 2026.

Vi forventer at afholde samtaler i uge 46 og 47.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte den rekrutterende leder Charlotte Lauritsen på telefon 72 37 60 20.

Der kan indgå en logik- og personanalyse i ansættelsesprocessen. Der vil forud for ansættelsen blive indhentet referencer og straffeattest. Vi vil til ansættelsessamtalen gerne høre om dine tidligere projekter og resultater.

Du bliver ansat på overenskomstvilkår i henhold til enhver tid gældende overenskomst for akademikere i staten (AC), overenskomst for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere (HK) eller overenskomst for Fuldmægtige m.fl. (DTS) i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet.

Det er en forudsætning for ansættelsen, at du kan sikkerhedsgodkendes til klassifikationsgraden [FORTROLIGT] og kan opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen gennem hele din ansættelse.

Ansættelsesområdet er Skatte- og Vækstministeriet med tilhørende institutioner. Dit arbejdssted bliver Ny Østergade 11, 4000 Roskilde. Tiltrædelse pr. 1. januar 2027 eller hurtigst muligt.

title: Ledende kirketjener til Københavns Domkirke
description:
Vil du lede en dygtig kirketjenergruppe og være med til at skabe gode rammer om livet i Vor Frue Kirke - Københavns Domkirke?

Som ledende kirketjener får du det overordnede ansvar for kirketjenernes arbejde og bliver samtidig en central del af en hverdag, hvor mennesker, tradition, gudstjenester og praktiske opgaver mødes. Hos os løfter vi opgaverne i fællesskab. Du er en del af gruppen og tager del i de samme opgaver som dine kolleger. Samtidig er det dig, der har det overordnede ansvar for, at arbejdet bliver planlagt, koordineret og fulgt til dørs.

Spændvidden i jobbet er stor. Du skal kunne stå i spidsen for kirketjenernes arbejde ved store kirkelige handlinger, hvor kravene til forberedelse, koordinering og sikker afvikling er høje. Men du skal også trives i den almindelige hverdag, hvor opgaverne tæller rengøring, praktiske udfordringer og nærværende møder med kirkens mange besøgende. Den ledende kirketjener har desuden et særligt ansvar for kirkens bygningsvedligehold.

OM JOBBET

Du får det daglige ledelsesansvar for kirkens syv fastansatte kirketjenere samt en række vikarer. Du refererer til kirkens daglige leder og derigennem til menighedsrådet.

Hverdagen i Vor Frue Kirke rummer både faste rutiner og situationer, der ikke kan planlægges på forhånd. Derfor har vi brug for en leder, der kan skabe struktur og overblik og samtidig bevare ro og fleksibilitet, når planer ændrer sig.

Du sætter retning for kirketjenergruppens arbejde og sørger for, at opgaver og ansvar er tydeligt fordelt. Det betyder ikke, at du skal løse alting selv. Tværtimod lægger vi vægt på et arbejdsfællesskab, hvor kolleger bidrager med erfaring og faglighed, hjælper hinanden og tager ansvar for den fælles opgave. Din rolle er at skabe det bedste udfoldelsesrum for samarbejdet og samtidig træffe de nødvendige beslutninger, prioritere og følge op.

Vor Frue Kirke er de hjemløses kirke. Dens døre er åbne for mennesker af alle slags: den faste menighed, andagtsøgende, turister, skoleklasser samt mennesker med udfordringer. Vi lægger vægt på at møde enhver med venlighed og respekt, men samtidig at kunne sætte nødvendige grænser.

DINE VIGTIGSTE OPGAVER

Sammen med kirketjenerteamet sørger du for, at huset fungerer i det daglige, og at mennesker, der kommer i kirken, bliver mødt professionelt og respektfuldt.

Du får blandt andet ansvar for:

  • at lede, koordinere og tage ligeværdig del i kirketjenerteamets daglige arbejde
  • at planlægge og koordinere arbejdstider, vagtplaner og opgaver
  • at sikre den praktiske forberedelse og afvikling af gudstjenester, koncerter og øvrige arrangementer – også i den helt store skala
  • at udvikle arbejdsgange og sammen med kollegerne finde gode løsninger på hverdagens opgaver
  • at afholde MU-samtaler og understøtte den enkelte medarbejders udvikling og trivsel
  • at planlægge og koordinere eksterne håndværkere og samarbejdspartnere i forbindelse med vedligeholdelse af kirkebygningen og tilhørende bygninger i samarbejde med kirkeværgen.
HVEM ER DU?

Du har interesse for kirken og forståelse for dens særlige karakter som både arbejdsplads, gudstjenesterum og sted for mange forskellige mennesker. Du er en tydelig og tillidsvækkende leder, der trives med at være tæt på både mennesker og opgaver. Du behøver ikke stå med alle svarene selv. Til gengæld skal du kunne samle trådene, sætte retning og sikre, at aftaler bliver omsat til handling.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • har solid erfaring med ledelse og kan skabe gode rammer om et team
  • har erfaring med ledelse af bygge- og/eller vedligeholdelsesopgaver.
  • arbejder struktureret og er god til at planlægge, prioritere og uddelegere arbejdet
  • evner at kommunikere klart og respektfuldt med kolleger og besøgende
  • har blik for både mennesker, praktiske detaljer og den større sammenhæng
  • har praktisk sans og hænderne godt skruet på
  • er fleksibel i forhold til skiftende arbejdstider
Erfaring fra folkekirken vil være en fordel, men din baggrund kan også være ledelsesmæssig, håndværksmæssig eller en anden. Du får en grundig introduktion til arbejdspladsen, og sammen lægger vi en plan for din opstart.

OM OS

Vor Frue Kirke er en levende kirke i hjertet af København med en bred vifte af kirkelige, kulturelle og sociale aktiviteter. Foruden ugens gudstjenester og transmitterede morgenandagter løfter kirken sine forpligtelser som dom- og sognekirke gennem kirkelig undervisning, et rigt koncertliv, børne- og familiearrangementer, museum, aftenåben kirke og socialt arbejde. Du bliver en del af en stor og socialt velfungerende arbejdsplads med 42 ansatte, hvor omgangstonen er varm og ordentlig, og hvor det kan mærkes, at vi kan lide at arbejde sammen. Du vil desuden møde et engageret menighedsråd med særligt fokus på et godt og professionelt arbejdsmiljø.

VI TILBYDER

  • et meningsfuldt og alsidigt arbejde midt i København
  • en usædvanlig spændvidde i opgaverne, fra den store kirkelige begivenhed til den helt almindelige hverdag
  • gode kolleger med en uformel omgangstone og godt humør
  • en arbejdsplads, hvor praktiske opgaver, fællesskab og ånd følges ad
  • et stærkt arbejdsfællesskab, hvor opgaverne løses sammen, og hvor du som ledende kirketjener har det overordnede ansvar for at skabe retning og sammenhæng
  • fleksible arbejdstider efter vagtplan, herunder aften- og weekendarbejde.


LØN- OG ANSÆTTELSESVILKÅR

Arbejdstiden er 37 timer om ugen. Stillingen indebærer skiftende arbejdstider, herunder aften- og weekendarbejde.

Ansættelse sker ved Vor Frue Sogns Menighedsråd, Nørregade 8, København K. Ansættelsen er omfattet af Fællesoverenskomsten mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer (OAO-S) og Organisationsaftalen for kirkefunktionærer med kerneopgaver som kirketjener eller graver indgået mellem Kirkeministeriet og Danmarks Kirketjenerforening og det tilhørende protokollat for kirketjenere. Nuværende tjenestemandsansatte kirketjenere har ret til at bevare deres tjenestemandsstatus ved ansættelse med direkte overgang. Der skal i så fald ske en klassificering af stillingen.

Det er en betingelse, at den obligatoriske 5 ugers uddannelse for kirketjenere gennemføres indenfor 2 år efter ansættelsens start. Årslønnen aftales indenfor intervallet 324.667 kr. – 408.841 kr. (nutidskroner). Der er rådighedsforpligtelse til stillingen. Rådighedstillægget udgør årligt 33.231,- kr. (nutidskroner). OK tillæg på 1.401,- kr. (nutidskroner) pr. år. Aftale om indplacering i lønintervallet indgås mellem menighedsrådet og Danmarks Kirketjenerforening.

Nærmere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til sekretariatsleder (daglig leder) Line Marschner på telefonnummer 3122 6639. Ansøgningen med relevante bilag indsendes via link i jobportalen. Ansøgninger modtaget pr. mail vil ikke komme i betragtning. Der vil blive afholdt samtaler 17. november. Anden samtale afholdes samme uge.

title: Performance Improvement Manager - PN 20099235 (Medicaid Health Systems Administrator 1)
description: Who We Are Investing in opportunities for Ohioans that work for every person and every family in every corner of our state is at the hallmark of Governor DeWine’s agenda for Ohio’s future. To ensure Ohio is “the best place to live, work, raise and family and start a business,” we must have strong schools, a great quality of life, and compassion for those who need our help. Ohio Department of Medicaid plays a unique and necessary role in supporting the governor’s vision. As the single state Medicaid agency responsible for administering high-quality, person-centric healthcare, the department is committed to supporting the health and wellbeing of nearly one in every four Ohioans served. We do so by: • Delivering a personalized care experience to more than three million people served. • Improving care for children and adults with complex behavioral health needs. • Working collectively with our partners and providers to measurably strengthen wellness and health outcomes. • Streamlining administrative burdens so doctors and healthcare providers have more time for patient care. • Ensuring financial transparency and operational accountability across all Medicaid programs and services. What You'll Do Office: Health Innovation Quality Bureau: Health Research Quality Classification: Medicaid Health Systems Administrator 1 (PN: 20099235) Job Overview: The Performance Improvement Manager is an integral part of the Ohio Department of Medicaid's (ODM's) Health Innovation Quality team. As Performance Improvement Manager, your responsibilities will include: Managing the development, implementation, and reporting of quality improvement projects (QIPs) for targeted Medicaid populations (i.e. Children with Chronic Conditions) Directing the design of Children with Chronic Conditions QIPs, to include (but not limited to) a focus on improving disparate outcomes and improvement of care transitions for consumers with specific disease conditions Directing and/or conducting research evidence-based interventions/strategies for Children with Chronic Conditions QIP topics Coordinating the identification of applicable quality measures and the collection and analysis of health services data to support the design and evaluation of Children with Chronic Conditions QIPs for the OhioRISE Plan Developing a methodology and implementation timeline for monitoring and evaluating Children with Chronic Conditions QIPs, including outcome measurement and impact on population health Reviewing applicable rules, policies, laws and guidelines to ensure compliance with Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) rules regulations, as well as all applicable state regulations, rules and laws Managing and directing contracted consultant staff and services supporting the design, development, implementation, evaluation and reporting related to the quality improvement initiatives for the PIHP Formulating policy and recommending legislative changes for Children with Chronic Conditions QIPs. Additional Information The Ohio Department of Medicaid does not provide employment-based visa sponsorship. Compensation is as listed on the posting unless required by legislation or union contract. The work location of this position is 50 West Town Street, Columbus, Ohio 43215. You will be required to report to this work location full-time, if selected. Travel required, as needed. Must provide own transportation. Or, in order to operate a state vehicle, you must have a valid driver's license from state of residence. Resumes and/or attachments are not reviewed. Therefore, please provide detail in the work experience section of your application.

title: Tømrer til nybyggede huse i Taastrup
description:
Er du tømrer og vil du have firmabil, fast arbejde og nye huse?

Vi mangler en tømrer til nybyg og renovering i Taastrup.

Du lander i en større byggeorganisation, hvor nye huse fylder hverdagen. Arbejdet ligger på Sjælland, og opgaverne handler især om individuelle boliger, hvor håndværket skal være ensartet fra hus til hus. Der er mange fagfolk omkring byggerierne, så du bliver en del af et setup, hvor planlægning og aflevering betyder noget.

Det her er for dig, der gerne vil arbejde med rigtige byggeopgaver og faste rammer. Du får firmabil, fastansættelse og en løn på 215-235 kr. i timen. Kørekort er nødvendigt, fordi du skal kunne møde ind på pladserne.

Det får du

Løn: 215-235 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Taastrup og omegn

Kolleger: Cirka 250 ansatte

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Nybyg, renovering og byggepladser

Din hverdag

Dagen er bygget op omkring planlagte byggeopgaver på nye huse. Du følger aftalerne på pladsen, koordinerer med de andre fag og får tømrerarbejdet gjort klar til næste trin. Når renovering er på programmet, handler det om at få det eksisterende til at spille med det nye.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Arbejder med nybyg af huse
  • Udfører tømrerarbejde på byggepladser
  • Tager del i renoveringsopgaver, når de ligger i planen
  • Monterer vinduer og døre efter mål
  • Arbejder med tag, konstruktioner og indvendige løsninger

Her handler godt håndværk om, at kvaliteten er den samme hele vejen igennem. Det kræver, at du tager ansvar for det du afleverer, og siger til hvis noget ikke stemmer.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du skal ikke være ekspert i hvert eneste hjørne af faget. Men du skal kunne stå inde for det du afleverer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har mindst 3 års erfaring som tømrer
  • Har kørekort
  • Møder stabilt og tager ansvar for dine aftaler
  • Kan arbejde med både nybyg og renovering
  • Siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det vigtigste er, at du er stabil, fagligt ordentlig og kan tage fat uden at skulle have alt forklaret flere gange.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte hurtigst muligt.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Du får gratis Wolt+, WashWorld og Tv2Play abonnementer.

Du får ét ugentlig spin på vores app, hvor du kan vinde alt fra rejser til elektronik.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

Tag fat nu - vi skal bruge en tømrer mere i Taastrup, og det kunne sagtens være dig.

title: Coating Engineer
description:
ABOUT US

Join a Global Photonics Leader Engineering Solutions from the Deep Ocean to Outer Space!


G&H is a world leader in photonics technology, delivering advanced optical systems, components, and solutions that support mission-critical applications across aerospace, defense, life sciences, industrial manufacturing, medical technology, and research markets. Our Rochester, NY facility specializes in the design and manufacture of precision optical components and coatings that enable customers to push the boundaries of innovation.


Through a commitment to technical excellence, continuous improvement, and customer satisfaction, G&H provides employees with the opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies while collaborating with highly skilled engineering and manufacturing professionals in a dynamic, growth-oriented environment.


THE OPPORTUNITY

We are seeking a highly skilled and hands-on Optical Coating Engineer to join our team in Rochester, NY. In this role, you will lead the design, development, optimization, and production support of advanced thin-film optical coatings used in optics, photonics, and laser applications. Working closely with engineering and manufacturing teams, you will drive coating performance, process improvements, and production success while ensuring products meet customer requirements and industry standards. This position is ideal for an engineer who enjoys both technical problem-solving and hands-on involvement in manufacturing operations.


WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Optical Coating Design & Development

  • Design, model, and optimize thin-film coatings for optical components including lenses, mirrors, filters, beamsplitters, and prisms.
  • Utilize optical coating design software such as TFCalc to simulate, analyze, and refine coating performance.
  • Evaluate coating materials and deposition processes to achieve required optical, environmental, and durability specifications.

Process Engineering & Manufacturing Support

  • Troubleshoot coating uniformity, adhesion, and performance issues during deposition and production.
  • Partner with manufacturing teams to transition successful coating designs into repeatable production processes.
  • Support production activities as needed, including working with Coating Technicians on loading parts, program execution, and inspection activities.

Testing, Quality & Continuous Improvement

  • Conduct and oversee optical performance testing including transmittance, reflectance, and durability evaluations.
  • Analyze process and test data to identify opportunities for performance improvements and corrective actions.
  • Ensure coatings meet customer specifications, internal quality requirements, and applicable industry standards.

Equipment & Technical Leadership

  • Support the maintenance, calibration, and optimization of coating equipment and vacuum deposition systems.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues related to coating materials, processes, and equipment performance.
  • Train and mentor technicians and production personnel on coating processes, equipment operation, and safety procedures.

WHAT YOU BRING

Qualifications & Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Optical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Engineering, or a related technical field preferred.
  • 5-10 years of experience in optical coating design, process development, or related photonics manufacturing environments.
  • Hands-on experience with thin-film deposition technologies, including electron beam (E-beam) deposition.
  • Proficiency with optical coating design and simulation software such as TFCalc.
  • Strong understanding of thin-film optics, coating characterization methods, and optical performance measurement.
  • Knowledge of optical coating materials, substrate selection, and environmental durability requirements.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex coating, manufacturing, and equipment-related challenges.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data interpretation skills.
  • Experience working in cleanroom and vacuum chamber environments preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across engineering and manufacturing teams.

Certifications (optional)

  • Certification in Optical Coatings or a related field is a plus.

G&H Benefits Include

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match
  • Paid vacation and company holidays
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Professional development and career growth opportunities

If you're ready to make a meaningful impact in a world-class photonics environment and help advance next-generation optical technologies, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Lead Consultant (Fusion Service VBCS / Redwood Developer)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Consultant (Fusion Service VBCS / Redwood Developer) based in India.

In this role, you will lead the development, customization, and enhancement of Oracle Fusion Service applications using Oracle Visual Builder Cloud Service (VBCS) and Redwood UI technologies. You will transform business requirements into scalable, user-friendly solutions that improve service workflows and customer experiences. Working across technical and functional teams, you will design modern interfaces, develop custom application extensions, and integrate enterprise systems through REST APIs and Oracle services. You will play a key role in ensuring application performance, security, and maintainability while following Oracle's recommended development practices. The position also offers opportunities to lead technical discussions, mentor developers, and contribute to successful implementations and production rollouts. You will join a collaborative, distributed working environment that values technical excellence, continuous improvement, and flexible work arrangements.

Accountabilities

  • Lead the design, development, customization, and enhancement of Oracle Fusion Service applications using VBCS and Redwood technologies.
  • Develop and extend user interfaces using Oracle Visual Builder and Visual Builder Studio (VB Studio), leveraging supported extension and personalization frameworks.
  • Implement Redwood UX designs and build custom pages, forms, layouts, business logic, and interactive features that improve service workflows.
  • Integrate Oracle Fusion Service with REST APIs, business objects, business events, integration services, and external applications to enable reliable data exchange.
  • Configure service-related functionality, including service requests, customer information, and associated workflows.
  • Collaborate with functional consultants, solution architects, and business stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
  • Lead technical design discussions, conduct code reviews, perform unit testing, and oversee debugging, troubleshooting, and defect resolution.
  • Support system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), deployments, production troubleshooting, and post-go-live activities.
  • Ensure application performance, security, maintainability, and compliance with Oracle development standards and best practices.
  • Mentor junior developers, share technical expertise, and provide guidance to the development team.
  • Contribute to ongoing improvements, technical documentation, and regression testing associated with Oracle quarterly updates.

Requirements

  • A graduate degree in any discipline, with at least 3 years of relevant experience in Oracle CX / Oracle Sales Cloud.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Oracle Visual Builder Cloud Service (VBCS) and Oracle Fusion Cloud Redwood UI development, including extensions and personalization.
  • Practical knowledge of Visual Builder Studio, business rules, action chains, variables, and service connections.
  • Experience consuming Oracle Fusion REST APIs and integrating Oracle applications with external systems.
  • Proficiency in JavaScript, JSON, HTML, and CSS, with a solid understanding of application development and debugging.
  • Good understanding of Oracle Fusion Service and Customer Experience (CX) application architecture, including service-related functionality and workflows.
  • Experience with application troubleshooting, performance optimization, technical documentation, testing, and defect resolution.
  • Ability to lead technical discussions, review designs and code, and coordinate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions.
  • Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), integration patterns, Oracle Fusion security, roles, privileges, and authentication mechanisms is an advantage.
  • Familiarity with Oracle SaaS implementations, rollout projects, quarterly updates, regression testing, and production support is preferred.
  • Knowledge of Oracle's supported Redwood extensibility frameworks and recommended development practices is highly desirable.

Benefits

  • Employment type: Full-time, permanent position.
  • Working hours: 40 hours per week.
  • Work arrangement: Remote working opportunity in India.
  • Work-life balance: Flexible working arrangements designed to support professional commitments and personal well-being.
  • Professional development: Opportunities to deepen expertise in Oracle Fusion Service, VBCS, Redwood UI, and enterprise application integrations.
  • Technical leadership: The opportunity to lead development initiatives, influence technical decisions, and mentor fellow developers.
  • Collaborative environment: Work with distributed teams and cross-functional stakeholders on enterprise technology solutions.
  • Compensation and benefits: Salary, healthcare coverage, and other benefits are subject to the partner company's employment package and policies.

Dit ga je doen

Ben jij een Senior DevOps Engineer met een hart voor Data Science platformen en -tooling

Als Senior Devops Engineer zet je jouw technische én sociale vaardigheden in voor de voortzetting, verbetering en uitbreiding van meerdere data science platformen binnen Defensie. In deze rol ben je verantwoordelijk voor ontwerpen en realiseren en beheren van technische oplossingen binnen onze platformen. Je zet je schouders graag onder complexe problemen en weet deze om te buigen tot simpele oplossingen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior DevOps Engineer Platformen ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, bouwen en doorontwikkelen van een robuust, schaalbaar en veilig platformlandschap binnen een complexe organisatie zoals Defensie. Je vervult een leidende rol op het snijvlak van techniek en business en neemt beslissingen op basis van zowel technische haalbaarheid als businesswaarde.

Je neemt eigenaarschap van hetgeen waar je aan werkt en stemt je keuzes af (samen) met je teamgenoten, product owners, architecten en andere betrokken partijen. Dankzij je ervaring in stakeholdermanagement binnen complexe organisaties weet je je eigen belangen en die van het team te behartigen richting de stakeholders. Je fungeert daarbij regelmatig als sparringpartner en coach voor de overige collega’s in je team.

Ontwerpen, implementeren en beheren van verbeteringen aan Kubernetes gebaseerde platformen is iets waar je warm voor looopt. Hierbij zet je je diepgaande kennis in van (Open Source) CNCF applicaties, scaling, networking, RBAC, operators en CRD’s. Je werkt volgens GitOps-principes en richt applicatie- en platformdeployments in met ArgoCD, inclusief multi-environment setups, sync-strategieën en rollback-scenario’s.


Je bouwt en optimaliseert CI/CD-pipelines met tools zoals GitLab CI en GitHub Actions en automatiseert infrastructuur en platformcomponenten met tools als Ansible en Helm en concepten als GitOps (ArgoCD).

Daarnaast heb je ervaring met het werken in een on-premise omgeving en de eigenaardigheden die daarbij komen kijken waarbij je niet terugdeinst voor zaken als virtualisatie, storage, networking en firewalls.

Monitoring en observability richt je professioneel in met Opentelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager en ELK/EFK, zodat betrouwbaarheid en performance continu inzichtelijk zijn. Je werkt volgens SRE-principes, past reliability patterns toe, begeleidt incident response en faciliteert blameless postmortems.

Security is integraal onderdeel van je werk: je past security hardening toe in je code, orchestreert network policies weet alles van secrets management. Daarnaast heb je zeer ruime ervaring met container image management (Docker/OCI), Linux troubleshooting, databases zoals PostgreSQL en MySQL (inclusief operators en back-ups) en het oplossen van complexe problemen in gedistribueerde systemen.

Tot slot draag je actief bij aan kennisdeling binnen het team, begeleid je medior en junior engineers en blijf je continu werken aan de verbetering van het platform en ook jezelf.

Dit vragen wij

Wat vragen we?

Je hebt diepe kennis van techniek en je weet jezelf te redden in een innovatieve, complexe en veranderende omgeving. Je positieve houding richting je werk en anderen en je sociale voelsprieten begeleiden je moeiteloos door je werkdag. Als er iemand aan je bureau staat dan spring je bij met kennis en kunde. Door je flexibiliteit, vindingrijkheid en can-do attitude weet je vrijwel elk probleem op te lossen. Kom je er zelf niet uit? Dan schroom je niet om hulp te vragen bij je teamgenoten of om je hulpvraag uit te zetten bij je netwerk zowel binnen als buiten de organisatie.

Dit neem je mee aan relevante werkervaring:
-Een HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur richting softwareontwikkeling, informatica of vergelijkbaar. Zo nodig toetsbaar in een assessment;
-Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden (in het Nederlands);
-Ruime ervaring met het werken in Agile teams;
-Ervaring en affiniteit met het coachen van medior en junior IT specialisten;
-Sterke troubleshooting-vaardigheden voor complexe IT systemen;
-Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in het DevOps vakgebied;
-Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met het werken met Linux distributies;
-Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met containerisatie en Kubernetes;
-Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met Cloud native tools en technologieën;
-Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring met automatisering en CI/CD zoals Gitlab CI;
-Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring met GitOps tooling zoals ArgoCD;
-Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring met Observability tooling zoals Opentelemetry;
-Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring met Python en/of Go;
-Werkervaring in innovatieve omgevingen;

Extra punten als je ..:
-Ervaring hebt met IT-oplossingen binnen een operationele of Defensie-omgeving;
-Ervaring hebt met data science platformen en GPU workloads;
-Ervaring hebt met on-premise infrastructuur;
-Ervaring hebt met (container) security best-practices;
-Je beschikt over een CKAD, CKA en/of CKS certificering;

Dit bieden we nog meer

Defensie hecht sterk aan persoonlijke groei en kent goede studiefaciliteiten, hierdoor sta je nooit stil. Je krijgt alle ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en door te groeien.

Buiten het salaris hebben we het individueel keuzebudget (IKB) dat bestaat uit 16,33% van het bruto jaarsalaris. Je kunt het IKB laten uitbetalen wanneer jij wenst, het gebruiken om extra verlofuren te kopen of het inzetten voor fiscale doeleinden. Naast een pensioenregeling bij het ABP ontvang je maandelijks een tegemoetkoming voor woon-werkverkeer of kun je onder gunstige voorwaarden kiezen voor een OV-abonnement met onbeperkt reizen door heel Nederland.

Het genoemde salaris is gebaseerd op een volledige werkweek van 38 uur. Je inschaling wordt gebaseerd op je werkervaring en opleidingsachtergrond. Het salaris ligt tussen de € 6.244,93 en € 8.067,96 (schaal 12).

Bijzonderheden

-Een veiligheidsonderzoek maakt deel uit van de selectieprocedure. De startdatum staat daarom niet vast.
-Een referentiecheck en assessment kunnen onderdeel uitmaken van de selectieprocedure.
-Om in aanmerking te komen voor deze functie moet je afkomstig zijn uit een land uit de Europese Economische Ruimte. Mocht dit niet het geval zijn dan beschik je over een gecombineerde vergunning voor verblijf en arbeid (GVVA).

Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld. Wij verzoeken vriendelijk om geen ongevraagde aanbiedingen, telefoontjes of e-mails te sturen. Dank u voor uw begrip.

Meer over de functiegroep

Organisatienaam

Ministerie van Defensie

Organisatieomschrijving

Visie
Het Commando Materieel & IT (COMMIT) ondersteunt de transitie naar een informatiegestuurde en technologisch hoogwaardige krijgsmacht met het beste materieel en de beste IT. Ons COMMITment is groot om de cruciale rol te versterken als strategisch partner van de Commandant der Strijdkrachten, van de operationele onderdelen en van internationale partners. COMMIT vergroot de impact van de ondersteuning door een integrale en innovatieve aanpak van materieel- en IT-projecten, (wapen)systeemmanagement en ketenlogistiek.

Wij investeren in de kwaliteit van onze mensen en de flexibiliteit en diversiteit van het personeelsbestand. De belangrijkste capaciteiten van COMMIT zijn de kennis en ervaring van ons personeel. Om de krijgsmacht sneller te voorzien van materieel en IT zetten wij naast technologische innovatie in op proces- en sociale innovatie op het gebied van projectvoering, inkoop en afstoting van defensiematerieel en personele en logistieke ondersteuning.

Het uitvoeren van innovatieve projecten vraagt om meer samenwerking met het bedrijfsleven, kennisinstituten en andere overheidsorganisaties en maatschappelijke instanties. Onder de vlag van C-COMMIT als National Armaments Director (NAD) ontwikkelen en versterken wij ook de internationale samenwerking op het gebied van materieel en IT (NAVO, EU, multinationaal en bilateraal).

Missie
COMMIT levert de krijgsmacht het beste materieel en de beste IT.

Extra
COMMIT is van iedereen en voor iedereen, we zijn ervan overtuigd dat we met een diverse en inclusieve organisatie onze taak, verbinding maken tussen willen en kunnen, het beste kunnen uitvoeren wanneer ons personeel een afspiegeling is van de maatschappij. Wij nodigen je daarom graag uit om te solliciteren op deze functie!

Over Defensie
Defensie zet zich in voor de belangen, welvaart en vrijheid van Nederland. We zijn dagelijks actief in binnen- en buitenland. Onze wereldwijde inzet versterkt de internationale samenwerking en zorgt ervoor dat mensen zich in vrijheid kunnen ontplooien. Nu en in de toekomst.

Bij het ministerie van Defensie werken ongeveer 79 duizend mensen direct en indirect aan vrede en veiligheid. Het ministerie bestaat uit het Commando Materieel & IT (COMMIT), de Bestuursstaf (het departement), de Koninklijke Marine, de Koninklijke Landmacht, de Koninklijke Luchtmacht, de Koninklijke Marechaussee, het Defensie Ondersteuningscommando (DOSCO).

Waar ga je werken?

Je komt terecht in het Service Team DATA, onderdeel van de afdeling DATA binnen de Directie Kennis & Innovatie van COMMIT. Hier werk je samen met onder andere product owners, front-end developers, DevOps engineers en beheerders aan toekomstgerichte oplossingen voor Defensie.

De Directie Kennis & Innovatie (K&I) speelt een sleutelrol binnen Defensie: wij zorgen ervoor dat onze militairen beschikken over de nieuwste technologieën op het gebied van materieel en IT. Door te investeren in kennisopbouw én innovatie zorgen we ervoor dat Defensie snel kan inspelen op veranderingen en technologische ontwikkelingen. Zo dragen we bij aan een organisatie die wendbaar en voorbereid is op de uitdagingen van morgen.

Binnen het Service Team DATA richten we ons specifiek op het ontwikkelen en beheren van defensiebrede data science-platformen. We zorgen voor veilige, goed beheerde omgevingen en ontwikkelen de tools en standaarden die nodig zijn om geavanceerde datatoepassingen mogelijk te maken. Zo ondersteunen we collega’s in de hele organisatie bij het bouwen van datagedreven oplossingen.

Kortom, je werkt in een omgeving waar technologie, innovatie en maatschappelijke relevantie samenkomen — en waarin jouw expertise het verschil maakt voor de veiligheid van Nederland.
