Här får du en unik möjlighet att vara med från start, forma rutiner och processer och successivt växa in i rollen som ekonomiansvarig.

Om rollen

Som ekonomiansvarig får du en bred och varierad roll där du blir en viktig del av bolagets fortsatta utveckling. Företaget har tidigare hanterat stora delar av ekonomiarbetet tillsammans med en extern redovisningsbyrå, men vill nu bygga upp en intern ekonomifunktion.

Det innebär att du får vara med och skapa struktur, utveckla rutiner och forma hur ekonomiarbetet ska fungera framåt. Du kommer att arbeta nära bolagets VD och successivt få ett större ansvar för både den löpande ekonomin och den ekonomiska uppföljningen.

Vi söker inte nödvändigtvis dig som redan har haft en roll som ekonomiansvarig. Kanske arbetar du idag som redovisningsekonom, ekonom eller junior controller och känner att du är redo för nästa steg? Här får du möjlighet att bredda din kompetens, ta mer ansvar och utvecklas tillsammans med verksamheten.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:

  • Arbeta med löpande redovisning, avstämningar och ekonomisk uppföljning.
  • Vara delaktig i månadsbokslut, rapportering och årsbokslut.
  • Arbeta med budget, prognoser och uppföljning av ekonomiska nyckeltal.
  • Vara delaktig i löneprocessen och säkerställa att den fungerar på ett bra sätt.
  • Utveckla och effektivisera ekonomiska rutiner, processer och arbetssätt.
  • Ta fram ekonomiska underlag och stötta VD i ekonomiska frågor och beslut.
  • Successivt ta ett större helhetsansvar för bolagets ekonomifunktion.

Vi söker dig som

Vi tror att du har några års erfarenhet av ekonomiarbete och en god grund inom redovisning. Du behöver inte kunna allt från dag ett, men du ska ha en vilja att lära dig, utvecklas och ta ett större ansvar.

Kanske har du arbetat några år som redovisningsekonom och känner dig redo att ta ett bredare grepp om ekonomin? Eller så har du en bakgrund inom revision och vill ta steget till en mer verksamhetsnära roll där du får vara med och påverka på riktigt.

Vi ser gärna att du har:

  • Några års erfarenhet av redovisning, revision eller liknande ekonomiarbete.
  • God förståelse för redovisning, avstämningar och bokslutsarbete.
  • Ett intresse för ekonomisk analys, rapportering och uppföljning.
  • Eftergymnasial utbildning inom ekonomi.
  • Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Har du dessutom erfarenhet av budget, prognoser eller lönehantering är det meriterande, men inget krav.

Om anställningen

Detta är en direktrekrytering där du blir anställd hos vår kund. OIO ansvarar för rekryteringsprocessen och vi önskar därför att alla frågor kring tjänsten går via oss.

Placering: Göteborgsområdet Omfattning: Heltid Start: Enligt överenskommelse Arbetstider: Utgångspunkten är 06.00–15.15, i linje med verksamhetens arbetstider.

Om OIO

Vår passion är att hjälpa dig till rätt roll och arbetsplats. Vi är samtidigt medvetna om att du är kräsen och väljer med omsorg inför nästa karriärsteg, det skulle vi också göra. Därför arbetar vi dedikerat i rekryteringsprocessen för att lära känna dig och dina ambitioner. Vi tror nämligen att människor på rätt plats har större chans att nå sin fulla potential. Genom schyssta, okrångliga anställningsvillkor samt ett närvarande ledarskap arbetar vi därefter aktivt med ditt engagemang och din utveckling. På så vis strävar vi efter att bli en självklar karriärpartner för dig. We are as picky as you are.

title: Tømrer til tagarbejde og service i Esbjerg
description:
Vil du have firmabil, frihed under ansvar og godt sammenhold?

Vi mangler en tømrer til tagarbejde, renovering og service i Esbjerg.

Du lander i et stort tømrer- og snedkersetup, hvor hverdagen spænder fra større entrepriser til små serviceopgaver. Arbejdet ligger i Esbjerg og omegn, og kunderne er både private og erhverv. Her er der plads til både tagarbejde, nybyg, renovering og spjæld, så du får en hverdag med bredde i faget.

Rollen passer til dig, der har prøvet lidt af hvert og gerne vil bruge din erfaring uden at blive pakket ind i for mange led. Du får frihed under ansvar, men du står ikke alene når en opgave skal vendes med en makker. Sammenholdet er en del af pakken, og det mærkes især når der skal tages fat.

Det får du

Løn: 200-260 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Esbjerg og omegn

Kolleger: Cirka 130 ansatte

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Nybyg, renovering, service og tagarbejde

Din hverdag

Dagen bliver lagt efter opgavens type: et hurtigt spjæld skal gribes anderledes an end en tagopgave eller en renovering. Du aftaler rækkefølgen med dem du arbejder sammen med, og du siger til hvis noget ikke stemmer. Firmabilen gør det nemt at rykke mellem opgaverne uden bøvl.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Arbejder med nybyg på bolig og erhverv
  • Løser renoveringsopgaver fra start til aflevering
  • Tager spjæld og serviceopgaver når de lander
  • Arbejder med tagarbejde på større og mindre opgaver

Det er ikke et sted, hvor du kun får én type opgave igen og igen. Du skal kunne tage ansvar for dit eget arbejde, men der er folk omkring dig, når noget skal koordineres eller løses i makkerpar.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du behøver ikke kunne alt. Men du skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine aftaler.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har mindst 5 års erfaring som tømrer
  • Har kørekort
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og i makkerpar
  • Møder stabilt og holder dine aftaler
  • Siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med nybyg, renovering, service eller tagarbejde. Men det vigtigste er, at du kan lide en hverdag, hvor du selv tager styringen.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte om 1 uge.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Du får gratis Wolt+, WashWorld og Tv2Play abonnementer.

Du får ét ugentlig spin på vores app, hvor du kan vinde alt fra rejser til elektronik.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

Tag fat nu - vi skal bruge en tømrer mere i Esbjerg, og det kunne sagtens være dig.

title: Sr. Program Manager, Business Continuity Management
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Program Manager, Business Continuity Management based in Canada.

As a Senior Program Manager, Business Continuity Management, you will lead the execution and continuous improvement of enterprise-wide business resilience strategies, helping critical functions maintain operations during disruptions. You will oversee the full business continuity lifecycle, from risk assessments and business impact analyses to recovery planning, testing, and remediation. Working closely with business stakeholders, technology leaders, and external partners, you will ensure that resilience plans are practical, effective, and aligned with organizational requirements. Your work will strengthen operational readiness, improve recovery times, and reduce business risks. This fully remote, full-time contract opportunity is ideal for an experienced professional with strong analytical skills, a hands-on approach, and a passion for building resilient business operations.

Accountabilities:

In this role, you will drive enterprise-wide business continuity initiatives, coordinate resilience activities, and ensure that recovery strategies remain effective and compliant with relevant standards and requirements. Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Drive stakeholder commitment, ownership, accountability, and collaboration to achieve business continuity objectives.

  • Partner with business and technology teams to design, document, and implement recovery strategies that mitigate operational disruptions.

  • Lead risk assessments and business impact analyses to identify critical functions, vulnerabilities, and recovery priorities.

  • Develop and maintain resilience plans, contingency procedures, and recovery strategies aligned with Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs), Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs), and service-level agreements (SLAs).

  • Coordinate and facilitate business continuity tests and exercises, including walkthroughs, tabletop exercises, simulations, and full-scale scenarios.

  • Validate recovery strategies, identify gaps, communicate findings to leadership, and oversee remediation activities.

  • Monitor annual compliance, regulatory, and reporting requirements while producing compliance reports, performance metrics, and trend analyses.

  • Coordinate third-party resilience audits and assessments, including the review, evaluation, and summarization of technical documentation.

  • Maintain alignment with established policies, standards, and procedures across all business continuity deliverables.

  • Support training, governance, and continuous improvement initiatives throughout the business resilience lifecycle.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate brings extensive hands-on experience in business continuity management, IT disaster recovery, and enterprise resilience, combined with strong stakeholder management and program execution capabilities. You should be comfortable translating complex technical and operational requirements into actionable recovery plans. The following qualifications and skills are essential:

    • Deep practical knowledge of the complete business continuity management lifecycle, including risk assessments, business impact analyses, recovery strategy design, planning, testing, and reporting.

    • Extensive experience conducting resilience audits and assessments, evaluating technical documentation, identifying control gaps, and summarizing findings.

    • Strong knowledge of business continuity, information availability, disaster recovery, and business recovery planning best practices, policies, and procedures.

    • Familiarity with computer operating systems, computer networking, data communications technologies, IT strategy, and information systems planning.

    • Knowledge of relevant standards, frameworks, and regulatory guidance, including ISO 22301, HIPAA, PCI, IOSCO, and applicable client and U.S. Department of Homeland Security guidance.

    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think creatively, proactively, and independently.

    • Excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to facilitate meetings, prepare reports, manage data, and communicate findings to leadership.

    • Outstanding organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple initiatives, delegate effectively, and meet delivery targets.

    • Proven ability to build rapport and establish trust with business and technology leaders, securing cooperation across diverse stakeholder groups.

    • A self-motivated, results-oriented approach, demonstrating initiative, ethical behavior, integrity, accountability, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

      • Benefits:

      • Hourly compensation: $70.01–$72.71 per hour on a W-2 basis.

      • Work arrangement: 100% remote.

      • Contract duration: Approximately 3 months, with a full-time schedule.

      • Working hours: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

      • Medical insurance: Four medical insurance plan options for eligible full-time employees working at least 30 hours per week.

      • Dental and vision insurance for eligible employees.

      • Additional coverage: Critical illness insurance, voluntary permanent life insurance, and accident insurance.

      • Employee perks: Access to additional benefits and workplace perks.

title: Linux Engineer (24*7 Operations)
description:
Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. Want to be part of it?

Role Summary

We are looking for a Linux Engineer to support our 24/7 Operations environment on a rotational shift basis. You will be responsible for monitoring and supporting Linux-based production systems, responding to alerts and incidents, troubleshooting infrastructure issues, and ensuring services remain stable and available.

You will work closely with Shift Leads, senior engineers, application teams, network teams, database teams, and other support functions to resolve incidents within SLA and maintain reliable production services.

Key Responsibilities:

Linux Operations

  • Provide L1/L2 support for Linux servers including RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu and Amazon Linux.
  • Troubleshoot CPU, memory, disk space, disk I/O, system load, network connectivity and service-related issues.
  • Manage Linux users, groups, permissions, file systems and access.
  • Monitor and manage services using systemd/systemctl.
  • Perform filesystem and LVM administration, including monitoring capacity and supporting filesystem extensions.
  • Troubleshoot networking issues involving DNS, TCP/IP, routing, ports, firewalls and SSH connectivity.
  • Analyse system and application logs to identify errors and service failures.
  • Manage cron jobs and scheduled operational tasks.
  • Support package updates, patching, server reboots and routine maintenance activities.
  • Perform approved production changes following change management procedures.

    • Monitoring and Incident Management

    • Monitor infrastructure and application alerts using tools such as CloudWatch, Prometheus/Grafana or Datadog.
    • Respond to alerts and incidents promptly and perform initial troubleshooting.
    • Identify recurring or false-positive alerts and raise recommendations for alert tuning.
    • Create, update and manage incidents through the appropriate ticketing system.
    • Work on incidents based on priority, business impact and SLA.
    • Escalate complex or critical issues to Shift Leads, L3 support, engineering or relevant resolver teams.
    • Participate in major incident and bridge calls when required.
    • Provide clear technical findings and regular updates during ongoing incidents.
    • Ensure incidents are properly documented before resolution and closure.

      • Operational Checks

      • Perform scheduled health checks for Linux servers and production services.
      • Validate CPU, memory, filesystem, network and critical process/service status.
      • Monitor backups, scheduled jobs and other operational activities where applicable.
      • Perform pre-change and post-change validation.
      • Carry out application and infrastructure connectivity checks following approved runbooks.
      • Ensure outstanding alerts, incidents and operational risks are clearly communicated during shift handovers.

        • Scripting and Automation

        • Write and maintain Bash scripts for routine administration and monitoring activities.
        • Use Python where appropriate for operational automation.
        • Identify repetitive manual tasks that can be automated.
        • Support improvements to monitoring and operational scripts.
        • Follow scripting, testing and change control standards before implementing automation in production.

          • Documentation and Knowledge Management

          • Create and maintain operational runbooks, SOPs and troubleshooting guides.
          • Document troubleshooting steps and resolutions for recurring incidents.
          • Update knowledge base articles when new issues or solutions are identified.
          • Ensure accurate documentation of incidents, changes and operational activities.
          • Share technical knowledge with other Operations team members.

            • Shift Operations

            • Work as part of a 24/7 rotational shift team, including nights, weekends and public holidays.
            • Take ownership of assigned incidents, service requests, alerts and operational tasks.
            • Follow structured shift handover procedures.
            • Clearly communicate open issues, pending actions, planned changes and risks to the incoming shift.
            • Escalate critical issues to the Shift Lead without unnecessary delay.
            • Support priority incidents until resolution or successful handover.

              • Process and Compliance

              • Follow ITIL practices for incident, problem and change management.
              • Follow approved change procedures for production activities.
              • Comply with security, access management and infrastructure standards.
              • Ensure privileged access and administrative activities follow organisational policies.
              • Participate in root cause analysis and post-incident reviews where required.
              • Identify opportunities to improve system reliability and reduce operational workload.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 4+ years of experience in Linux administration, infrastructure operations, NOC or production support.
  • Experience supporting systems in a 24/7 production environment.
  • Strong hands-on Linux administration experience.
  • Good knowledge of RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu and/or Amazon Linux.
  • Strong understanding of Linux command-line troubleshooting.
  • Experience with Linux file systems and LVM.
  • Good understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, SSH, routing, ports and firewall concepts.
  • Experience managing systemd services, processes, users, groups and permissions.
  • Strong log analysis and troubleshooting skills.
  • Experience monitoring CPU, memory, disk, system load and network performance.
  • Experience with monitoring tools such as CloudWatch, Nagios, Zabbix, Prometheus/Grafana or Datadog.
  • Experience using ticketing/service management platforms such as ServiceNow or Jira Service Management.
  • Working knowledge of ITIL incident, problem and change management.
  • Bash scripting skills; Python scripting knowledge is desirable.
  • Experience supporting patching, maintenance and production changes.
  • Ability to troubleshoot incidents calmly and methodically under pressure.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to provide clear technical updates and shift handovers.
  • Willingness to work rotational shifts, including nights, weekends and public holidays.

Desirable Skills

  • AWS or other cloud infrastructure experience.
  • Experience with VMware or Nutanix environments.
  • Knowledge of Ansible or other configuration/automation tools.
  • Familiarity with Git and source control.
  • Basic database and SQL troubleshooting knowledge.
  • Experience with backup and recovery operations.
  • Understanding of high-availability and disaster recovery environments.
  • Relevant Linux certification such as RHCSA/RHCE or equivalent.
Why join us?
We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.
An inclusive environment to thrive
We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day.
Be rewarded for your efforts
We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.
Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.
We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.
"At Keyloop, AI is a daily ally: We encourage and train every employee to use our AI tools to boost their creativity and productivity."

title: Har du lyst til at overtage en sød 2. klasse? Dansk og kontaktlærer søges til Ordrup Skole
description:
En hverdag med faglighed, fællesskab og Co-Teaching i praksis

Ordrup Skole søger en engageret og kreativ dansklærer til 2. årgang med tiltrædelse den 1. december 2026. Vi leder efter en kollega, der brænder for danskfaget og for at skabe undervisning med faglige ambitioner, hvor stærke relationer og fællesskab er fundamentet for elevernes læring og trivsel. Hos os bliver du en del af en skole, hvor vi lykkes sammen – både fagligt og menneskeligt.

Som dansklærer bliver du en del af et klasseteam bestående af en matematiklærer og en klassepædagog. Samarbejdet er en naturlig del af hverdagen, og der er skemalagt tid til fælles planlægning, koordinering og sparring. Det giver mulighed for at tænke undervisning, struktur og elevtrivsel sammen og sikre en sammenhængende skoledag for eleverne.

Co-Teaching er en grundlæggende arbejdsform på Ordrup Skole og ikke et midlertidigt tiltag. Når to voksne er til stede i undervisningen, arbejder vi bevidst med fælles didaktik, tydelige roller og fælles forberedelse. Alle lærere har Co-timer i deres opgaveoversigt, og vi prioriterer et højt antal Co-timer på alle årgange. I 2. klasse er hverdagen understøttet af 10 klassepædagogtimer samt CoTeachning timer, hvilket giver gode muligheder for nærvær, differentiering og fælles ansvar for elevernes faglige og sociale udvikling. Der vil desuden være mulighed for at undervise i engelsk, gerne den bløde del af håndværk og design og andre fag, vi er åbne for at sammensætte en fagkombination, der passer godt til både dig og skolens behov.

Det tilbyder vi – og det forventer vi af dig

Vi tilbyder et stærkt fagligt og kollegialt fællesskab, skemalagte samarbejdsmøder og tid til fælles planlægning, en nærværende og tillidsfuld ledelse samt gode fysiske rammer og engagerede forældre. Du bliver en del af en skole i bevægelse med gode muligheder for faglig og professionel udvikling – uanset om du er nyuddannet eller har flere års erfaring.

Vi forventer, at du har en tydelig faglig profil i dansk og er ambitiøs på elevernes vegne, at du er en nærværende og tydelig klasseleder med blik for fællesskabet, og at du bidrager aktivt til teamsamarbejde og kollegial sparring. Du vægter stærke og professionelle relationer til elever, kolleger og forældre højt. På Ordrup Skole tror vi på, at undervisning lykkes bedst, når vi løfter opgaven sammen, og vi glæder os til at finde en kollega, der vil være med til at styrke dette fællesskab.

Det praktiske

Hvis du ønsker at være en del af vores dedikerede team af lærere og bidrage til udviklingen af Ordrup Skole, bedes du sende din ansøgning og CV via vores rekrutteringssystem.

  • Ansøgningsfrist: onsdag den 28. oktober 2026 kl.10.00
  • Der indkaldes løbende til ansættelsessamtaler, forvent indkaldelse senest 28. oktober 2026. De sidste samtaler afholdes 29. oktober 2026.
  • Tiltrædelse: 1. december 2026
  • Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at sende en SMS til skoleleder Martin Steno på tlf. 26257403

Løn og ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst med Gentofte kommunelærerforening. I Gentofte kommune er der en generel politik om, at der ved ansættelse på børne- og ungeområdet indhentes børne- og straffeattest.

title: Smed til konstruktion og bearbejdning i Virum
description:
Er du smed og vil du have god timeløn, firmabil og ordnede forhold?



Vi mangler en smed til konstruktion og bearbejdning i Virum.



Du lander i en større værkstedsforretning, hvor der er flere fagligheder under samme tag. Hverdagen ligger tæt på biler, værksted og praktiske løsninger, så arbejdet skal spille sammen med resten af huset. Der er både mekanisk værksted, pladeværksted og reservedelsflow omkring dig, og det kræver en smed der kan arbejde ordentligt fra første opmåling til færdig samling.

Rollen passer til dig, der kan lide at tage fat på konkrete konstruktioner og få tingene til at passe. Du får en hverdag med forarbejde, bearbejdning og samling, hvor kvaliteten kan mærkes i det næste led. Stemningen skal være jordnær, og det skal være sjovt at gå på arbejde.

Det får du

Løn: 230-250 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Virum og omegn

Kolleger: Cirka 40 ansatte

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Konstruktion, bearbejdning og samling

Din hverdag

Dagen handler om at tage emner fra forarbejde til færdig samling. Du arbejder med en værkstedsrytme, hvor dine løsninger skal passe ind i det arbejde, der allerede er i gang. Når noget skal justeres, siger du til, så opgaven ikke bare bliver sendt videre halvt.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Forarbejder og bearbejder emner
  • Fremstiller og samler konstruktioner
  • Skærer, borer og tilpasser dele
  • Arbejder med konstruktioner i metal
  • Reparerer og ombygger efter behov

Der er mange fagligheder omkring dig, så det betyder noget at du afleverer ordentligt og taler rent om det, der mangler. Det er den slags hverdag, hvor godt håndværk ikke behøver store ord.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du skal ikke være ekspert i hvert eneste hjørne af faget. Men du skal kunne stå inde for det du afleverer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har mindst 3 års erfaring som smed
  • Har kørekort
  • Kan arbejde med forarbejde, bearbejdning og samling
  • Er stabil og møder som aftalt
  • Siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra værksted, konstruktion eller reparation. Men det vigtigste er, at du kan tage en opgave seriøst og få den gjort færdig.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.



Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte hurtigst muligt.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.



Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Du får gratis Wolt+, WashWorld og Tv2Play abonnementer.

Du får ét ugentlig spin på vores app, hvor du kan vinde alt fra rejser til elektronik.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.



Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Det tager to minutter.

title: Case Specialist- 2025910
description:
Are you a person of compassion? An advocate for justice? Someone who stands up for the rights of the vulnerable and speaks out for the marginalized, the exploited and the forgotten? Do you believe in our calling as Christians to welcome the least of these and love our neighbor?
If you answered ‘yes’, to any of the above, World Relief, and millions of people around the world need you.
At this pivotal moment in time, we are rapidly expanding and growing our team to meet the increasing needs of our world. We are looking for people who want to use their gifts and talents to make a real and tangible difference in our world and the lives of the suffering.
If you’re looking for a purpose-driven career in which you can grow your talents, while also standing up for the rights of the vulnerable, we want you to join us today.
ORGANIZATION SUMMARY
World Relief is a global Christian humanitarian organization whose mission is to boldly engage the world’s greatest crises in partnership with the church. The organization was founded in the aftermath of World War II to respond to the urgent humanitarian needs of war-torn Europe. Since then, for 80 years, across 100 countries, World Relief has partnered with local churches and communities to build a world where families thrive and communities flourish.
Today, organizational programming focuses on humanitarian and disaster response, community strengthening and resilience, and refugee & immigrant services and advocacy.

POSITION SUMMARY:
World Relief seeks a Case Specialist to provide support, services, and service enrollment assistance to newly arrived refugees as a part of their integration into their new country.

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide community orientation, advice, and assistance in addressing basic needs
  • Perform home visits and evaluations during service period
  • Maintain regular communication with clients through phone calls, emails, and office visits
  • Assist refugees with appointments and other health related appointments
  • Assist clients in creating budgets and provide basic financial information
  • Ensure client enrollment to public benefits (as applicable), enrollment in ESL classes (as applicable), and encourage clients to engage in further integration programs and legal services
  • Assist clients in creating individualized service plans that map out the completion of core services
  • Maintain and complete detailed and accurate records of client files, case notes, and reporting records in a timely manner
  • Encourage participants to work towards self-sufficiency and early employment (if applicable)
  • Identify and address barriers to successful resettlement and integration
  • Operate as a cultural broker between volunteers, church groups, service providers, and refugees
  • Complete reports and other tasks related to the Reception and Placement Program as needed

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • Mature and personal Christian faith
  • Committed to the mission, vision, and values of World Relief
  • Desire to serve and empower the Church to impact vulnerable communities
  • Able to affirm and/or acknowledge World Reliefs Core Beliefs, Statement of Faith, Christian Identity and National Association of Evangelicals' For the Health of The Nation document
  • Ability to work evenings and weekends as client’s needs change
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable access to an insured vehicle required (Position is based in Fort Worth Office, but travel around the DFW Metroplex is required)
  • Must be able to pass a background check and MVR check
  • Experience in Microsoft software including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook
  • Up to 50% domestic local travel only required

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Demonstrated understanding of case management processes--extremely detailed orientated and excellent time management skills
  • Bi-lingual desired (e.g., Dari, Pashto, Arabic, Kirundi, Swahili, Spanish)
  • Skill and sensitivity working with people from various backgrounds and beliefs
  • Ability to work well on a team in a synergistic work environment, a flexible and motivated team player
  • Undergraduate degree preferred
  • Previous case management experience preferred
  • Previous professional experience in social services sector strongly preferred
World Relief offers a competitive benefits package and employee discount program for full-time employees.
World Relief is honored to be recognized with the Gold-level Cigna Healthy Workforce Designation for exceeding the core components of our well-being program including leadership and culture, program foundations and execution, and whole person health.
***
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
We are proud to be an EEO/AA employer M/F/D/V. We maintain a drug-free workplace and perform pre-employment substance abuse testing.
For World Relief staff, strong commitment to the mission, vision, and values of World Relief is essential, and Christian faith is a prerequisite for employment, based upon United States federal guidelines provided in Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964.

Du kender måske allerede Netto som Danmarks største dagligvarekæde – men vidste du også, at vores medarbejdere er rigtig glade for at arbejde her?

title: Senior Test and Systems Engineer
description:
Technology Advancement Group (TAG) is a veteran-owned systems integrator in Ashburn, Virginia. We design, build and integrate assured positioning, navigation and timing (PNT) hardware and software for the Department of Defense and the companies that build for it. Our products include anti-jam CRPA antennas, horizon-nulling antennas and a miniature M-code GPS receiver. All of them are shipping today, with test data behind them, and our engineers integrate them into the systems our customers already run.

We're hiring a Senior Test and Systems Engineer to lead systems engineering and test on our PNT products and to build the team that does it. You'll report to our [Technical Director], manage our Junior Systems Engineer, and work in a matrixed organization alongside hardware, software and production engineers. You'll own the path from a customer's technical requirements to the test result that proves we met them: requirements, architecture, verification and validation, and the procedures production uses to build and test every unit. There's no large engineering department behind you here, so you'll set how TAG does systems engineering and test, and you'll give input directly to Engineering, Manufacturing, Configuration Management, Quality and executive leadership.

On an average day you'll handle some combination of the following. You'll turn customer requirements into requirements documents and performance specifications, lead architecture design and documentation, and own configuration management and Contract Data Requirements Lists (CDRLs) for your programs. You'll write and approve test plans, design verification procedures, functional test procedures and assembly procedures, and run system and integration testing in the lab and in the field, including on customer platforms. You'll lead design reviews, troubleshoot hardware, software and system issues to root cause, and support failure reporting, analysis and corrective action. You'll evaluate Engineering Change Requests (ECRs), design test fixtures and keep test documentation under revision control. You'll also assign, review and coach the Junior Systems Engineer's work so it meets the same standard as yours.

Who You Are

You're a senior engineer who still wants the hardware on your bench, and you want to build the team and the process around you.

You lead by doing. You set the standard by working to it. You'll write procedures, run tests and debug units alongside the engineer you manage, and you'd rather show than tell.

You develop people. You give clear assignments, review work honestly and explain the why behind your feedback. You measure yourself partly by how fast the engineers around you grow.

You think in requirements. When a customer says what they need, you're already working out how you'll verify it. You won't call something done until a test proves it.

You don't stop at the symptom. When a test fails, you chase it to the root cause, prove it, and make sure the fix shows up in the design, the procedure or the process.

You own it at small scale. There's no test department or process group to lean on here. When a procedure is missing, you write it. When a process is slowing the team down, you say so and fix it.

You care who's on the other end. Our products go to warfighters who need to know where they are when GPS is jammed or spoofed. A test you sign off on is a promise to them. You take that seriously, and it shows in your work.

Required Experience

Systems engineering across the lifecycle. You've taken electronic products from customer requirements through design, verification and production. You've decomposed requirements, written performance specifications and worked to an interface control document (ICD). Pick a requirement and you can walk us through it from the customer's words to the test result.

Test and verification. You've written and run test plans, design verification procedures and functional test procedures for hardware and software, and built the fixtures to run them. You can show us a procedure you wrote that someone else ran without having to ask you what you meant.

Hands-on integration and troubleshooting. You've integrated hardware and software in the lab and in the field, and traced failures to root cause with oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, signal generators and test data. You can describe a failure that took more than a day to find and how you proved the cause.

Configuration and change control. You've kept configuration management, revision-controlled documentation and engineering changes in order on a program. You know what a test record has to show to hold up with a customer or an auditor.

Leading engineers. You've led or mentored at least one engineer: assigned the work, reviewed it and helped them grow. You can tell us about someone you developed and what changed for them.

Communication. You brief test results and technical issues clearly, in writing and in person, to engineers, program managers and customers, including at design reviews.

U.S. person status. This position requires access to technical data controlled under U.S. export control laws. Applicants must be U.S. persons as defined in the ITAR (22 CFR 120.62): U.S. citizens and nationals, lawful permanent residents, and persons admitted as refugees or granted asylum.

Clearance eligibility. You must be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance, which requires U.S. citizenship.

Nice to Haves

GNSS and PNT. You've worked with GNSS receivers, CRPA or anti-jam antennas, GNSS simulators or inertial systems, and you understand what jamming and spoofing do to a navigation solution.

Military platform integration. You've integrated and tested equipment on military vehicles, aircraft or ships, or supported customer test events.

Quality systems. You've worked in an ISO 9001 or AS9100 quality system and supported failure reporting, analysis and corrective action (FRACAS).

Linux and test automation. You're comfortable on the Linux command line and script your own test automation.

Active clearance. You already hold a current U.S. government security clearance, at any level.

TAG is a small, veteran-owned company, and more than a quarter of our team has served. You'll work directly with leadership and engineering, build the team you lead, and the products you test will ship to the field.

TAG is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

TAG does not respond to unsolicited recruitment services.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Operations Generalist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Operations Generalist based in Australia.

The Senior Operations Generalist will play a key role in ensuring smooth, efficient operations within a globally distributed organization working across the private markets ecosystem. In this remote position, you will oversee essential administrative, financial, and project coordination workflows while supporting leadership and enabling teams to collaborate effectively across time zones. You will manage day-to-day processes, coordinate meetings and communications, maintain accurate financial records, and contribute to recruitment and onboarding activities. You will also conduct research to support partnerships, sponsorships, and collaborative events. Beyond execution, you will help maintain high operational standards by improving handovers, ensuring consistent reporting, and mentoring junior team members. This opportunity is ideal for an organized, proactive professional who thrives in an international environment and enjoys combining hands-on operations with process improvement and team development.

Accountabilities

  • Oversee daily operational workflows across CRM systems, finance, and internal coordination to ensure business activities run efficiently.

  • Manage global calendars, schedule meetings, and coordinate communications across teams operating in different time zones.

  • Track and organize invoices, receipts, and expense reports across departments, maintaining accurate and reliable records.

  • Support recruitment and onboarding processes, helping new team members integrate smoothly into the organization.

  • Conduct research into sponsorship opportunities, potential partnerships, and event co-hosting initiatives.

  • Maintain clear, timely daily reporting and high-quality handovers through Slack to support continuity and effective collaboration.

  • Coordinate administrative and project-related tasks, ensuring priorities are tracked and deadlines are met.

  • Mentor junior generalists, promote consistent ways of working, and contribute to continuous operational improvement.

  • Support leadership directly with operational execution, organization, and coordination of key initiatives.

    • Requirements

    • At least 3 years of experience in remote operations, administration, project coordination, or a related field.

    • Strong English proficiency, with a minimum B2 level; C1 proficiency is preferred.

    • Proficiency in Google Workspace, including Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Drive, as well as Slack.

    • Exceptional attention to detail, organizational skills, and time management.

    • Ability to manage multiple workflows, prioritize competing tasks, and deliver accurate work within deadlines.

    • Demonstrated independence and reliability when working remotely with colleagues across different time zones.

    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across teams and functions.

    • A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and willingness to take ownership of operational processes.

    • Ability to provide guidance to junior colleagues and contribute to consistent team standards.

    • Location requirement: Applicants must currently be based in Poland, the Philippines, or Latin America to be considered for this position.

      • Benefits

      • Monthly compensation of $1,800–$2,100 USD, depending on experience.

      • Permanent employment opportunity.

      • Fully remote work with international collaboration and flexibility across time zones.

      • Opportunity to join a global team working to transform the private markets ecosystem.

      • Professional growth opportunities, including potential progression into leadership and process optimization responsibilities.

title: Event Project Manager
description:
Meeting Tomorrow is a 23-year-old company with a growing team of 90 talented, friendly people. We’re headquartered in Chicago, with about 80% of our team working remotely in cities across the country.

We are a full-service event agency with three core divisions: planning, production, and creative. We plan and produce corporate events of every shape and size, partnering with clients that include Fortune 500 companies and leading organizations across a wide array of industries.

We’re known for our exceptional customer experience, our collaborative culture, and our can-do spirit. Our culture has earned us recognition as a Top 20 Inspiring Workplace in North America, as well as the Events Industry Council's Social Impact Award. We offer great benefits, the best coworkers you’ll find anywhere, and the opportunity to work in a dynamic, team-oriented environment. We can’t wait to meet you!


The Opportunity

The Event Project Manager is responsible for managing a high volume of AV production projects for small to mid-sized corporate events for a wide variety of our clients.

This person will work with clients across tech, finance, pharma, and non-profit spaces, serving as the face of Meeting Tomorrow throughout the event execution process. You'll be the client's main point of contact and the person accountable for how each event turns out. You'll get to know each client's goals, spot gaps in the plan, recommend the right path, and keep clients, vendors, and our internal teams on track from first call to final invoice. This role is highly detailed, task-oriented, and requires the confidence to guide senior client stakeholders throughout the whole process, ultimately ensuring the clients' vision for AV production and creative design becomes reality.

This role requires some onsite travel (approximately 10-15%, or about 2-3 days per month).

What You'll Own

  • Audiovisual Event Project Planning: You’ll manage many overlapping events throughout the year, managing project scope, timelines, and budgets. You’ll guide clients through the project lifecycle, coaching them on AV production best practices for in-person and hybrid events to ensure the execution exceeds their vision.
  • Communication & Decision Making: You are the client’s main point of contact and MT representative. You’ll lead the information flow between internal teams (fulfillment, creative, etc.), venues, vendors, and the client, set clear deadlines, and follow up until things are done, as well as preparing onsite staff for successful execution.
  • Client Relationship Building: You don’t just manage events but you build genuine connections. You’ll get to know our clients on a personal level (interests, family, life events) and bring a level of enthusiasm that drives credibility and repeat business.
  • Creative Deliverables Management: You’ll act as the bridge between clients and creative teams (designers, editors). You’ll manage logistics with vendors (decor, print, custom fabrication), maintain asset trackers, manage POs, and negotiate terms to be a true steward of the client’s budget.
  • On-Site Leadership: You’ll travel (approx. 10-15%) to be the face of MT, preparing onsite staff in partnership with Production Managers to execute flawlessly while staying engaged and responsive in fast-paced event environments.

What We Need

  • 4+ Years of Event Experience: You’ve been a part of leading events whether at an agency or other high-touch client setting.
  • Organization & Speed: You’re used to a high volume of work, a fast-paced multitasker who is accountable to deadlines, and finds joy in the details.
  • Clear Communicator. You’re able to confidently set expectations, speak up early, and follow through.
  • Relationship Builder. You’re able to build relationships and cater your approach depending on the person you’re talking to. You’re experienced in working with different personalities and professional levels.
  • Technical & Creative Curiosity: You’re ready to dive into AV production and creative service logistics.
  • Adaptability. You can confidently work and make decisions in gray, unpredictable spaces with shifting priorities. When faced with unforeseen challenges, you adjust to keep the project (and everybody) on track.
  • Values Alignment: You demonstrate kindness, commitment, and humility in everything you do.

The Impact

Within 1 month, you’ll:
  • Learn about MT’s services - the value we offer, the types of events that we service and our customer-service mentality.
    Have opportunities for training to expand your exposure and understanding of how we manage events at Meeting Tomorrow
  • Meet with current members of the Project Management, Production, Creative, and Sales teams to understand best practices for supporting our clients and their diverse needs.
Within 3 months, you’ll:
  • Build strong and lasting relationships with clients and internal team members, ensuring a strong client retention rate.
  • Begin to create your own processes for working with your clients and identify opportunities for efficiency/improvement.
  • Become proficient in our CRM, Netsuite and Project Planning tool, Backstage.
  • Work with members of our internal support teams to effectively manage an event series for premier clients. These clients include Fortune-5000 companies in many sectors including pharmaceutical, wealth management, and production service agencies.
Within 6 months you’ll:
  • Have proficiency in the role and be managing accounts with autonomy.
  • Complete projects to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the team.
  • Demonstrate an aptitude for problem solving and contingency planning; striving to consistently exceed client expectations.

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision plan options
  • Employer paid STD, LTD, Life Insurance, and EAP access
  • 401k with employer matching up to 4%
  • 16 PTO days (increases with tenure) + 9 paid holidays
  • Annual profit-sharing bonus
  • 12 weeks 100% paid parental leave (maternity, paternity, adoption)
  • $50 Monthly fitness reimbursement
  • Monthly stipends for internet and/or cell
  • Company donation(s) to your charities of choice (up to $1,000 annually)
  • Regular social events and learning opportunities

At Meeting Tomorrow, our mission is to foster a culture of respect and affection. We embrace our differences and are committed to having a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment. We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer that believes in second chances and strongly encourages BIPOC, women, LGBTQIA, veterans, persons with disabilities, formerly incarcerated and all other individuals to apply.

What makes Meeting Tomorrow’s culture so special is the people, and we look for candidates who are a match for our company’s core values: commitment, kindness and humility. If those words describe you and you see yourself in this posting, you’re ready to apply!
